SPEAKING NORMATIV — Crafts and everyday design
1:40–2:00 to'xtovsiz, 3 ta yangi ibora, 4 mezon o'rtachasi ≥ 5.5 (S6_CLASS)

kahoot.q: In Listening Section 4, when is the best time to read all the questions?
kahoot.explain: Section 4 da o'rtada pauza yo'q, shuning uchun savollarning hammasi audio boshlanishidan oldin berilgan vaqtda o'qiladi.

kahoot.q: Predict the gap: 'The museum now owns more than 300 ___ from the 18th century.' What kind of word is missing?
kahoot.explain: '300' dan keyin sanaladigan ko'plikdagi ot keladi (masalan, 300 paintings).

kahoot.q: The instructions say NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Which answer breaks the word limit?
kahoot.explain: 'a pair of scissors' — to'rt so'z; qolganlari bir yoki ikki so'z, ya'ni chegara ichida.

kahoot.q: Sentence: 'The designer chose bright ___ buttons.' You hear: 'she chose bright plastic buttons'. What do you write?
kahoot.explain: 'bright' va 'buttons' gapda bor — faqat yetishmayotgan so'z yoziladi; ularni takrorlasangiz, gap buziladi.

kahoot.q: Sentence: 'The company's first products were ___.' You hear: 'You might think they began with toys, but in fact they first made kitchen tools.' What do you write?
kahoot.explain: 'You might think ... but in fact' — birinchi aytilgan narsa (toys) tuzoq, javob 'in fact' dan keyin keladi.

kahoot.q: Sentence: 'The main reason for the change was ___.' You hear: 'Price was one factor, and fashion another, but the main reason was comfort.' What do you write?
kahoot.explain: Savolda 'main reason' bor, ma'ruzachi ham 'the main reason was' deb ko'rsatadi; price va fashion — boshqa sabablar.

kahoot.q: A lecturer says: 'What's more, the new material was much cheaper.' What is the speaker doing?
kahoot.explain: 'What's more' (= furthermore) yangi qo'shimcha fikr qo'shadi; u xulosa yoki qarama-qarshilikni bildirmaydi.

kahoot.q: A lecturer says: 'To put it another way, the design was simple.' What does this phrase signal?
options: The same idea in new words
kahoot.explain: 'To put it another way' — o'sha fikr boshqa so'zlar bilan qayta aytiladi; paraphrase'ni ushlash uchun qulay joy.

kahoot.q: The question says 'was invented'. Which phrase in the lecture could mean the same?
kahoot.explain: 'Invented' — ilk bor yaratilgan, ya'ni 'first developed'; qolganlari ixtirodan keyingi bosqichlar.

kahoot.q: The question says 'too expensive for most people'. Which phrase in the lecture means the same?
options: most people did not like it
few people had heard of it
kahoot.explain: 'Could afford' — pul yetadi; 'few people could afford it' = ko'pchilik uchun juda qimmat edi.

kahoot.q: Sentence: 'Visitors can see several old ___ in the hall.' You hear: '...several old spinning wheels'. Which answer gets the mark?
kahoot.explain: 'Several' dan keyin ko'plik kerak (-s); 'old' gapda bor, 'a spinning wheel' esa birlik va gapga mos emas.

kahoot.q: You missed Q4, and the lecturer is now talking about Q5's topic. What should you do?
options: Stop and try to recall Q4
Wait for Q4 to be repeated
kahoot.explain: Audio to'xtamaydi: hozir Q5 ning kalit so'zini tinglang, Q4 ga oxirida mantiqiy taxmin yozing.

kahoot.q: A 'fastener' on a jacket is something that…
kahoot.explain: Fastener — kiyimni yopib, mahkamlab turadigan narsa: tugma, zamok, ilgak.

kahoot.q: 'The custom originated in Persia.' This means the custom…
kahoot.explain: Originate — kelib chiqmoq, ilk bor paydo bo'lmoq.

kahoot.q: A 'bulky' winter coat is…
options: light and very easy to fold
kahoot.explain: Bulky — katta hajmli, qo'pol: kiyish yoki olib yurish noqulay.

kahoot.q: 'The old craft was revived in the 1990s.' What happened in the 1990s?
kahoot.explain: Revive — qayta tiklamoq: unutilgan narsa yana hayotga qaytadi.

kahoot.q: If you 'embroider' a bag, you…
kahoot.explain: Embroider — kashta tikmoq: igna bilan mato ustiga naqsh yoki rasm tikish.

kahoot.q: 'For many people, the dove symbolises peace.' Here, 'symbolises' means…
kahoot.explain: Symbolise — ramzi bo'lmoq, biror g'oyani ifodalamoq (= represent).

kahoot.q: 'The new style was slow to catch on.' This means the style…
options: was hard to make by hand
kahoot.explain: Catch on — ommalashmoq; 'slow to catch on' — sekin ommalashdi.

kahoot.q: 'My aunt took up knitting last year.' This means she…
options: sold all the things she had knitted
kahoot.explain: Take up — yangi mashg'ulotni boshlamoq; teskarisi — give up (tashlamoq).

lessons.title: Mock test 2: Unit 1–8 dan keyin — Listening va Reading bo'yicha yakuniy o'lchov, natijalar tahlili (imtihon alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada)
lessons.grammar_topic: Mockdan keyingi tahlil darsi: imtihonning o'zi dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter; Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa); bu darsda natija Mock 1 bilan solishtiriladi, savol turlari bo'yicha Unit 1–8 ga bog'lab tahlil qilinadi, Writing AI izohi 4 mezon bo'yicha ko'rib chiqiladi va ikki haftalik reja yoziladi; Speaking — alohida yuzma-yuz intervyu (11–14 daqiqa, S6_FULL bo'yicha; filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan), umumiy band to'rt bo'limdan
lessons.vocab_topic: Xom ball va band, Mock 1 → Mock 2 o'sishi, yetti xato sababi, savol turi bo'yicha naqsh, unitga qaytish, Writing mezonlari, ikki haftalik reja
lessons.book_ref: JonyOS mock bazasi: JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar (qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter). Mock 2 uchun Mock 1 (9-dars) dan BOSHQA variant tanlanadi — bir xil test ikki marta berilmaydi; mock bazasida variantlar harf bilan belgilangan (Variant A, B, …) — tanlangan variant harfini ustoz yozib qo'yadi. Mock — dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya: Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa; Listening yozuvi bo'lmasa, skriptni examiner ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi. Examiner javoblar varaqasi har savol bo'yicha o'quvchining javobi, to'g'ri javob va mavzu belgisini ko'rsatadi; Listening va Reading bandi rasmiy xom ball — band jadvali bo'yicha avtomatik qo'yiladi. Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. Speaking mock kartochkalari A/B/C — Jony Academy original materiali (Part 1 mavzulari: Home, Shopping, Sports, Birthdays).
objectives: Mock sessiyasini tartib bilan o'tkazish (alohida kun, JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim): xona va ekran tayyorligi, qoidalar, Listening, tugatgan o'quvchi bilan ishlash.
Mock (Listening ~30 + Reading 60 + Writing 60 = 150 daqiqa) dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida sessiya ekanini, bu 120 daqiqalik dars esa faqat natijalar tahlili ekanini bilish.
O'z natijasini o'qish: xom ball, band va qaysi bo'lim o'rtachani pastga tortgani.
Har xato javobni yetti sababdan bittasiga ajratish.
Xatolarni savol turi bo'yicha guruhlab, Unit 1–8 dagi qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligini aniqlash.
Maqsad bilan solishtirish (6.0 va undan yuqori: Listening 23+, Reading 23+ (40 dan)) va ikki haftalik aniq reja yozish.
Mock 1 → Mock 2 jadvalini to'ldirish: xom ball va band qanchaga o'zgargani, eng zaif 2 tur va 9-darsdagi ikki haftalik rejaning nechta qatori bajarilgani.
Writing natijasini o'qish: AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha qo'ygan ballar, inglizcha izoh va xatolar ro'yxati; Mock 1 bilan solishtirish, eng past mezonni topish va 5 ta xatoni tuzatish.
Speaking mock tartibini bilish, o'z bandini 4 mezon bo'yicha tushunish va 1-mock speaking natijasi bilan solishtirish.
materials: Mock sessiyasi uchun: chop etilgan ism ro'yxati — kim qaysi kompyuterda o'tirgani va kim tugatgani belgilanadi.
Mock sessiyasi uchun: sessiyani o'tkazuvchi examiner ekranida Listening skripti (yozuv bo'lmasa o'qiladi) — o'quvchiga ko'rsatilmaydi.
Mock sessiyasi uchun: har stolda zaxira qog'oz va qalam — Listening paytida ism, raqam va sanalar qoralama qilinadi.

Mock sessiyasi uchun: doskada xona qoidalari (telefon sumkada, imtihon to'liq ekranda, ekrandan chiqish tizimda sanaladi) va qolgan vaqt. Tahlil darsi uchun: doskada Listening va Reading xom ball — band jadvallari (2-mashq).
Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchiga "Yetti sabab" jadvali va "Savol turi → Unit" xaritasi (quyidagi 3-mashq jadvali) chop etilgan holda.
Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchiga "Ikki haftalik reja" varaqasi — 6 qator, oxirida ustoz imzosi uchun joy.

Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchi o'z examiner javoblar varaqasini o'z ekranida (kompyuterda) yoki chop etilgan shaxsiy nusxada ko'radi. Proyektorda faqat to'g'ri javoblar va guruh statistikasi (qaysi savolda nechta xato) ko'rsatiladi — shaxsiy natijalar proyektorga chiqarilmaydi.

Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchining Mock 1 (9-dars) natijasi — Listening va Reading xom ball va band, Writing mezonlari — 9-darsdagi xatolar daftari (tur va sabab sanog'i) va 9-darsda imzolangan ikki haftalik reja varaqasi (4-mashq uchun).
Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchining examiner tasdiqlagan Writing natijasi — 4 mezon bo'yicha ball, inglizcha izoh va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxati (o'z ekranida yoki chop etilgan nusxada).

Speaking intervyusi uchun (filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan): Speaking kartochkalari A/B/C (faqat examinerda), bayonnoma varaqasi, 1-mock speaking bandlari ro'yxati, telefon diktofoni, intervyu jadvali.
timeline: Kirish: bugun — tahlil darsi

Mock 2 alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada o'tgan (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar); bugun faqat natija, Mock 1 bilan solishtirish va tahlil. Mock — o'lchov, jazo emas. Ballar ovoz chiqarib aytilmaydi, har kim o'z varaqasi bilan ishlaydi.
Natijani ochish

Har o'quvchi Listening va Reading xom ball va bandini, Writing bandini daftariga yozadi, yoniga Mock 1 (9-dars) natijasini qo'yadi va maqsad bilan solishtiradi (6.0 va undan yuqori: Listening 23+, Reading 23+ (40 dan)).
Xom ball — band jadvali
Doskada ikkala jadval; jadval chegarasida bitta savol yarim bandni o'zgartirishi va band o'zgarmasa ham xom ball o'sishi ko'rsatiladi (2-mashq).
Yetti sabab
Har sababga kamida bitta misol, asosan Unit 5–8 turlaridan (1-mashq, 9 ta misol); sabablar jadvali tarqatiladi.
Javoblar varaqasi: Listening

Har kim o'z varaqasini savol-savol o'qiydi, har xatoga sabab raqami va Section turi yoziladi. Proyektorda faqat to'g'ri javoblar va guruh statistikasi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 3–4 savol uchun ustoz skriptdan faqat tegishli bitta gapni ko'rsatadi (bu gaplarni darsdan oldin examinerdan olib tayyorlab qo'ying).
Javoblar varaqasi: Reading
Passage bo'yicha ketma-ket; har xatoga sabab raqami va savol turi yoziladi.
Savol turi → Unit xaritasi
Har tur va har sabab necha marta chiqqani sanaladi; xatolar savol turi bo'yicha guruhlanadi va Unit 1–8 dagi qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligi topiladi (3-mashq).
Mock 1 → Mock 2

4-mashq jadvali to'ldiriladi: Mock 1 va Mock 2 ning xom balli va bandi, eng zaif 2 tur va eng ko'p sabab (hozirgi sanoqdan), 9-darsdagi rejaning nechta qatori bajarilgani; har qatorga xulosa. Writing qatorining xulosasi 5-mashqdan keyin yoziladi.
Ikki haftalik reja
Har kim eng katta ikki naqsh bo'yicha 6 qatorli reja yozadi; 9-darsdagi rejaning bajarilmagan, hali kerakli qatori ham kiritiladi; juftlik o'qib tekshiradi.
Writing feedback
AI examiner natijasi: 4 mezon bo'yicha ball, inglizcha izoh, grammatika va lug'at xatolari; Mock 1 bilan solishtirish, eng past mezon, 5 ta tuzatish va bitta odat (5-mashq).
SPEAKING — Mock: tartib, kartochkalar va band

2' tartib eslatiladi (S6_MOCK_PROCEDURE) → 3' 1-mock speaking bandi bilan solishtirish: qaysi mezon o'sdi? → 3' S6_FULL dan Band 6 va 7 qatorlari farqi → 2' intervyu jadvali. Mock 2 Speaking natijasi hali chiqmagan bo'lsa, 1-mock bandidan bitta maqsad mezon tanlanadi. Intervyuning o'zi — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan (6–9-mashq).
Xulosa va vazifa

5-mashqdagi Writing odati reja varag'ining ostiga yoziladi; reja ustozga ko'rsatiladi va imzolanadi; xatolar daftari, yangi material va Writing xatboshisi uyda bajariladi. Har o'quvchi Speaking intervyu slotini daftariga yozadi.

intro: Bu — Mock 2 dan keyingi TAHLIL darsi. Imtihonning o'zi dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida sessiyada o'tadi; bu 120 daqiqada natija Mock 1 bilan solishtiriladi, savol-savol va savol turi bo'yicha tahlil qilinadi, Writing izohi ko'rib chiqiladi va ikki haftalik reja yoziladi. Yangi mavzu yo'q — Unit 1–8 da o'rganilgan savol turlari kombinatsiyalarining imtihon sharoitidagi natijasi tahlil qilinadi.

Mock sessiyasi (dars sonidan tashqarida, alohida kun): examiner JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar bo'limidan guruh uchun mockni ochadi (Mock 1 dan boshqa variant), o'quvchilar qat'iy rejimda (faqat kompyuter, to'liq ekran) ishlaydi: Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa — jami 150 daqiqa, bitta o'tirishda. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan: har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon bo'yicha; imkon bo'lmasa, bu mockda Speaking yo'q.

Sessiyada Listening yozuvi bo'lmasa, skriptni EXAMINER ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: bir marta, bir tekis tezlikda (taxminan 150 so'z/daqiqa), rollarni ovoz bilan farqlab. Skript faqat examiner ekranida turadi.

Natija ikki raqam: XOM BALL (40 dan nechta) va BAND. Listening va Reading jadvallari bir xil emas: 26 ta to'g'ri javob Listeningda 6.5, Academic Readingda 6.0. Jadval chegarasida bitta savol yarim bandni o'zgartiradi (Reading 22 ta = 5.5, 23 ta = 6.0) — bo'sh javob qoldirmang. Band o'zgarmasa ham xom ball o'sishi — o'sish: Listening 18 → 22 ikkalasi ham 5.5, lekin 4 savol yaxshiroq.

Yetti sabab: 1) eshitmadim / topa olmadim; 2) eshitdim, lekin xato yozdim (imlo, ko'plik, raqam); 3) vaqt yetmadi; 4) savol turini noto'g'ri tushundim (so'z limiti, NOT GIVEN va FALSE farqi, TWO letters); 5) taxmin qildim; 6) bilardim, lekin javobni o'zgartirdim; 7) savoldagi so'zni yoki uning paraphrase'ini tanimadim (javob joyi oldimda edi, lekin sinonimni bilmadim) — davosi: paraphrase juftligini daftarga yozish va unit lug'atini takrorlash.

6.0 kursida tahlil SAVOL TURI bo'yicha olib boriladi. Har xatoning yonida savol turi yoziladi va "Savol turi → Unit" xaritasidan qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligi topiladi. Masalan, Matching headings da 3 ta xato — Unit 2 (3-dars) va Unit 7 (14-dars) strategiyasi takrorlanadi va shu turdagi YANGI passage'lar ishlanadi (darsdagi Practice'larning javoblari o'quvchiga allaqachon ma'lum).
Kombinatsiya xatosini alohida belgilang: agar bir passage'da ikkinchi savol turiga vaqt yetmagan bo'lsa (3-sabab), muammo tur emas — xarita usuli va vaqt taqsimoti.

Maqsad: 6.0 va undan yuqori: Listening 23+, Reading 23+ (40 dan). Maqsaddan past bo'lim — ikki haftalik rejaning birinchi qatori. Writing uchun raqamli maqsad qo'yilmaydi: Task 2 mezonlari Mock 1 dagi ballar bilan solishtiriladi (o'sish), Task 1 esa kursda 19–20-darslarda o'tiladi — shuning uchun Task 1 bali diagnostika va o'sha darslarning boshlang'ich nuqtasi.

WRITING natijasi: JonyOS AI examiner Writing'ni 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi — Task Achievement (Task 1) / Task Response (Task 2), Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy; Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi. U inglizcha examiner izohi va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxatini beradi. Examiner 48 soat ichida bahoni tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, shundan keyin natija e'lon qilinadi; guruh ustozi tahlil darsida shu tasdiqlangan natija bilan ishlaydi. Har mezonga faqat butun ball qo'yiladi; .5 faqat o'rtacha — Writing bandida chiqadi.

Sessiya qoidasi: telefon sumkada, stolda emas. Qat'iy rejimda imtihon to'liq ekranda ishlanadi; qoidabuzarlik (boshqa varaq, oyna yoki ilovaga o'tish, to'liq ekrandan chiqish, brauzer kengaytmasi yoki ekran rasmini olishga urinish) tizimda sanaladi: 2 marta ogohlantirish beriladi, 3-chiqishda o'quvchi imtihondan chetlatiladi (chegarani examiner o'zgartirishi mumkin). Savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'tariladi.

MOCK 1 → MOCK 2: bu darsda o'sish ko'rinadi. Har o'quvchi 9-darsdagi natijasini yoniga qo'yadi: Listening va Reading xom balli va bandi, Writing bandi, eng zaif 2 tur, eng ko'p chiqqan sabab va 9-darsdagi ikki haftalik rejaning nechta qatori bajarilgani (4-mashq). Mock 1 dagi eng zaif tur endi kam xato bersa (eng zaif 2 tur ichida bo'lmasa) — reja ishlagan; o'sha tur yana birinchi o'rinda bo'lsa — yangi rejada usul o'zgartiriladi (strategiya takrori + ko'proq yangi material).

SPEAKING (filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan; imkon bo'lmasa, bu mockda Speaking yo'q): Speaking ham mockning bir qismi, lekin kompyuterda emas: har o'quvchi bilan ALOHIDA, yuzma-yuz 11–14 daqiqa (Part 1, Part 2, Part 3). Intervyu telefon diktofoniga yoziladi (moderatsiya uchun); baho S6_FULL bo'yicha 4 mezonga qo'yiladi, Speaking bandi S6_MOCK_BAND jadvalidan olinadi.

Asosiy yo'l — mock haftasida alohida jadval: har o'quvchiga 15 daqiqalik slot (dars oldidan yoki keyin), administrator jadvalni guruh chatiga yuboradi. Zaxira (faqat 1–3 o'quvchi: kasal yoki kelmagan) — 21–25-darslarning 'WRITING NORMATIV' bosqichida: sinf 18 daqiqa mustaqil yozadi, ustoz bitta o'quvchini qo'shni stolda tekshiradi. Zaxira intervyuni ham imkon qadar examiner o'tkazadi; ustoz o'tkazsa, diktofon yozuvini examiner ko'rib chiqadi va bandni tasdiqlaydi.

Yakuniy mockning umumiy IELTS bandi = (Listening + Reading + Writing + Speaking) / 4, eng yaqin yarim bandga yaxlitlanadi: x.125 → x.0; x.25, x.375 va x.625 → x.5; x.75 va x.875 → keyingi butun son. Masalan: 6.5 + 6.0 + 5.5 + 6.0 = 24 / 4 = 6.0; 6.5 + 6.0 + 6.0 + 6.5 = 25 / 4 = 6.25 → 6.5; 6.5 + 6.0 + 6.0 + 6.0 = 24.5 / 4 = 6.125 → 6.0. Speaking o'tkazilmagan bo'lsa, umumiy band hisoblanmaydi — faqat Listening, Reading va Writing bandlari yoziladi.
formulas: Bo'sh reja ishlamaydi; uyda 3 daqiqa zaxira bilan ishlanadi
Writing: eng past mezon + 5 ta tuzatish
Writing bandini ko'taradigan bitta aniq odat
presentation: To'liq mock bitta darsga sig'adimi?

Yo'q. Mock — dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim, kompyuterda): Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon). Bu 120 daqiqalik dars — faqat natijalar tahlili.
Mock nega kerak, darslar yetmaydimi?
Darsda har tur alohida ishlanadi; mockda hammasi aralash va vaqt bilan. Kombinatsiya ko'nikmasi faqat shu yerda o'lchanadi.
Ballim past chiqdi. Nima qilaman?
Avval sabablarni sanang. Ko'pincha 2-sabab (imlo, raqam) — bu eng tez tuzaladigan xato.
Xatolarim har xil turlarda. Qayerdan boshlayman?
Eng ko'p xato bo'lgan ikki turdan. Xaritadan ularning darsini toping.
Listening skriptini keyin berasizmi?

To'liq skript berilmaydi — tahlil javoblar varaqasi orqali. Lekin guruhda eng ko'p xato qilingan 3–4 savol uchun ustoz skriptdan faqat tegishli bitta gapni ekranda ko'rsatadi: shunda 1-sabab (eshitmadim) bilan 7-sabab (paraphrase'ni tanimadim) ajraladi.
Vaqt yetmadi — bu qaysi sabab?
3-sabab. Davosi — xarita usuli va vaqt qoidasi (Unit 1): imtihonda har passage 20 daqiqa (javoblarni kiritish bilan); uyda mashqda 17 daqiqa — 3 daqiqa zaxira bilan.
Writingni ham tahlil qilamizmi?

Ha, bugun 20 daqiqa (5-mashq). Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi (TA/TR, CC, LR, GRA; Task 2 ikki barobar), inglizcha izoh va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxatini beradi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. Task 2 ballari Mock 1 bilan solishtiriladi; Task 1 kursda 19–20-darslarda o'tiladi — hozirgi Task 1 bali diagnostika. Speaking ham alohida baholanadi — alohida intervyuda (filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan) S6_FULL bo'yicha 4 mezonga butun band (6–9-mashq). Umumiy band — to'rt bo'lim o'rtachasi. Writing natijasi 19–25-darslardagi Task 1 blokida ishlatiladi.
Mock 1 dan o'sdimmi? Qanday bilaman?

4-mashq jadvalida Mock 1 va Mock 2 ni yonma-yon yozing. Band o'zgarmasa ham xom ball o'sgan bo'lishi mumkin (Listening 18 → 22: ikkalasi 5.5) — bu ham o'sish; keyingi bandgacha necha savol qolganini hisoblang. Mock 1 dagi eng zaif tur endi kam xato bersa, 9-darsdagi reja ishlagan.
Bu yakuniy mock — kurs tugadimi?

Bu Unit 1–8 bo'yicha yakuniy mock — Listening va Reading bo'yicha yakuniy o'lchov. Kurs tugamadi: 19–20-darslarda Writing Task 1 o'tiladi, Mock 2 dagi Task 1 natijasi o'sha darslarning boshlang'ich nuqtasi.
notes: Maktab qarori: mock imtihoni — dars sonidan tashqaridagi ALOHIDA 150 daqiqalik sessiya (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter): Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon). Writing natijasi examiner tekshirgandan keyin (48 soat ichida) chiqadi, shuning uchun bu 120 daqiqalik tahlil darsini natijalar e'lon qilingandan KEYIN o'tkazing.
Natijalarni ochishdan oldin o'quvchilarga eslating: mock — o'lchov, jazo emas. Maqsad — keyingi ikki haftada qaysi darsga qaytishni bilish.

Tahlil qismida ustoz ham guruh bo'yicha umumiy naqshni yozib oladi: agar guruhning yarmi bitta turda xato qilgan bo'lsa, butun guruhga o'sha turdagi yangi passage yoki Section uyga beriladi va natijasi keyingi hafta tekshiriladi (19–20-darslar Writing Task 1 ga bag'ishlangan).

Bu Unit 1–8 bo'yicha yakuniy mock — Listening va Reading bo'yicha yakuniy o'lchov. Kurs shu bilan tugamaydi: 19–20-darslarda Writing Task 1 o'tiladi va Mock 2 dagi Task 1 natijasi o'sha darslarning boshlang'ich nuqtasi bo'ladi. Maqsadga yetmagan o'quvchi uchun xaritadagi 2 ta eng zaif dars bo'yicha individual reja tuziladi va Writing Task 1 bilan parallel olib boriladi.

Mock 1 natijalari: darsdan oldin har o'quvchining 9-darsdagi natijasini (Listening, Reading, Writing), xatolar daftaridagi sanoqni (eng zaif 2 tur, eng ko'p sabab) va imzolangan ikki haftalik rejasini tayyorlab qo'ying — 4-mashq usiz ishlamaydi. Mock 1 da qatnashmagan o'quvchi faqat Mock 2 ustunini to'ldiradi va uni boshlang'ich nuqta deb oladi.

Sessiya kuni tartibi (dars timeline'iga kirmaydi): kompyuterlar tekshiriladi, mock JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar bo'limidan ochiladi (Mock 1 dan boshqa variant ekanini tekshiring), ism ro'yxati va zaxira qog'oz tarqatiladi; telefon sumkaga, qat'iy rejim qoidalari ovoz chiqarib aytiladi. Listening skriptini (yozuv bo'lmasa) ikki marta o'qimang va tezlashtirmang. Reading va Writing paytida xona kuzatiladi, mazmun bo'yicha yordam berilmaydi (texnik savolga — beriladi), qolgan vaqt doskaga yozib boriladi.

Speaking intervyusi: slotlar ro'yxatini mock haftasidan oldin administratorga bering, u jadvalni guruh chatiga yuboradi; har intervyu telefon diktofoniga yoziladi. Kartochkalar A/B/C faqat examinerda (9-dars kartochkalari takrorlanmaydi) — ularni almashtirib ishlating va chiqqan o'quvchidan savollarni boshqalarga aytmaslikni so'rang. 1-mock bayonnomasini yoningizda tuting: har o'quvchiga qaysi mezonda o'sgani aytiladi. Zaxira slot (21–25-darslar, 'WRITING NORMATIV') faqat 1–3 o'quvchi uchun. Bularning hammasi filial Speaking'ni o'tkaza olsa amal qiladi (examiner bilan, boshqa kuni).

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Bu xato qaysi sababdan?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz xato javobni o'qiydi, o'quvchi yetti sababdan bittasini raqami bilan aytadi va "demak nima qilish kerak" deydi. Misollar asosan Unit 5–8 savol turlaridan.
items: Listening Section 4 (ma'ruza, sentence completion): 34–36-savollar bo'sh qolgan — o'quvchi 33-savol javobini kutib qolgan va keyingi gaplarni o'tkazib yuborgan.
Listening Section 3 (flow chart): to'g'ri javob "accommodation", o'quvchi "accomodation" yozgan.
Listening Section 1 (note completion, ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER): "Day: ______" qatoriga "next Saturday" yozilgan (to'g'risi "Saturday").
Reading Passage 3 dagi oxirgi 4 savol (sentence endings) bo'sh qolgan: Passage 1 ga 28 daqiqa ketgan.

YES / NO / NOT GIVEN: matnda "Some critics claim that online courses will replace universities" deyilgan, muallif bu fikrga baho bermagan. "The writer believes online courses will replace universities" gapiga o'quvchi YES tanlagan (to'g'risi NOT GIVEN).
Diagram labelling (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage): matnda "storage tank", o'quvchi o'z so'zlari bilan "water container" yozgan — ma'nosi yaqin, lekin matnda yo'q.
Sentence endings savolida o'quvchi isbot gap topmagan va grammatik jihatdan mos kelgan birinchi tugallanmani tanlagan; javob xato chiqqan.
Matching headings: o'quvchi avval iv ni tanlagan, oxirgi 2 daqiqada isbotsiz vi ga o'zgartirgan; to'g'risi iv edi.

Matching information: savolda "a reference to a cost-saving measure", xatboshida "the new system cut running expenses by a third"; o'quvchi bu xatboshini o'tkazib yuborgan va "cost-saving bilan cut expenses bir xil ekanini bilmadim" deydi.
why: Section 4 da pauza yo'q: javob kelmasa, keyingi savolga o'ting va doim ikki savolni birga kuzating (Unit 8 Listening, 17-dars).
Imlo xatosi — 0 ball. Javoblarni kiritishda qo'sh harflarni (cc, mm) tekshiring (Unit 7 Listening, 15-dars).
So'z chegarasi har guruhda boshqa bo'lishi mumkin — har guruhda qayta o'qing. "next Saturday" — ikki so'z, 0 ball (Unit 5 Listening, 11-dars).

Xarita usuli va vaqt (Unit 1 Reading): imtihonda har passage 20 daqiqa (javoblarni kiritish bilan); uyda mashqda 17 daqiqa — 3 daqiqa zaxira bilan. 20-daqiqada javoblarni yozib, keyingi passage'ga o'ting.

Y/N/NG MUALLIF fikrini so'raydi: matndagi boshqa odamlarning fikri (some critics claim …) muallif fikri emas. Muallif o'z munosabatini bildirmagan bo'lsa — NOT GIVEN (Unit 3, 5-dars; Unit 8, 16-dars).
"from the passage" — javob matndan aynan, o'sha shaklda ko'chiriladi; o'z sinonimingiz — 0 ball. Paraphrase savolda bo'ladi, javob esa matndagi so'z (Unit 6, 12-dars).
Bir nechta tugallanma grammatik jihatdan mos keladi — ma'no bo'yicha isbot gapni toping. Taxmin — faqat vaqt tugaganda oxirgi chora (Unit 8, 16-dars).
Birinchi javobni faqat yangi isbot topilganda o'zgartiring (Unit 2, 3-dars; Unit 7, 14-dars).
cost-saving measure = cut expenses. Paraphrase juftligini daftarga yozing va unit lug'atini takrorlang (Unit 5, 10-dars).

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Writing — AI examiner izohi bo'yicha tahlil va Mock 1 bilan solishtirish
class_ex.instr: Har o'quvchi examiner tasdiqlagan Writing natijasini ochadi: 4 mezon bo'yicha ball, inglizcha examiner izohi va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxati; Mock 1 dagi Writing natijasi ham yoningizda bo'lsin. Besh qadamni daftarda bajaring. Namuna (Dilnoza) "Javobni ko'rsat" bosilganda "Javob" ustunida chiqadi — ko'chirmang, o'z natijangiz bilan ishlang.
items: 1-qadam. Task 1 va Task 2 uchun 4 mezon bo'yicha ballaringizni yozing: Task Achievement (Task 1) / Task Response (Task 2), Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy. Task 2 ballari yoniga Mock 1 dagi ballarni yozing.
2-qadam. Mock 1 bilan solishtiring: Task 2 da qaysi mezon o'sdi, qaysi biri o'zgarmadi? Eng past mezonni belgilang (Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi).
3-qadam. Inglizcha izohdan eng muhim BITTA gapni toping va o'zbekchaga o'giring: examiner nimani so'rayapti?
4-qadam. Xatolar ro'yxatidan 5 ta xatoni tanlang: to'g'ri shaklini yozing va turini belgilang (grammatika yoki lug'at).
5-qadam. Eng past mezon uchun keyingi ikki haftada bajariladigan BITTA aniq odatni yozing. Task 1 dagi eng past mezonni alohida belgilang — 19–20-darslarda shu mezondan boshlaysiz.
answers: Dilnoza. Task 1: TA 5, CC 6, LR 6, GRA 5. Task 2: TR 6, CC 6, LR 6, GRA 5 (Mock 1 da Task 2: TR 6, CC 5, LR 5, GRA 5).

CC 5 → 6 va LR 5 → 6 o'sdi (Mock 1 dan keyin tanlangan odat ishladi); TR 6 va GRA 5 o'zgarmadi. Eng past — GRA 5 (ikkala task'da). Task 2 ikki barobar og'ir, shuning uchun Task 2 dagi GRA 5 Writing bandini eng ko'p pastga tortgan.

"You attempt complex sentences, but frequent errors in verb forms and subject–verb agreement sometimes make your meaning unclear." → Murakkab gaplarga urinasiz, lekin fe'l shakllari va ega–kesim moslashuvidagi tez-tez xatolar ba'zan fikringizni tushunarsiz qiladi — GRA ustida ishlash kerak.

"Many people is worried about traffic" → "Many people are worried about traffic" (grammatika); "If the government will invest more in buses" → "If the government invests more in buses" (grammatika); "The number of cars raised sharply" → "The number of cars rose sharply" (lug'at: rise — o'timsiz, raise — o'timli); "the most of students" → "most students" (grammatika); "do a mistake" → "make a mistake" (lug'at).

Har body xatboshisini yozib bo'lgach, 1 daqiqa faqat fe'llarni tekshiraman: ega bilan moslik (people are, the government invests) va if-gapdagi zamon (if + Present Simple). Task 1 da eng past — TA 5 (va GRA 5): 19–20-darslarda overview va asosiy xususiyatlarni tanlashdan boshlayman.
why: Har mezonga faqat BUTUN ball qo'yiladi (masalan 5 yoki 6); .5 faqat o'rtacha — Writing bandida chiqadi.

O'sgan mezon — ishlagan odat, uni davom ettiring. O'zgarmagan eng past mezon uchun 5-qadamdagi odat ikki haftalik reja varag'ining ostiga Writing qatori qilib yoziladi. Task 2 dagi 1 ball farq Writing bandiga Task 1 dagiga qaraganda ko'proq ta'sir qiladi.
Izoh inglizcha — tushunmagan so'zni ustozdan so'rang. Izohdan bitta aniq harakat chiqishi kerak.
Tuzatilgan xato — keyingi ishda takrorlanmaydigan xato. Grammatika xatolari GRA ga, so'z tanlash va birikma xatolari LR ga tegishli.
Odat kichik va aniq bo'lsin: "grammatikani yaxshilayman" emas, "har xatboshidan keyin 1 daqiqa fe'llarni tekshiraman". Task 1 bali — diagnostika: Task 1 19–20-darslarda o'tiladi.
class_ex.note: Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha baholaydi (Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi), inglizcha izoh va xatolar ro'yxatini beradi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, natija shundan keyin e'lon qilinadi. Bu darsda faqat tasdiqlangan natija bilan ishlanadi. Task 2 5.0 kursida o'tilgan — uning mezonlari Mock 1 bilan solishtiriladi; Task 1 esa 19–20-darslarda o'tiladi — shuning uchun Task 1 bali DIAGNOSTIKA va o'sha darslarning boshlang'ich nuqtasi. Ballni sinfda ovoz chiqarib aytmang.

class_ex.title: 9-mashq: SPEAKING — Mock kartochkalari A/B/C (faqat examiner)
class_ex.instr: Examiner kartochkani tasodifiy tanlaydi; savollar oldindan oshkor qilinmaydi.
items: Kartochka A / B / C — examiner tasodifiy tanlaydi
Part 1 (4–5 daqiqa): Home + yana 1 ta tanish mavzu
Part 2 (3–4 daqiqa): kartochka, 1 daqiqa tayyorlanish, 1–2 daqiqa gapirish
Part 3 (4–5 daqiqa): Part 2 mavzusi bo'yicha umumiy muhokama
answers: KARTOCHKA A — Part 1. Home: Do you live in a house or a flat? / Which room do you spend most time in? / Would you like to change anything about your home? Shopping: Do you enjoy shopping? / Do you prefer shopping online or in shops? / Has the way people shop in your city changed?

KARTOCHKA A — Part 2. Describe an environmental problem in your city or area. You should say: what the problem is, what causes it, how it affects people, and explain what could be done to solve it. Follow-up: Have you personally done anything about this problem?

KARTOCHKA A — Part 3. Whose job is it to solve environmental problems — individuals or the government? / Will cities in the future be cleaner or more polluted? / Should plastic bags be banned completely? / How can schools teach children to care about the environment?

KARTOCHKA B — Part 1. Home: Do you live in a house or a flat? / Which room do you spend most time in? / Would you like to change anything about your home? Sports: Do you play any sports? / Which sport is most popular in your country? / Did you do more sport as a child?

KARTOCHKA B — Part 2. Describe a gift that you gave someone which made them very happy. You should say: what the gift was, who you gave it to, why you chose it, and explain why it made them happy. Follow-up: Do you prefer giving gifts or receiving them?

KARTOCHKA B — Part 3. Why do people give gifts? / Are expensive gifts always better than cheap ones? / Has advertising made gift-giving too commercial? / What gift traditions are there in your country?

KARTOCHKA C — Part 1. Home: Do you live in a house or a flat? / Which room do you spend most time in? / Would you like to change anything about your home? Birthdays: How do you usually celebrate your birthday? / Which birthday do you remember best? / Are birthdays more important for children or adults?

KARTOCHKA C — Part 2. Describe an old friend that you would like to see again. You should say: who this person is, how you met, why you lost touch, and explain why you would like to see him or her again. Follow-up: Have you tried to find this friend online?

KARTOCHKA C — Part 3. How do friendships change as people get older? / Can online friends be as close as real-life friends? / Why do people lose touch with old friends? / Is it important to have friends from different backgrounds?
why: Part 1 da javob 1 gap bo'lsa — 'Why?' yoki 'Can you give an example?' bilan kengaytiring; boshqa yordam bermang.
Part 2 da tayyorlanish va gapirishni taymer bilan o'lchang; 2:00 da muloyim to'xtating, keyin 1 ta follow-up savol.
Part 3 da fikrni chuqurlashtiring: 'Why do you think so?', 'Is that always true?'; mavzudan tashqariga chiqmang.
Kartochkalarni bir guruhda almashtirib ishlating (A, B, C, A ...), toki keyingi o'quvchi savollarni oldindan eshitmasin; 9-dars kartochkalari bu yerda ishlatilmaydi.
O'quvchi chiqqach 1–2 daqiqada S6_FULL bo'yicha 4 mezonga butun band qo'ying, S6_MOCK_BAND dan Speaking bandini oling va 1-mock bandi yoniga yozing (qaysi mezon o'sdi).
class_ex.note: Mavzular: IELTS Speaking Part 1–3 umumiy turlari; kartochka matni — Jony Academy original materiali. Proyektorga faqat items (tartib) chiqadi.

homework_intro: Mock sessiyasida to'liq imtihonni topshirdingiz, bugun sinfda natijani Mock 1 bilan solishtirdik, javoblar varaqasini savol-savol o'qidik va Writing izohini ko'rdik. Uyda xuddi shu ishni HAMMA xato bo'yicha oxirigacha qilasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — xatolar daftari: har xato uchun oltita ustun — savol raqami, sizning javobingiz, to'g'ri javob, savol turi, sabab raqami (1–7) va qaytiladigan dars. Oxirida har sabab va har tur necha marta chiqqanini sanang.

Ikkinchi vazifa — ikki haftalik reja: eng katta ikki naqsh bo'yicha 6 qator; har qatorda qaysi dars, qancha mashq, qaysi kun va kim tekshiradi. 9-darsdagi rejaning bajarilmagan qatori hali kerak bo'lsa, uni ham kiriting.

Uchinchi vazifa — eng zaif savol turi bo'yicha YANGI material: Reading uchun 30-Day Reading Challenge'dagi shu turdagi hali ishlanmagan passage, Listening uchun JonyOS mock bazasidagi mos Section (raqamini ustoz beradi). Vaqt bilan ishlang, har javob yonida isbot gap bo'lsin. Darsdagi Practice'larni qayta ishlamang — ularning javoblari sizga allaqachon ma'lum.
To'rtinchi vazifa — Writing: AI izohi bo'yicha Task 2 dagi eng past mezon uchun Task 2 dan bitta body xatboshini qayta yozing; xatolar ro'yxatidan yana 5 ta xatoni tuzating.

Beshinchi vazifa — Speaking intervyusi: administrator mock haftasidagi jadvalni guruh chatiga yuboradi — o'z 15 daqiqalik slotingizga 5 daqiqa oldin keling; tayyorgarlik uchun uchta Part 2 turini (a person / an object / a problem) uyda ovozli yozib yuboring.

homework.title: Xatolar daftari: sabab + savol turi + dars
homework.instr: Har xato: savol raqami — javobim — to'g'ri javob — savol turi — sabab (1–7) — qaytiladigan dars. Oxirida sanash.
homework.answers: Keyingi dars boshida ustoz sanoqni tekshiradi; eng ko'p chiqqan ikki tur rejadagi ikki qator bilan bir xil bo'lishi shart.

homework.title: Ikki haftalik reja
homework.instr: 6 qator: dars raqami, mashq miqdori, kun, tekshiruvchi. Masalan: "Sentence endings: 16-dars strategiyasi + har kuni 1 ta yangi passage, 17 daqiqa" (imtihonda 20 daqiqa; uyda 3 daqiqa zaxira bilan). 9-darsdagi rejaning bajarilmagan, hali kerakli qatori ham kiritiladi.
homework.answers: Reja ustoz tomonidan imzolanadi; ikki haftadan keyin shu turdagi xatolar soni qayta sanaladi.

homework.title: Eng zaif tur: yangi passage yoki Section
homework.instr: Xaritadan topilgan darsning strategiyasini takrorlang, keyin shu turdagi YANGI materialni vaqt bilan bajaring: Reading — 30-Day Reading Challenge'dagi hali ishlanmagan passage, Listening — JonyOS mock bazasidagi mos Section (raqamini ustoz beradi); har javob yonida isbot.
homework.answers: Maqsad: shu turda 80% dan yuqori natija.

homework.title: Writing: bitta xatboshini qayta yozish
homework.instr: AI izohi bo'yicha Task 2 dagi eng past mezonni tanlang (5-mashq, 2-qadam) va Task 2 dan bitta body xatboshini shu mezon bo'yicha qayta yozing; xatolar ro'yxatidan yana 5 ta xatoni tuzating (to'g'ri shakli + grammatika yoki lug'at).
homework.answers: Ustoz eski va yangi xatboshini yonma-yon ko'radi: eng past mezon bo'yicha o'zgarish ko'rinishi va 5 ta tuzatish to'g'ri bo'lishi shart.

homework.title: Speaking (og'zaki): mock oldidan Part 2 mashqi
homework.instr: Uchta umumiy tur — a person, an object, a problem: har biriga 1 daqiqa reja (qog'ozga 5–6 kalit so'z) + 2 daqiqa ovozli yozuv, ilovaga yuboring.
items: A person: Describe a teacher who has had a strong influence on you. You should say: who this teacher is, what subject they taught, how they taught it, and explain why they influenced you.
An object: Describe something you own that you would never sell. You should say: what it is, how you got it, how often you use it, and explain why it is so important to you.
A problem: Describe a problem you solved together with other people. You should say: what the problem was, who helped you, how you solved it, and explain what you learned from it.
homework.answers: Ustoz S6_FULL (sinfdagi rubrika) bo'yicha 4 mezonga band qo'yadi; tekshiruv: har yozuv 1:40–2:00 to'xtovsiz, kartochkadagi 4 band yoritilgan, kamida 2 murakkab gap (because/which/if) va 1 ta o'tgan zamon hikoyasi.
homework.note: Mock kartochkalari A/B/C oshkor qilinmaydi — bu uch tur faqat umumiy mashq uchun (Jony Academy original kartochkalari).

normativ: har xatoga sabab (1–7), savol turi va dars; Writing: 5 ta tuzatish va 1 xatboshi qayta yozilgan
6 qator, raqam va kun bilan, imzolangan
yangi passage yoki Section, vaqt bilan, isbot bilan
slotga kelish, uch qism to'liq; 1-mockdan kamida 1 mezonda +1 yoki Speaking bandida +0.5, yoki 6.0+

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (1): Task 1 bilan tanishuv va 4 baholash mezoni
lessons.grammar_topic: Academic Writing Task 1: talablar (150 so'z, 20 daqiqa), savol turlari va examiner baholaydigan 4 mezon
lessons.vocab_topic: Task 1 tili: grafik, jadval, jarayon va xaritani tasvirlash uchun asosiy so'zlar
lessons.book_ref: Ustoz bergan slaydlar: "Mastering IELTS Writing: Task 1 (Academic)", 1–14-slaydlar (Section 1: General Overview).
objectives: Task 1 ning asosiy talablarini bilish: kamida 150 so'z, 20 daqiqa, Task 2 ning yarmicha ball, fikr emas — ma'lumotni tasvirlash.
Task 1 savolini ko'rib, turini aniqlash: grafik (line, bar, pie), jadval, jarayon (process) yoki xarita (map); bir nechta grafik ham bo'lishi mumkin.
Examiner baholaydigan 4 mezonni o'z so'zi bilan tushuntira olish: Task Achievement, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy.
Band 7 uchun har mezonda nima kerakligini bilish — ayniqsa aniq OVERVIEW (umumiy tendensiya) va asosiy xususiyatlarni tanlash.
Namuna javobda har mezon qayerda ko'rinishini topa olish.
materials: Slaydlar 1–14 (quyidagi Reading bo'limida ikki rasm) — proyektorda ko'rsatiladi.
Namuna javob (Jony Academy) va uning jadvali — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan, to'rt rangli marker bilan (har mezonga bitta rang).
Doskada to'rt ustun: TA — CC — LR — GRA; dars davomida har ustunga misollar yozib boriladi.
Soat: Task 1 uchun 20 daqiqa normasi doskaga yoziladi.
timeline: Kirish
Savol: "Task 2 ni bilasiz. Task 1 undan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?" — javoblar doskaga.
Task 1 nima? (slaydlar 1–3)
150 so'z, 20 daqiqa, yarim ball, grafik / jadval / jarayon / xarita. O'quvchilar daftarga 5 ta asosiy faktni yozadi.
To'rt misol (slaydlar 4–7)
Har misolda: bu qaysi tur? vaqt bormi? nimani solishtirish kerak? (1-mashq bilan birga).
To'rt mezon (slaydlar 8–13)
Har mezon: rasmiy talab → "boshqacha aytganda" → bitta tipik xato. Doskadagi to'rt ustun to'ldiriladi.
Band descriptor xulosasi (slayd 14)
O'quvchilar har mezondan bittadan eng muhim talabni tanlab aytadi. W6_T1_FULL jadvali ekranda (class_ex: 0–9 rubrika), keyin W6_T1_CLASS — sinf rubrikasi (band 5–7).
Namuna javob tahlili
Jony Academy namunasi o'qiladi; o'quvchilar to'rt rang bilan mezonlarni belgilaydi.
Sinf mashqlari
2-mashq (qaysi mezon?) va 3-mashq (Task 1 da nima bo'lmaydi?).
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: jadval bo'yicha kirish + overview va mezonlar ro'yxati bilan o'z-o'zini tekshirish.

intro: Academic Writing Task 1 — grafik, jadval, jarayon yoki xarita berilgan qisqa hisobot. Kamida 150 so'z, tavsiya etilgan vaqt 20 daqiqa. Task 2 ikki barobar ko'p ball beradi, shuning uchun Task 1 ga 20 daqiqadan ortiq vaqt sarflamang.

Savol har doim bir xil ko'rsatma bilan tugaydi: "Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant." Ya'ni uchta ish: 1) ASOSIY xususiyatlarni TANLASH (hamma raqamni emas); 2) ularni tasvirlash; 3) solishtirish.
To'rt tur: grafik (line, bar, pie), jadval, jarayon (process) va xarita (map). Ba'zan ikkita grafik yoki grafik + jadval birga beriladi (slayd 4 dagi Yaman va Italiya pie chartlari).
Task 1 da FIKR yo'q: "I think", "in my opinion", sabab va taxminlar ("because people are lazier now") yozilmaydi. Faqat ko'rsatilgan ma'lumot.
TASK ACHIEVEMENT: savoldagi hamma narsani qamrash, aniq OVERVIEW (umumiy tendensiya yoki eng katta farq) va asosiy xususiyatlarni aniq tasvirlash. Overview'siz javob odatda Band 5 dan oshmaydi.
COHERENCE AND COHESION: mantiqiy tartib (kirish → overview → tafsilotlar) va bog'lovchilar (however, whereas, by contrast, at this point) — lekin ortiqcha emas.
LEXICAL RESOURCE: sinonimlar va aniqlik ("nice" emas, "a sharp rise"), kollokatsiyalar ("rise sharply", "a slight fall"). Bir so'zni takrorlamaslik uchun paraphrase.

GRAMMATICAL RANGE AND ACCURACY: oddiy va murakkab gaplar aralash. Band 7 uchun (slayd 13 dagi rasmiy iqtiboslar): turli murakkab tuzilmalar ishlatiladi ("a variety of complex structures"), xatosiz gaplar tez-tez uchraydi ("frequent error-free sentences"), grammatika va tinish belgilari yaxshi nazoratda, bir nechta xato bo'lishi mumkin. "Gaplarning ko'pchiligi xatosiz" — bu Band 8 talabi. Slayd 13–14 dagi "more than 50%" / "+50% sentence accuracy" — soddalashtirilgan maslahat, rasmiy Band 7 mezoni emas.
formulas: Hammasini qamrash, aniq overview, asosiy xususiyatlar
"Overall, TV viewing fell sharply, while social media became the most popular activity."
Overview yo'q; hamma raqamni ketma-ket sanash
"The number is big", bir so'zni 5 marta takrorlash
"..., which was three times the figure for social media"
presentation: 150 so'zdan ko'p yozsam ball oshadimi?
Yo'q. 160–190 so'z yetarli. Uzunroq javob — ko'proq xato ehtimoli va Task 2 ga kam vaqt.
Hamma raqamni yozishim kerakmi?
Yo'q. "Selecting" — tanlash. Eng katta, eng kichik, eng ko'p o'zgargan va istisnolarni yozing.
Xulosa (conclusion) yozamanmi?
Task 1 da overview yetarli. Fikrli xulosa yozmang.
Nega bunday bo'lganini tushuntirsam-chi?
Kerak emas va xato: grafikda sabab ko'rsatilmagan. Bu Task Achievement ni pasaytiradi.
Overview qayerda turadi?
Odatda kirishdan keyin, ikkinchi xatboshida — examiner uni darhol ko'radi (keyingi darsda batafsil).
Qaysi mezon eng muhim?
To'rttasi teng (har biri 25%). Lekin Task 1 da eng ko'p ball overview va tanlash (Task Achievement) da yo'qotiladi.
notes: Bu dars — Writing Task 1 turkumining kirishi. Slaydlar ingliz tilida; har slayddan keyin o'quvchi o'z so'zi bilan o'zbekcha yoki inglizcha qayta aytsin.
To'rt mezonni devorga ilib qo'ying — keyingi Writing darslarida har tekshiruv shu to'rt ustun bo'yicha bo'ladi.
Namuna javobdagi ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan; o'quvchilarga buni aytib qo'ying.

Task 1 bloki 7 darsdan iborat: 19 — Task 1 va to'rt mezon; 20 — 4 savol turi, formula va reja; 21 — Line graph; 22 — Bar chart; 23 — Pie chart + Table; 24 — Process diagram; 25 — Map. 21–25 da har darsda Band 6.5 namuna, til banki va 20 daqiqalik WRITING NORMATIV bor.

how: CORE — Task 1 ning har javobida keladigan so'zlar; STRONG — solishtirish va o'zgarish; SUPER — Band 7 uchun aniq iboralar.
Har so'z bilan namuna jadval (quyida) haqida bitta gap tuzing.
core: The table illustrates how young people spent their free time.
Jadval yoshlar bo'sh vaqtini qanday o'tkazganini ko'rsatadi.
The table compares four leisure activities.
The figure for social media more than tripled.
Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ko'rsatkichi uch baravardan ko'proq oshdi.
A large proportion of students chose sport.
Umuman olganda, televizor kamroq mashhur bo'ldi.
TV viewing fell, whereas social media use rose.
Televizor ko'rish kamaydi, ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan foydalanish esa oshdi.
The figures for sport in 2015 and 2025 were 5 and 6 hours respectively.
Sport ko'rsatkichlari 2015 va 2025 yillarda mos ravishda 5 va 6 soat edi.
Over the period, sport changed little.
Bu davr mobaynida sport kam o'zgardi.
strong: The figure for sport rose slightly, from 5 to 6 hours.
Sport ko'rsatkichi biroz oshdi, 5 dan 6 soatga.
By contrast, reading became less common.
By 2025, social media had overtaken television.
2025 yilga kelib ijtimoiy tarmoqlar televizorni quvib o'tgan edi.
Kitob o'qish kichik mashg'ulot bo'lib qoldi.
Reading was the least popular pastime.
Kitob o'qish eng kam mashhur mashg'ulot edi.
super: Internetdagi vaqt uch baravardan ko'proq oshdi.
The most striking change was the fall in TV viewing.
Eng ko'zga tashlanadigan o'zgarish — televizor ko'rishning kamayishi.
In 2015, TV viewing was three times the figure for social media.
2015 yilda televizor ko'rish ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ko'rsatkichidan uch barobar ko'p edi.
There was a reversal in the popularity of TV and social media.
Televizor va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar mashhurligida teskari o'zgarish bo'ldi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Bu qaysi tur? Vaqt bormi?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz savol boshini o'qiydi. O'quvchilar ayting: 1) turi (line / bar / pie / table / process / map); 2) vaqt o'zgarishi bormi; 3) asosan nimani solishtirish kerak.
items: The graph shows the number of visitors to three museums in London between 2000 and 2020.
The pie charts give information about the ages of the populations of Yemen and Italy in 2000 and projections for 2050.
The table gives information about the underground railway systems in six cities.
The two maps show an island before and after the construction of some tourist facilities.
The diagrams show the stages and equipment used in the cement-making process.
The bar chart compares the average monthly rainfall in four cities.
answers: line graph — vaqt bor; muzeylar o'zgarishi va solishtiruvi
pie chart (bir nechta) — vaqt bor (2000 → 2050); yosh guruhlari ulushi, ikki davlat
table — vaqt yo'q; shaharlar orasidagi farq
map — "oldin va keyin"; nima qo'shildi, nima o'zgardi
process — vaqt emas, BOSQICHLAR; boshi va oxiri
bar chart — vaqt yo'q; shaharlar orasidagi farq
why: "between 2000 and 2020" — vaqt oralig'i, line graph odatiy.
Slayd 4 dagi misol. Ikki davlat + ikki yil = to'rtta pie; solishtirish ikki yo'nalishda.
Slayd 5 dagi misol. Raqamlar ustunlarda; eng katta va eng kichikni tanlash kerak.
Slayd 6 dagi misol. Xaritada — joylashuv va o'zgarish tili (was built, was replaced).
Slayd 7 dagi misol. Jarayonda passiv (is heated, is mixed) va bosqich bog'lovchilari.
Vaqt yo'q — o'sish/kamayish emas, solishtirish tili (higher than, the lowest).

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Bu xato qaysi mezonga ta'sir qiladi?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz xatoni o'qiydi. O'quvchi mezonni aytadi (TA / CC / LR / GRA) va qanday tuzatishni aytadi.
items: Javobda umumiy tendensiya (overview) yo'q.
"The number of people was very big and it was nice."
"In 2015 young people watches TV 12 hours."
Hamma gap "Also, ..." bilan boshlanadi.
"I think young people are lazy now, so they use social media."
Javob faqat qisqa oddiy gaplardan iborat, bitta ham murakkab gap yo'q.
Oxirgi yildagi ma'lumot umuman tilga olinmagan.
Xatboshilar yo'q — butun javob bitta blok.
why: Overview — Task Achievement ning asosiy talabi.
"very big", "nice" — aniq emas; "a significant number", "the highest figure".
Zamon va moslashuv: "watched"; raqamdan keyin "hours a week".
Bog'lovchilar xilma-xil va o'rinli bo'lishi kerak: however, whereas, by contrast.
Fikr va sabab — Task 1 talabiga zid.
Band 7 uchun "a variety of complex structures" kerak.
"Covers all requirements" — hamma asosiy ma'lumotni qamrash.
Xatboshilar mantiqiy tartibni ko'rsatadi (kirish → overview → tafsilot).

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Task 1 da bu gap o'rinlimi?
class_ex.instr: Har gapga "ha" yoki "yo'q" deng va sababini ayting.
items: "Overall, the most striking change was the fall in television viewing."
"In my opinion, social media is dangerous for teenagers."
"This is probably because smartphones became cheaper."
"Reading was the least popular pastime in both years."
"To sum up, I believe people should read more books."
"Time spent on sport rose slightly, from 5 to 6 hours."
why: Overview — asosiy tendensiya, raqamsiz.
Fikr — Task 1 da so'ralmaydi.
Sabab grafikda yo'q — taxmin.
Solishtirish va asosiy xususiyat.
Fikrli xulosa — Task 2 uslubi.
Aniq tafsilot raqam bilan.

class_ex.title: Writing Task 1 rubrikasi — IELTS band 0–9 (4 mezon)
class_ex.instr: Jadvalni ekranga chiqaring: har mezon bo'yicha Band 5, 6 va 7 qatorlarini solishtiring; har mezondan bittadan eng muhim talabni tanlang.
head: Band
Task Achievement — topshiriq bajarilishi
Coherence & Cohesion — izchillik va bog'liqlik
Lexical Resource — lug'at
Grammatical Range & Accuracy — grammatika
rows: Barcha talablar to'liq; asosiy xususiyatlar mohirona tanlangan va aniq ko'rsatilgan.
Keng, aniq, tabiiy lug'at; xato juda kam ('slip').
Keng tuzilmalar to'liq moslashuvchan va aniq; xato juda kam.
Barcha talablar qamrab olingan; asosiy xususiyatlar aniq va yaxshi ko'rsatilgan.
Ma'lumot mantiqiy ketma-ket; bog'lash usullari yaxshi; xatboshilash o'rinli.
Keng lug'at ravon, aniq ma'no; ba'zan kollokatsiya/imlo xatosi.
Keng tuzilmalar; gaplarning ko'pchiligi xatosiz, xatolar kam.
Talablar qamrab olingan; asosiy trend/farq/bosqichlarning ANIQ overview'i; asosiy xususiyatlar aniq, lekin yanada kengaytirilishi mumkin.
Mantiqiy tartib, aniq rivojlanish; bog'lovchilar o'rinli (ba'zan ortiqcha yoki kam).
Moslashuvchan lug'at; kam uchraydigan so'zlar, kollokatsiyaga e'tibor; ba'zan so'z tanlash/imlo xatosi.
Murakkab tuzilmalar xilma-xil; xatosiz gaplar tez-tez uchraydi; tinish va grammatika yaxshi nazoratda, bir nechta xato bo'lishi mumkin.
Talablarga javob beradi, ma'lumot o'rinli tanlangan; overview bor; asosiy xususiyatlar yetarli, lekin ayrim detallar ahamiyatsiz, noo'rin yoki NOANIQ.
Ma'lumot izchil, umumiy rivojlanish bor; bog'lovchilar samarali, lekin ba'zan mexanik yoki xato; it/this havolasi har doim aniq emas.
Topshiriq uchun yetarli lug'at; kam uchraydigan so'zga urinadi, ba'zan noaniq; imlo xatolari bor, lekin ma'no tushunarli.
Oddiy va murakkab gaplar aralash; grammatika/tinishda xatolar bor, kamdan-kam tushunishni qiyinlashtiradi.

readings.title: NAMUNA JAVOB — to'rt mezon qayerda ko'rinadi
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (171 so'z; ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The table below shows the average number of hours per week that young people in one city spent on four leisure activities in 2015 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
text: The table compares the average number of hours per week that young people in one city spent on four leisure activities in 2015 and 2025.

Overall, the most striking change was a reversal in the popularity of television and social media: watching TV fell sharply, while social media became by far the most time-consuming activity. By contrast, the time given to sport and reading changed very little.

In 2015, young people spent 12 hours a week watching television, which was three times the figure for social media (4 hours). Over the following decade, however, television viewing dropped to just 5 hours, whereas time on social media more than tripled to 14 hours, overtaking every other activity.

Time spent on sport rose slightly, from 5 to 6 hours, and by 2025 it was second only to social media, having overtaken television. Reading remained a minor activity: it was the least popular pastime throughout, falling from 3 hours to only 2 hours a week, the lowest figure in the table for either year.
paraphrases: the figure for, time given to, time spent on
three times the figure for, whereas, by contrast

homework_intro: Bugun Task 1 nima ekanini va examiner qaysi to'rt narsaga qarashini bildik. Uyda birinchi marta o'zingiz kirish va overview yozasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — quyidagi jadval uchun kirish (1 gap) va overview (2 gap) yozing: "The table shows the percentage of households in one town that owned four devices in 2005 and 2025: landline phone 90% → 30%; laptop 25% → 80%; smartphone 5% → 95%; DVD player 60% → 10%." 10 daqiqa.
Ikkinchi vazifa — yozganingizni to'rt mezon bo'yicha o'zingiz tekshiring: overview bormi (TA)? savol so'zlari ko'chirilmaganmi (LR)? bog'lovchi bormi (CC)? zamon to'g'rimi (GRA)?
Uchinchi vazifa — CORE va STRONG so'zlardan 8 tasi bilan namuna jadval haqida 8 gap.
21-darsdan boshlab har darsda bitta grafik turi chuqur o'rganiladi va to'liq 150+ so'zlik javob yoziladi.

homework.title: Kirish + overview (qurilmalar jadvali)
homework.instr: 1 gap kirish (paraphrase), 2 gap overview (raqamsiz). 10 daqiqa.
homework.answers: Namuna: "The table compares the proportion of households in a town that owned four types of device in 2005 and 2025. Overall, by the end of the period, smartphones had become almost universal and laptops were owned by a large majority of households, while ownership of landline phones and DVD players had fallen dramatically. Smartphone ownership saw the greatest change of all."

homework.answers: Ustoz keyingi darsda ikki o'quvchining tekshiruvini sinf bilan solishtiradi.

kahoot.q: How long must an Academic Writing Task 1 answer be?
kahoot.explain: Task 1 — kamida 150 so'z; 250 so'z Task 2 ning talabi.

kahoot.q: About how long should you spend on Writing Task 1 in the exam?
kahoot.explain: Writing jami 60 daqiqa: Task 1 ga taxminan 20, Task 2 ga 40 daqiqa — Task 2 ikki barobar ko'p ball beradi.

kahoot.q: 'The diagram shows how recycled paper is produced.' Which type of Task 1 is this?
kahoot.explain: "How ... is produced" — vaqt emas, bosqichlar ketma-ketligi, ya'ni jarayon (process).

kahoot.q: The task says 'Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features'. What does 'selecting' mean?
kahoot.explain: "Selecting" — hamma raqamni emas, eng muhim xususiyatlarni (eng katta, eng kichik, eng katta o'zgarish) tanlash.

kahoot.q: A line graph shows how people travelled to work. Which sentence is the best overview?
options: Overall, car use rose steadily, while cycling declined sharply.
In 2010, 45% of commuters drove and only 12% cycled to work.
The line graph shows how people travelled to work in a city.
I believe that more commuters should cycle to work every day.
kahoot.explain: Overview — umumiy tendensiya, aniq raqamsiz; raqamli gap tafsilot, savolni takrorlash kirish, fikr esa Task 1 da yozilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Which of these should NOT appear in a Task 1 answer?
kahoot.explain: Task 1 da faqat berilgan ma'lumot tasvirlanadi; sabab va taxmin grafikda yo'q, ular Task Achievement ni pasaytiradi.

kahoot.q: An answer contains 'recieve' and 'goverment'. Which criterion do these spelling errors affect?
kahoot.explain: Imlo va so'z yasalishi xatolari Lexical Resource mezoniga kiradi ("spelling and word formation").

kahoot.q: An answer says 40% where the chart shows 30%. Which criterion suffers most?
kahoot.explain: Ma'lumotni aniq berish — Task Achievement talabi ("accurately represented"); noto'g'ri raqam shu mezonni pasaytiradi.

kahoot.q: An answer uses 'it' and 'this' so often that the reader cannot tell what they refer to. Which criterion is affected?
kahoot.explain: "It, this, these" — bog'lash vositalari (referencing); noaniq ishlatilsa Coherence and Cohesion pasayadi.

kahoot.q: Which description matches Band 7 for Grammatical Range and Accuracy?
kahoot.explain: Band 7: "frequent error-free sentences"; "the majority of sentences are error-free" — bu Band 8 ta'rifi.

kahoot.q: If you copy words directly from the question, are they counted in your 150 words?
kahoot.explain: Savoldan so'zma-so'z ko'chirilgan qism so'z soniga kirmaydi — kirishni o'z so'zingiz bilan yozing.

kahoot.q: Question: 'The chart shows the percentage of adults who smoked.' Which introduction is best?
options: The chart illustrates the proportion of adult smokers.
The chart shows the percentage of adults who smoked.
The chart proves that smoking is harmful to all adults.
In this essay I will describe a chart about smoking.
kahoot.explain: Kirish — savolning paraphrase'i: shows → illustrates, percentage → proportion; ko'chirish, fikr va "essay" iborasi yaramaydi.

kahoot.q: In a Task 1 answer, 'The graph illustrates...' is closest in meaning to 'The graph ___...'
kahoot.explain: Illustrate — ko'rsatmoq, tasvirlamoq; grafik bahslashmaydi va inkor qilmaydi.

kahoot.q: In which phrase is 'increase' stressed on the FIRST syllable (IN-crease)?
kahoot.explain: Ot bo'lsa urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda (ˈɪnkriːs), fe'l bo'lsa ikkinchisida (ɪnˈkriːs); "a sharp increase" — ot.

kahoot.q: 'Sales in May and June were 40 and 55 units respectively.' What were the sales in June?
kahoot.explain: Respectively — mos ravishda: birinchi raqam birinchi oyga (May), ikkinchisi ikkinchi oyga (June) tegishli.

kahoot.q: 'By 2020, online sales had overtaken shop sales.' This means online sales ___.
kahoot.explain: Overtake — quvib o'tmoq: oldin pastroq edi, endi yuqoriroq; bunga ikkinchisining kamayishi ham sabab bo'lishi mumkin.

kahoot.q: Which adverb best describes a rise from 50% to 52%?
kahoot.explain: 50% dan 52% ga — atigi 2 foiz punktlik kichik o'zgarish, shuning uchun "slightly"; qolgan uchtasi katta o'zgarish uchun.

kahoot.q: Prices were £5 in 2010 and £5 in 2020. Which sentence is correct?
kahoot.explain: Remain — bog'lovchi fe'l: undan keyin ravish yoki fe'l emas, sifat (stable) yoki ot birikmasi (a minor activity) keladi; passivda ishlatilmaydi ("were remained" noto'g'ri).

kahoot.q: 'Chess is a popular pastime in Uzbekistan.' What is a 'pastime'?
kahoot.explain: Pastime — bo'sh vaqtda zavq uchun qilinadigan mashg'ulot (hobby); "past" so'zi bilan adashtirmang.

kahoot.q: 'There was a reversal in the popularity of tea and coffee.' What happened?
options: Both fell by the same amount
kahoot.explain: Reversal — teskari o'zgarish: oldin ko'proq bo'lgani kamroq bo'ldi va aksincha.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (2): 4 savol turi, 4 xatboshili formula va reja
lessons.grammar_topic: Task 1 ning 4 savol turi (vaqtli grafik, solishtirma grafik, jarayon, xarita), har savolga yaroqli 4 xatboshili formula va 1–2 daqiqalik reja
lessons.vocab_topic: Tendensiya tili: rise, fall, peak, remain stable, fluctuate + ravishlar (sharply, steadily, slightly)
lessons.book_ref: Ustoz bergan slaydlar: "Mastering IELTS Writing: Task 1 (Academic)", 15–20-slaydlar (Section 2: Approaching the response); 21–47-slaydlar mazmuni (reja, asosiy trend, ma'lumot tanlash, aniqlik) 21–25-darslarda o'z so'zlarimiz bilan beriladi.
objectives: Task 1 savolini 4 turdan biriga ajratish: vaqt o'zgarishi bor grafik, vaqtsiz solishtirma grafik, jarayon, xarita.
Har savol turiga yaroqli 4 xatboshili formulani qo'llash: 1) kirish, 2) overview, 3) birinchi guruh tafsilotlar, 4) ikkinchi guruh tafsilotlar.
Overview va summary farqini bilish: ikkalasini ham yozmaslik, lekin bittasini albatta yozish — overview ikkinchi xatboshida.
Ma'lumotlarni 3- va 4-xatboshiga mantiqiy GURUHLASH: o'xshash tendensiya, kategoriya, bosqich yoki xarita qismi bo'yicha.
1–2 daqiqada qisqa belgilar bilan reja tuzish (↑ ↓ ++ →) va rejadan to'liq javob yozish.
materials: Slaydlar 15–20 (quyidagi Reading bo'limida) — proyektorda.
Jony Academy line graph'i (sport turlari, 2010–2020) — chop etilgan yoki ekranda.
Doskada formula: PARA 1 Introduction / PARA 2 Overview / PARA 3 Key details (1) / PARA 4 Key details (2).
Doskada belgilar lug'ati: ↑ oshdi, ↓ kamaydi, ++ yuqori va barqaror, → keyin, ≈ o'zgarmadi, pk cho'qqi.
Taymer: har reja uchun 2 daqiqa.

19-dars slaydlari 4–7 (to'rt misol: pie charts, table, maps, process; 19-dars rejasidagi "Slaydlar 1–7" rasmi) — "Taymer: uchta reja" bosqichida ekranda; 2-uy vazifasi uchun shu rasmni guruh chatiga yuboring.
timeline: Takrorlash
19-dars: to'rt mezon va overview nima uchun kerak — 3 savol bilan; 19-dars so'zlari takrori: by contrast, overtake, respectively.
4 savol turi (slaydlar 15–16)
Vaqtli grafik, solishtirma grafik, jarayon, xarita; har biriga qanday til kerak (1-mashq).
Formula (slayd 17)
4 xatboshi; overview yoki summary — ikkalasi emas, bittasi albatta; nega overview ikkinchi xatboshida.
Nega reja kerak (slaydlar 18–20)
Reja vaqt tejaydi; slayd 20 dagi belgilarni birga "ochish" (3-mashq).
Namuna: grafik → reja → javob

Jony Academy line graph'i; ustoz doskada reja tuzadi; namuna javob o'qiladi, xatboshilar formula bilan solishtiriladi. Namuna javob class_ex oxiridagi rubrika (W6_T1_CLASS) bo'yicha 4 mezonga band bilan baholanadi.
Sinf mashqlari
2-mashq (guruhlash) va 4-mashq (xatboshilarni tartiblash).
Taymer: uchta reja
19-dars slaydlari 4–7 dagi to'rt misoldan uchtasi uchun har biriga 2 daqiqada reja; juftlik solishtiradi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: berilgan ma'lumotdan to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa. Keyingi 5 dars — har grafik turi alohida: 21 Line graph, 22 Bar chart, 23 Pie chart + Table, 24 Process diagram, 25 Map.

intro: Task 1 savollari 4 turga bo'linadi (slayd 16): 1) VAQTLI GRAFIK — yillar yoki oylar bo'yicha o'zgarish (line graph, ba'zan bar/table); 2) SOLISHTIRMA GRAFIK — vaqt yo'q, faqat kategoriyalar farqi (pie, bar, table); 3) JARAYON (process) — bosqichlar; 4) XARITA (map) — joy va o'zgarish.

Tur tilni belgilaydi: vaqtli grafikda o'zgarish tili (rose, fell, peaked, remained stable); solishtirmada solishtirish tili (higher than, twice as many, the largest proportion); jarayonda passiv va ketma-ketlik (is heated, after that, finally); xaritada joylashuv va o'zgarish (was built, was replaced, to the north of).

FORMULA (slayd 17) — Task 2 dan farqli, har qanday Task 1 savoliga bir xil: PARA 1 — kirish (savolni paraphrase qilish, 1 gap); PARA 2 — overview (eng muhim 2 ta umumiy xususiyat, raqamsiz); PARA 3 — birinchi guruh tafsilotlar; PARA 4 — ikkinchi guruh tafsilotlar.

Overview yoki summary: oxirida summary yozish ham mumkin, lekin ikkita qoida bor — IKKALASINI HECH QACHON yozmang, BITTASINI HAR DOIM yozing. Biz overview'ni ikkinchi xatboshida yozamiz: examiner eng muhim Task Achievement talabini birinchi qatorlardayoq ko'radi.
Overview uchun savol: "Agar grafikni 5 soniya ko'rsam, nimani eslab qolaman?" — eng katta/eng kichik, asosiy tendensiya (oshdi/kamaydi), eng katta o'zgarish, umumiy naqsh.

GURUHLASH — 3- va 4-xatboshining sifati: o'xshash tendensiyalar birga (oshganlar / kamayganlar), yoki yuqori va past kategoriyalar, yoki jarayonning birinchi va ikkinchi yarmi, yoki xaritaning shimoli va janubi. Har chiziqqa alohida xatboshi — xato.
REJA (slaydlar 18–20) 1–2 daqiqa: turini aniqlang → overview uchun 2 ta asosiy fikrni belgilar bilan yozing → P3 va P4 guruhlarini belgilang. Reja faqat siz uchun: "R↑ // F++ // B, S ↑→↓" yetarli.
Vaqt: 2 daqiqa reja + 15 daqiqa yozish + 3 daqiqa tekshirish = 20 daqiqa.
formulas: "The line graph illustrates how many students ... took part in four sports between 2010 and 2020."
"Overall, football was the most popular sport throughout..., whereas basketball and swimming rose at first but then declined."
presentation: Summary va overview farqi nima?
Overview — ikkinchi xatboshida umumiy tendensiya; summary — oxirida xuddi shunday xulosa. Bittasi yetarli, ikkalasi takror.
Kirish necha gap?
Bitta gap yetarli: savolni paraphrase qiling (shows → illustrates / compares; between 2010 and 2020 → over a ten-year period).
Guruhni qanday tanlayman?
O'xshash tendensiyali ma'lumotlarni birga qo'ying. Rejada doira bilan belgilang.
Reja yozishga vaqt yo'q-ku?
Reja vaqtni tejaydi: 2 daqiqa rejasiz yozilgan javob ko'pincha 5 daqiqa qayta yozishga olib keladi.
Jarayon va xaritada ham shu formula?
Ha. Jarayonda P3 — birinchi yarim bosqichlar, P4 — ikkinchi yarim; xaritada P3 — nima o'zgardi, P4 — nima qo'shildi yoki boshqa qism.
Hamma raqamni yozamanmi?
Yo'q. Boshlanish, oxir, cho'qqi va eng katta farqlar yetarli.
notes: Slayd 20 dagi rejani o'quvchilar "Umm... what?!" deb qabul qiladi — maqsad shu: reja faqat yozuvchi uchun. 3-mashqda belgilarni birga gapga aylantiring.
Uy vazifasi va keyingi Writing darslaridagi (21–25: har grafik turi alohida) har Task 1 javobi shu formula bo'yicha tekshiriladi: 4 xatboshi, overview ikkinchi o'rinda, guruhlash mantiqiy.
Namuna grafikdagi ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan.

how: CORE — o'zgarish fe'llari; STRONG — ravishlar va otlar; SUPER — Band 7 iboralari.
Namuna grafikdagi har chiziq uchun CORE fe'l + STRONG ravish bilan bitta gap tuzing.
Takror (19-darsdan, yangi so'z sifatida sanalmaydi): by contrast, overtake, respectively — namuna javobda va uy vazifasida qayta ishlatiladi.
core: Running rose steadily throughout the decade.
Yugurish o'n yil davomida bir tekis oshdi.
Ikkala sport ham 2016 dan keyin pasaydi.
Football was the most popular throughout the period.
Futbol butun davr bo'yi eng mashhur edi.
strong: Yugurish har yili bir tekis o'sdi.
super: Basketball and swimming followed a similar pattern.
Basketbol va suzish o'xshash naqshda o'zgardi.
Swimming fell, ending the decade at 120.
Suzish kamayib, o'n yillikni 120 bilan yakunladi.
After 2016, both basketball and swimming showed a clear downward trend.
2016 dan keyin basketbol va suzishda aniq pasayish tendensiyasi kuzatildi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: To'rt turdan qaysi biri? Qanday til kerak?
class_ex.instr: Har savolga: tur (vaqtli grafik / solishtirma grafik / jarayon / xarita) va asosiy til (o'zgarish / solishtirish / passiv + ketma-ketlik / joylashuv).
items: The graph shows car ownership in three countries from 1990 to 2020.
The pie chart shows how a university spent its budget in 2024.
The diagram shows how chocolate is produced.
The maps show a town centre in 1995 and today.
The bar chart shows the number of international students in five countries in 2022.
The table shows the monthly sales of three smartphone brands from January to June.
answers: solishtirma grafik — solishtirish tili (the largest proportion)
xarita — joylashuv va o'zgarish (was replaced, was built)
why: "from 1990 to 2020" — vaqt.
Bitta yil — vaqt o'zgarishi yo'q.
"how ... is produced" — bosqichlar.
Ikki davr xaritasi — nima o'zgargan.
Bitta yil, besh davlat — kategoriyalar farqi.
Oylar bo'yicha — jadval ham vaqtli bo'lishi mumkin. Turni jadval yoki grafik emas, VAQT belgilaydi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Guruhlash — P3 va P4 ga nima tushadi?
class_ex.instr: Har ma'lumotlar to'plami uchun P3 va P4 guruhini taklif qiling va sababini ayting.
items: Line graph, 4 chiziq: A va C oshgan, B va D kamaygan.
Pie chart: 6 ta xarajat turi — uchtasi katta (30%, 25%, 20%), uchtasi kichik (10%, 8%, 7%).
Process: 8 bosqich — 1–4 zavodda, 5–8 do'konda.
Map: shimoliy qismda park va maktab qurilgan, janubiy qismda fermalar uy-joyga aylangan.
Table: 6 shahar metrosi — ikkitasi eng eski va eng uzun, ikkitasi eng yangi va eng qisqa.

readings.source: Ustoz bergan slaydlar (Section 2: Approaching the response — Lecture 5, 7)

readings.title: NAMUNA: grafik → reja → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (158 so'z; grafik ma'lumotlari mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The graph below shows the number of students taking part in four sports at a university between 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA (2 daqiqa): O: F ++ (tepada, ≈) // R ↑↑ (90 → 400) // B, S ↑ → ↓ (pk 2016). P3: F + R. P4: B + S.
text: The line graph illustrates how many students at one university took part in four sports — football, running, basketball and swimming — between 2010 and 2020.

Overall, football was the most popular sport throughout the period and its numbers remained almost unchanged. Running showed the most dramatic growth, becoming nearly as popular as football by 2020, whereas basketball and swimming both rose at first but then declined sharply.

Football attracted around 420 students in 2010, and this figure stayed remarkably stable, finishing the decade at 445. Running, by contrast, began as the least popular activity, with only 90 participants, but it grew steadily every year, reaching 400 by 2020.

Basketball and swimming followed a very similar pattern. Participation in basketball climbed from 200 to a peak of 330 in 2016, and swimming rose from 150 to 260 over the same period. After 2016, however, both fell dramatically, ending the decade at 150 and 120 respectively, lower than their starting points.
glossary: throughout the period — butun davr bo'yi
paraphrases: the number of students taking part in
how many students ... took part in

homework_intro: Bugun har qanday Task 1 savoliga yaroqli formulani o'rgandik: kirish, overview, ikki guruh tafsilot — va 2 daqiqalik reja. Uyda birinchi to'liq javobingizni yozasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa (2 reja + 15 yozish + 3 tekshirish): "The graph shows the average price of a cinema ticket and a monthly streaming subscription in one country, 2014–2024: cinema £8 → £9 → £11 → £12 (2014, 2017, 2020, 2024); streaming £6 → £8 → £9 → £13." Grafik rasmi yo'q — avval shu raqamlardan daftarga oddiy line graph chizing, keyin rejani yozing, keyin 4 xatboshi.

Ikkinchi vazifa — 19-dars slaydlari 4–7 dagi to'rt misoldan ikkitasiga faqat REJA (2 daqiqadan): sinfda reja tuzilmagan misolga va sinfda sizga eng qiyin bo'lgan misolga — overview uchun 2 fikr va P3/P4 guruhlari.
Uchinchi vazifa — CORE fe'llar + STRONG ravishlar bilan sport grafigi haqida 6 gap (har sport uchun kamida bitta).

Topshirish: uchala vazifa keyingi (21-) darsgacha ustozga topshiriladi; 21-dars shu uy vazifasidagi overview'ni tekshirish bilan boshlanadi. Topshirishdan oldin o'zingizni tekshiring: 1) 4 xatboshi; 2) kirish — savolning paraphrase'i, 1 gap; 3) overview ikkinchi xatboshida va raqamsiz; 4) P3 va P4 — mantiqiy 2 guruh, asosiy raqamlar bilan; 5) kamida 150 so'z. To'liq ro'yxat — 4-uy vazifasi (W6_T1_CHECK); uni to'liq javob bilan birga topshiring.
Keyingi 5 dars — har grafik turi alohida: 21 Line graph, 22 Bar chart, 23 Pie chart + Table, 24 Process diagram, 25 Map; bugungi formula va reja har birida ishlatiladi.

homework.title: To'liq javob: kino va streaming narxi
homework.instr: Grafik rasmi berilmagan: avval raqamlardan daftarga oddiy line graph chizing (x — yillar, oraliqlar teng emas: 2014, 2017, 2020, 2024; y — narx, £; bu 20 daqiqaga kirmaydi). Keyin reja + 4 xatboshi, 160–190 so'z, 20 daqiqa. Overview ikkinchi xatboshida, raqamsiz. Yozgach W6_T1_CHECK bo'yicha o'zingizni tekshiring.
homework.answers: Namuna overview: "Overall, both prices rose over the decade, but the cost of streaming increased more quickly and overtook the price of a cinema ticket by the end of the period." Guruhlash: P3 — 2014–2020: kino har doim qimmatroq bo'lgan (farq £1–2: 2014 da £8 va £6, 2017 da £9 va £8, 2020 da £11 va £9); P4 — 2020–2024: streaming £9 → £13 ga keskin oshib, kinoni (£12) quvib o'tgan.

homework.title: Ikki reja (19-dars slaydlari 4–7 dan)
homework.instr: Har biriga 2 daqiqa: tur, overview uchun 2 fikr, P3/P4 guruhlari — belgilar bilan.
homework.answers: Rejalar to'liq javob bilan birga keyingi (21-) darsgacha ustozga topshiriladi. Ustoz har rejada turni, overview uchun 2 fikrni va P3/P4 guruhlarini tekshirib, qisqa yozma izoh bilan qaytaradi. Namuna rejalar (ustoz uchun; o'quvchining belgilari boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin): 1-misol (pie charts, Yemen va Italy, 2000 → 2050; vaqt bor): O: Y — yosh aholi, 0–14 ↓, 15–59 ↑ // I — aholi keksayadi, 60+ ↑↑. P3: Yemen. P4: Italy. 2-misol (jadval, 6 shahar metrosi; vaqtsiz, solishtirma): O: eski tizimlar odatda uzunroq va gavjumroq // London eng eski va eng uzun, Tokyo eng ko'p yo'lovchi. P3: London, Paris, Tokyo. P4: Washington DC, Kyoto, Los Angeles. 3-misol (ikki xarita, orol): O: orol turistik maskanga aylandi // daraxtlar va plyaj saqlangan. P3: yangi binolar (accommodation, reception, restaurant). P4: yo'llar va dengiz bo'yi (footpaths, vehicle track, pier, swimming). 4-misol (jarayon, cement → concrete): O: sement — ko'p bosqichli, uskunali jarayon // beton — to'rt xom ashyoni aralashtirish, soddaroq. P3: cement production. P4: concrete production.
