kahoot.q: 'The bar chart shows cinema attendance in one country from 2000 to 2020.' Which type of Task 1 question is this?
options: A graph with a trend over time
A comparative graph with no time
A map showing changes to a place
kahoot.explain: 'from 2000 to 2020' — vaqt bor, shuning uchun bar chart bo'lsa ham bu vaqtli grafik: o'zgarish tili kerak.

kahoot.q: 'The table shows the population of six cities in 2023.' Which language will this answer mainly need?
options: Change over time: rose, fell, peaked
Location: to the north of, next to
kahoot.explain: Bitta yil va olti shahar — vaqt o'zgarishi yo'q, demak bu solishtirma jadval va solishtirish tili kerak.

kahoot.q: In the four-paragraph formula for Task 1, what does paragraph 2 contain?
options: An overview of the main features
The specific figures for each year
The first group of key details
kahoot.explain: Formula: PARA 2 — overview, ya'ni eng muhim 2 ta umumiy xususiyat, raqamsiz.

kahoot.q: What is the rule for an overview (paragraph 2) and a summary (last paragraph)?
options: Always write one, but never both
Always write both of them to be safe
Write a summary only for maps
Neither is needed if figures are clear
kahoot.explain: Slayd 17 qoidasi: bittasi har doim bo'lsin, ikkalasi hech qachon — takror so'z va vaqtni isrof qiladi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence is the best overview?
options: Overall, tea sales rose, while coffee sales fell.
Overall, tea sales rose from 20 to 45 tonnes.
In 2010, coffee sales stood at 60 tonnes.
The graph shows sales of tea and coffee.
kahoot.explain: Overview raqamsiz umumiy tendensiyani beradi; raqamlar P3–P4 ga, savolning paraphrase'i esa P1 ga tegishli.

kahoot.q: Which of these is a mistake when organising paragraphs 3 and 4?
options: Writing a new paragraph for every line
Putting similar trends in one paragraph
kahoot.explain: Har chiziqqa alohida xatboshi — xato: ma'lumot mantiqiy 2 guruhga bo'linadi, aks holda Coherence pasayadi.

kahoot.q: How much of your 20 minutes should the Task 1 plan take?
kahoot.explain: Reja 1–2 daqiqa: 2 daqiqa reja + 15 daqiqa yozish + 3 daqiqa tekshirish = 20 daqiqa.

kahoot.q: A student's plan says 'C ≈' about coffee sales. What does it mean?
kahoot.explain: ≈ belgisi — 'deyarli o'zgarmadi' (doskadagi belgilar lug'ati); reja faqat yozuvchining o'zi uchun, shuning uchun qisqa belgilar yetarli.

kahoot.q: Which sentence suits a process diagram about making paper?
options: The wood is then cut into small chips.
Paper is more popular than plastic.
The mill lies to the north of the river.
kahoot.explain: Jarayonda passiv va ketma-ketlik tili ishlatiladi: 'is cut', 'then'.

kahoot.q: 'Tea sales rose, ___ coffee sales fell over the same period.' Which word best completes the comparison?
kahoot.explain: 'whereas' ikki qarama-qarshi tendensiyani bitta gapda solishtiradi; 'despite' dan keyin to'liq gap emas, ot yoki -ing shakl keladi, 'due to' — sabab, 'such as' — misol.

kahoot.q: What should the introduction (paragraph 1) do?
options: Paraphrase the question in one sentence
Copy the question exactly, word for word
Give the two main trends with numbers
Say which trend you personally prefer
kahoot.explain: Kirish — savolni o'z so'zlaringiz bilan paraphrase qilish (1 gap); trend va raqamlar keyingi xatboshilarda.

kahoot.q: Which figures should you report in paragraphs 3 and 4?
options: Key ones: start, end, peaks, big gaps
Every number that the graph shows
Only the figures for the last year
kahoot.explain: Hamma raqam emas: boshlanish, oxir, cho'qqi va eng katta farqlar yetarli — ular P3–P4 da beriladi.

kahoot.q: Which verb means 'to reach the highest point'?
kahoot.explain: peak — cho'qqiga chiqmoq: 'Sales peaked in 2015.'

kahoot.q: Which verb means 'to go up and down irregularly'?
kahoot.explain: fluctuate — tebranmoq, o'zgarib turmoq: ko'rsatkich goh oshadi, goh kamayadi.

kahoot.q: 'After 2015, prices levelled off.' What does this mean?
options: They stopped changing and stayed stable
They rose sharply to a new high
They fell quickly to their lowest point
They went up and down every year
kahoot.explain: level off — barqarorlashmoq: o'zgarish to'xtab, ko'rsatkich bir xil darajada qoladi.

kahoot.q: 'Visitor numbers fell ___ from 900 to 200 in a single year.' Which adverb fits best?
kahoot.explain: Bir yilda 900 → 200 — juda katta va tez pasayish, shuning uchun dramatically; slightly va marginally — kichik o'zgarish, gradually — asta-sekin o'zgarish uchun.

kahoot.q: Which adverb means 'at an even, regular rate'?
kahoot.explain: steadily — bir tekis: 'Visitor numbers grew steadily every year.'

kahoot.q: 'The two lines followed a similar ___.' Which word completes this Band 7 phrase?
kahoot.explain: followed a similar pattern — o'xshash naqshda o'zgardi: ikki chiziq bir xil yo'nalishda o'zgarganda ishlatiladi.

kahoot.q: What does 'a downward trend' describe?
options: A sudden rise at the end
The highest point on a graph
kahoot.explain: a downward trend — pasayish tendensiyasi: vaqt davomida umumiy kamayish.

kahoot.q: Which word means 'from the beginning to the end of a period'?
kahoot.explain: throughout the period — butun davr bo'yi: 'Tea was the most popular drink throughout the period.'

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (3): Line graph — trendlar, asosiy nuqtalar va taxminiy raqamlar
lessons.grammar_topic: Line graph: trend tili (fe'l + ravish va sifat + ot), asosiy nuqtalar (boshlanish, burilish, cho'qqi, eng past, oxir), taxmin va prognoz
lessons.vocab_topic: Trend va raqam tili: rise, decline, peak, plateau, overtake, fluctuate; approximately, just over, roughly; is expected to
lessons.book_ref: Ustoz slaydlari mazmuni (21–47-slaydlar mazmuni.md): 21–24 (reja va vaqt taqsimoti), 29–32 (trendni topish), 39 (asosiy nuqtalar), 46 (uchta 'A' — approximately, around, about). Grafiklar — Jony Academy original (matplotlib), ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan.
objectives: Line graph'ni 'trend grafigi' sifatida tanish va overview'da 2 asosiy trendni raqamsiz yozish (slaydlar 29–32).
Har chiziq uchun asosiy nuqtalarni topish: boshlanish, burilish, cho'qqi, eng past, oxir — va chiziqlar kesishgan joyni (slayd 39).
Trendni ikki struktura bilan ifodalash: fe'l + ravish (rose sharply) va there was + sifat + ot (a sharp rise); to / by / at / from / of predloglarini to'g'ri ishlatish.
Raqam aniq ko'rinmasa taxmin so'zlarini (approximately, around, just over, roughly), prognoz uchun is expected to / is projected to ni ishlatish (slayd 46).
20 daqiqada (2' reja + 18' yozish) 150+ so'zli line graph javobini yozish va uni juftlikda W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi bilan baholash.
materials: Namuna grafigi ielts6_21_sample.png (yoshlarning kunlik vaqti, 2012–2024) — proyektorda.
Sinf normativi grafigi ielts6_21_class.png (Riverton muzeylari, 2000–2020) — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan yoki ekranda.
Uy vazifasi grafigi ielts6_21_hw.png (uyni isitish usullari, 1990–2030) — chop etilgan yoki ilovada.
Taymer (2' reja + 18' yozish); doskada ikki struktura (rose sharply / a sharp rise) va predloglar: by — farq, to — yangi qiymat, at — cho'qqi.
W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi varaqasi (har juftlikka) va W6_T1_CHECK ro'yxati (uy vazifasi uchun).
timeline: Takrorlash
20-dars uy vazifasidan 1 overview (kino va streaming) o'qiladi; sinf tekshiradi: raqamsizmi, 2 asosiy xususiyat bormi?
Line graph: asosiy xususiyatlar (slaydlar 29–32, 39)
Trend grafigi = vaqt o'qi; qiyalikni kuzatish (↑ ↓ ≈ ↑→↓); 5 asosiy nuqta + kesishish; 1-mashq namuna grafigida.
Til banki: trend va raqam tili (slayd 46)
CORE/STRONG/SUPER so'zlar; doskada ikki struktura va predloglar formulasi; taxmin so'zlari (approximately, just over, roughly) va prognoz (is projected to).
Namuna: grafik → reja → javob
Ustoz 2 daqiqada doskada reja tuzadi (slaydlar 21–24); namuna javob o'qiladi; 'Namunani formula bilan tekshiring' — 6 savol.
Sinf mashqlari
2-mashq (fe'l + ravish → sifat + ot), 3-mashq (to / by / at / from / of), 4-mashq (xatoni toping); W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasini ekranda tanishtirish.
WRITING NORMATIV — Line graph
2' reja + 18' yozish (imtihon sharoiti) → 10' juftlikda W6_T1_CLASS bilan tekshirish → 5' ustoz 1 ishni ekranda tahlil qiladi
Xulosa va vazifa
5 asosiy nuqta va ikki struktura takrori; uyga: isitish usullari grafigi (prognoz bilan), W6_T1_CHECK, 8 gap.

intro: Line graph — 'trend grafigi': gorizontal o'qda vaqt (yillar, oylar). Vaqt o'qi bor har qanday grafik (bar yoki jadval bo'lsa ham) trend grafigi hisoblanadi va overview TRENDLAR haqida bo'ladi (slayd 31).

Trendni topish (slayd 32): har chiziqning qiyaligiga qarang — ↑ oshdi, ↓ kamaydi, ≈ barqaror, ↑→↓ avval oshib keyin kamaydi. Overview'ga eng muhim 2 trend yoki qarama-qarshi trendlar kiradi: "Whereas social media use rose sharply, TV viewing declined."

Asosiy nuqtalar (slayd 39): boshlanish, burilish nuqtasi, oxir, eng yuqori va eng past nuqta; chiziqlar kesishgan joy ham asosiy xususiyat. P3 va P4 dagi raqamlar shu nuqtalardan olinadi — hamma yilni yozish shart emas (slayd 28).

Ikki struktura: A) ega + fe'l + ravish — "Social media use rose sharply." B) There was + a + sifat + ot + in + ega — "There was a sharp rise in social media use." Javobda ikkalasini aralashtiring: Lexical Resource va Grammatical Range uchun.

Predloglar: rose BY 105 minutes (farq) TO 150 (yangi qiymat); FROM 45 TO 150 (boshlanish va oxir); peaked AT 200,000 (cho'qqi qiymati); a rise OF 105 minutes (ot + of + farq). Bitta predlog xatosi raqam ma'nosini o'zgartiradi.

Taxmin (slayd 46): raqam aniq ko'rinmasa — approximately, around, about, roughly; biroz yuqori — just over, biroz past — just under, deyarli — almost. Noto'g'ri 'aniq' raqamdan ko'ra to'g'ri taxmin yaxshi: noaniq detal Task Achievement'ni Band 6 ga tushiradi (slayd 42).

Zamon: o'tgan yillar — past simple (rose, fell, peaked); prognoz — is expected to / is projected to / will + fe'l, 'by 2030' — 2030 ga kelib. Sabab va izoh yozmang: grafik sababni ko'rsatmaydi (slayd 26).
Vaqt (slayd 24): reja 1–2'; kirish 2–3'; overview 3–5'; P3 5'; P4 5'; tekshirish 2–3'. Bugungi sinf normativida: 2' reja + 18' yozish.

readings.title: NAMUNA: Line graph → reja → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (185 so'z; ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The graph below shows the average number of minutes per day that people aged 16–24 in one country spent on three activities between 2012 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA (2 daqiqa): O: SM ↑↑ (×3+) overtake TV ~2018 // TV ↓↓ // R ≈ low (oxirida biroz ↑). P3: SM + TV (45/140 → 105/100 → 150/60). P4: R (35 → 25 → 30).
text: The line graph compares how many minutes a day young people aged 16 to 24 in one country spent on social media, watching television and reading books over a twelve-year period from 2012 to 2024.

Overall, time spent on social media rose dramatically and overtook TV viewing in around 2018, while watching television declined steadily throughout the period. Reading was the least popular activity and remained relatively stable, with only a slight recovery at the end.

In 2012, young people watched TV for 140 minutes a day, roughly three times as long as the 45 minutes they spent on social media. By 2018, social media use had climbed to 105 minutes, while TV viewing had fallen to 100. After that, social media continued to grow, reaching 150 minutes in 2024, whereas TV time dropped to just 60 minutes, a fall of almost 60% over the whole period.

Reading, by contrast, changed very little. Young people read for 35 minutes a day in 2012, and this figure dipped to 25 minutes in 2018, where it plateaued until 2021, before rising slightly to 30 minutes in 2024.
glossary: the least popular — eng kam mashhur
paraphrases: the average number of minutes per day

items: The graph below shows the number of visitors (in thousands) to three museums in Riverton between 2000 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
answers: Kirish: The line graph shows how many people, in thousands, visited three museums in Riverton — a science museum, a history museum and an art gallery — over the twenty years from 2000 to 2020.

Overview: Overall, the Science Museum grew continuously and became the most popular of the three, while the History Museum lost visitors before recovering. The Art Gallery, by contrast, peaked in 2010 and then declined.

P3 (Science + History, kesishish): History 250,000 (2000) → 180,000 (2010) → 240,000 (2020); Science 120,000 → 210,000 (2010, History ni ortda qoldirdi) → 310,000 (2020), ya'ni ikki yarim baravardan ko'p. 2010 da Art Gallery (200,000) ham History (180,000) ni ortda qoldirgan — History o'sha yili eng kam tashrif buyurilgan muzey.

rows: Kirish savolni o'z so'zlarim bilan aytadi (savoldan 3 tadan ko'p so'z aynan emas)?
Overview 2-xatboshida, raqamsiz, 2 ta asosiy xususiyat bilan?
Ma'lumot P3 va P4 ga mantiqiy guruhlangan?
Har asosiy xususiyat raqam bilan; birlik (%, million, km, °C) va valyuta to'g'ri?
Izoh yoki sabab yozilmagan — faqat grafikdagi fakt?
Bog'lovchilar xilma-xil (while, whereas, by contrast, respectively, after which)?
Ikki shakl ham bor: fe'l + ravish va sifat + ot?
Zamon to'g'ri: o'tgan — past, kelajak — will / is expected to, jarayon — present passive?
homework.answers: 9 banddan kamida 7 tasi 'Ha' — normativ bajarildi. Bugungi grafikda 8-band (zamon) ayniqsa muhim: 1990–2020 — past simple, 2030 — is projected to / is expected to.

homework.title: Til banki: 8 gap
homework.instr: Bugungi uch grafik bo'yicha 8 gap: 4 tasi fe'l + ravish, 4 tasi there was + sifat + ot. Har gapda raqam, birlik va to / by / at / from / of dan biri; kamida 2 gapda approximately / just over / roughly.
answers: Social media use rose dramatically from 45 to 150 minutes a day between 2012 and 2024.
There was a steady fall in TV viewing, from 140 to 60 minutes a day.
Reading time fell slightly from 35 to roughly 25 minutes a day between 2012 and 2018.
There was a slight recovery in reading time, to 30 minutes in 2024.
Visitors to the Science Museum increased steadily by 190,000 over the twenty years.
There was a sharp drop in History Museum visitors to 180,000 in 2010.
Electric heaters rose gradually from 20% to 30% of homes between 1990 and 2020.
There is expected to be a sharp rise in the use of heat pumps, to approximately 35% of homes by 2030.

normativ: 20 daqiqada 150+ so'z, overview bor, 4 mezon o'rtachasi ≥ 5.5 (W6_T1_CLASS)
Uy vazifasi: Task 1 — uyni isitish usullari

kahoot.q: Rice prices went from $40 to $65. Which sentence reports the DIFFERENCE correctly?
kahoot.explain: by — qancha o'zgargani (65 − 40 = 25); to — yangi qiymat bo'lardi (rose to $65). 'at' faqat cho'qqida (peaked at), 'of' esa ot bilan (a rise of $25).

kahoot.q: 'There was a sharp rise ___ the number of train passengers.' Which word fits?
kahoot.explain: rise / fall / increase IN + nima o'zgargani; OF esa raqam bilan keladi: a rise of 2 million.

kahoot.q: 'Exports dropped slightly in 2019.' Which sentence says the same thing with 'There was'?
options: There was a slight drop in exports in 2019.
There was a slightly drop in exports in 2019.
There was a slight drop of exports in 2019.
There dropped a slight export in 2019.
kahoot.explain: Ravish sifatga (slightly → slight), fe'l otga (dropped → a drop) aylanadi, keyin 'in + nima'. 'a slightly drop' va 'drop of exports' xato.

kahoot.q: 'Club membership peaked ___ 3,000 in 2016.' Which preposition is correct?
kahoot.explain: Cho'qqi qiymati 'at' bilan: peaked at 3,000. 'by' farqni bildiradi, 'for' va 'with' bu yerda ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: A point is a little above 50 on the graph, but no exact figure is shown. What should you write?
kahoot.explain: Raqam aniq ko'rinmasa taxmin so'zi: just over — biroz ko'p. 'exactly 52' — o'ylab topilgan raqam, 'just under' teskari, 'much more' juda bo'rttirilgan.

kahoot.q: A line ends in 2030 and the key says '(projected)'. Which sentence is correct?
options: Sales are expected to reach 80% by 2030.
kahoot.explain: 2030 hali kelmagan — prognoz tili kerak: is/are expected to, is projected to, will. Past simple yoki present perfect bu yerda noto'g'ri.

kahoot.q: A line graph shows bus use from 2000 to 2020. Which tense should describe those years?
kahoot.explain: Ma'lumot o'tgan yillarga tegishli — past simple (rose, fell, peaked). Kelajak shakli faqat prognoz qismi uchun.

kahoot.q: What does the overview of a line graph usually describe?
options: The main trends and any crossing
The highest number only, in detail
kahoot.explain: Line graph overview'i — eng muhim trendlar (oshdi, kamaydi, barqaror) va chiziqlar kesishgani, raqamsiz. Sabab yozilmaydi, raqamlar P3–P4 da ham faqat asosiy nuqtalardan.

kahoot.q: Two lines cross on a line graph. Why does this matter?
options: It is a key feature worth reporting
It shows a mistake in the data
It means both lines stopped changing
It is only needed in a conclusion
kahoot.explain: Chiziqlar kesishgan joy — biri ikkinchisini quvib o'tgan payt; bu asosiy xususiyat, overview va P3/P4 da aytiladi.

kahoot.q: On a line graph, a line that goes up very steeply shows ___.
kahoot.explain: Tik ko'tarilgan chiziq — tez va katta o'sish: sharp / dramatic rise. Yotiqroq chiziq — gradual, gorizontal chiziq — o'zgarish yo'q.

kahoot.q: The graph shows passengers in millions. The line for 2020 is at 4. Which sentence is accurate?
kahoot.explain: Birlik o'qda yoki sarlavhada beriladi ('in millions') va raqam bilan birga yoziladi; birliksiz yoki noto'g'ri birlik Task Achievement'ni pasaytiradi.

kahoot.q: 'Coffee prices rose in 2015 because of bad weather in Brazil.' What is wrong with this sentence?
options: It gives a reason not shown in the graph
It uses the wrong tense for 2015
It does not give any figure at all
kahoot.explain: Task 1 da faqat grafikdagi ma'lumot yoziladi; sabab (because of ...) grafikda yo'q — bu o'z fikr, Task Achievement pasayadi. Zamon va fe'l to'g'ri.

kahoot.q: Sales went from 200 to 600 units. Which phrase describes this change?
kahoot.explain: 600 = 200 × 3 — uch baravar o'sish: a threefold increase. twofold — ikki baravar, slight — biroz, reduction — kamayish.

kahoot.q: Which word is closest in meaning to 'approximately'?
kahoot.explain: approximately = roughly / around / about — taxminan. exactly — aniq (teskari ma'no), slightly — biroz, steadily — bir tekis.

kahoot.q: Which adverb means 'slowly, over a long period'?
kahoot.explain: gradually — asta-sekin. sharply, dramatically va suddenly — tez va keskin o'zgarish uchun.

kahoot.q: Which phrase means 'a little less than'?
kahoot.explain: just under 50 — 50 dan biroz kam (masalan 48). just over — biroz ko'p, well above — ancha ko'p, roughly double — taxminan ikki baravar.

kahoot.q: 'Profits declined after 2012.' Which word fits 'There was a steady ___ in profits'?
kahoot.explain: decline — ham fe'l, ham ot: a steady decline in profits. 'declining' va 'declined' fe'l shakllari, 'declination' esa boshqa ma'noli so'z.

kahoot.q: 'Sales are projected to double by 2030.' What does 'projected' mean here?
kahoot.explain: is projected to — prognoz: kelajakda shunday bo'lishi kutilmoqda. Grafikda ko'pincha uzuq chiziq yoki '(projected)' belgisi bilan ko'rsatiladi.

kahoot.q: 'Sales dipped in March.' What does 'dip' mean?
options: fall a little for a short time
kahoot.explain: dip — qisqa muddatga biroz tushish (keyin ko'pincha tiklanadi). rise sharply — tez o'sish, remain stable — o'zgarmaslik, peak — cho'qqi.

kahoot.q: 'The figure for tea was well below that for coffee.' What does 'well below' mean?
kahoot.explain: well below — ancha past (much lower). slightly lower — biroz past, well above — ancha yuqori.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (4): Bar chart — trend yoki solishtirma grafik, eng ko'p va eng kam
lessons.grammar_topic: Bar chart: vaqtli (trend) va vaqtsiz (solishtirma) bar grafikni ajratish; solishtirish tili (higher than, twice as many, the figure for), number / amount / proportion / percentage, birlik aniqligi
lessons.vocab_topic: Solishtirish tili: compared with, whereas, twice as many as, slightly higher, the highest proportion, the figure for, respectively
lessons.book_ref: Ustoz slaydlari mazmuni (21–47-slaydlar mazmuni.md): 31 (trend grafigi bar bo'lishi ham mumkin), 33–34 (farqlar va eng ko'p/eng kam), 40 (solishtirish va guruhlash), 43 (o'lchov birligi). Grafiklar — Jony Academy original (matplotlib), ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan.
objectives: Bar chartda avval VAQT bor-yo'qligini aniqlash: yillar yoki oylar bor — trend grafigi (o'zgarish tili), yo'q — solishtirma grafik (solishtirish tili).
Asosiy xususiyatni tanlash: eng ko'p va eng kam, eng keskin farq; har ustunni har ustun bilan solishtirmasdan ma'lumotni P3 va P4 ga guruhlash.
Solishtirish tilini aniq ishlatish: compared with, whereas, twice as many as, five times as many, slightly higher, the figure for, respectively.
number / amount / proportion / percentage farqini bilish va birlik hamda valyutani (thousand, %, $) javobda to'g'ri yozish.
20 daqiqada 150+ so'zlik Bar chart javobini yozish va uni W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi bilan baholash (WRITING NORMATIV).
materials: Namuna grafigi (ielts6_22_sample.png): erkak va ayollarning 5 jismoniy faoliyati, 2024 — proyektorda, namuna javob bilan birga.
Sinf normativi grafigi (ielts6_22_class.png): 4 shahardagi xorijiy talabalar, 2015 va 2025 — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan yoki ekranda.
Uy vazifasi grafigi (ielts6_22_hw.png): 3 yosh guruhining haftalik xarajati — chop etilgan.
Doskada savol-sxema: "Vaqt bormi? → HA: trend tili (rose, doubled) / YO'Q: solishtirish tili (higher than, whereas)"; taymer (2 daqiqa reja + 18 daqiqa yozish).
W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi varaqasi (har juftlikka bitta) va W6_T1_CHECK ro'yxati (uy vazifasi uchun).
timeline: Takrorlash
21-dars uy vazifasidan (line graph) bitta overview ovoz chiqarib o'qiladi; sinf tekshiradi: raqamsizmi, 2 asosiy trend bormi?
Bar chart: asosiy xususiyatlar (slaydlar 31, 33–34, 40)
Vaqt bormi? → trend yoki solishtirma bar; eng ko'p / eng kam va eng keskin farq; guruhlash — har birini har biri bilan emas (1-mashq).
Til banki
Solishtirish iboralari (CORE / STRONG / SUPER) namuna grafik bilan; number / amount / proportion / percentage (2-mashq); birlik va valyuta (slayd 43).
Namuna: grafik → reja → javob
Erkak/ayol grafigi: ustoz doskada 2 daqiqalik reja tuzadi; namuna javob o'qiladi va 6 savol bilan formula bo'yicha tekshiriladi.
Sinf mashqlari
3-mashq (solishtirish gaplari) va 4-mashq (birlik xatolari); oxirida W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi bilan tanishuv — normativda shu bilan baholanadi.
WRITING NORMATIV — Bar chart
2' reja + 18' yozish (imtihon sharoiti) → 10' juftlikda W6_T1_CLASS bilan tekshirish → 5' ustoz 1 ishni ekranda tahlil qiladi
Xulosa va vazifa
Trend va solishtirma bar farqi bitta gapda; uy vazifasi grafigi (yosh guruhlari xarajati) va W6_T1_CHECK tushuntiriladi.

intro: Bar chartni ko'rganda birinchi savol: grafikda VAQT bormi (yillar, oylar)? Bor bo'lsa — bu trend grafigi, ustunli bo'lsa ham (slayd 31): rose, fell, more than doubled. Yo'q bo'lsa — solishtirma grafik (slayd 33): o'sish va tushish yo'q, faqat higher than, twice as many, the most popular.

Tipik xato — vaqt yo'q grafikda o'zgarish fe'li: "Football decreased from men to women." To'g'risi: "A far smaller proportion of women than men played football." Ikki yilli bar (2015 va 2025) esa trend: avval o'zgarish, keyin shu yildagi solishtirish.
Asosiy xususiyat (slaydlar 34, 40): eng ko'p va eng kam narsa, eng keskin farq. Grafikka 5 soniya qarab nimani eslab qolsangiz — overview'da shu bo'ladi, raqamsiz.

Guruhlash: har ustunni har ustun bilan solishtirmang. Mantiqiy 2 guruh tanlang — masalan, erkaklar ustun faoliyatlar (P3) va ayollar ustun faoliyatlar (P4); yoki o'sganlar va kamayganlar; yoki eng yuqori va eng past toifalar. Har guruhda raqamlarni unutmang.

Solishtirish tuzilmalari: X is higher than Y; X is twice / five times as high as Y; twice as many men as women; while the figure for women was 27%; 52% and 61% respectively; whereas / while bilan ikki tomon bitta gapda beriladi.

number / amount / proportion / percentage: the number of + sanaladigan ot (students, visitors); the amount of + sanalmaydigan ot (money, time); the proportion / percentage of + odamlar ulushi (the proportion of women). Raqam bilan: 30% yoki 30 per cent — "30 percentage" emas.

Birlik va valyuta (slayd 43): o'qda nima yozilgan bo'lsa, javobda ham shu bo'ladi — thousand, million, %, $. "42" emas — "42,000 students"; "40" emas — "$40". Birlikni tushirib qoldirish yoki foizni son deb yozish — Band 6 dagi "noaniq detal".
Aniq raqam ko'rinmasa — approximately, around, just over, just under (slayd 46). Zamon: o'tgan yilgi ma'lumot (2024, 2015) — past simple; bitta yil solishtirmasi ham past simple.
formulas: Savol va o'qdan yil yoki oyni qidiring
Eng baland va eng past ustunni, eng keskin farqni belgilang
Walking — eng yuqori; yoga (men) — eng past; football — eng katta farq
Savolni paraphrase qiling, birlik va yilni saqlang
The bar chart compares the proportion of men and women in one city who took part in ...
Overall, walking was by far the most popular activity for both sexes, whereas ...
Proportionally, five times as many men as women played football (30% compared with 6%).
Guruhlash — har birini har biri bilan emas (slayd 40)
Yoga was practised by 19% of women but only 4% of men.
presentation: Bar chart doim solishtirma grafikmi?
Yo'q. O'qda yillar yoki oylar bo'lsa — trend grafigi (slayd 31): o'zgarish tili kerak (rose from 18,000 to 42,000). Vaqt yo'q bo'lsa — faqat solishtirish.
Ikki yilli bar (2015 va 2025) — trendmi yoki solishtirmami?
Ikkalasi ham: asosiysi o'zgarish (increased, fell, tripled), keyin shu yildagi solishtirish (Northbridge overtook Eastport).
Hamma ustunni yozishim kerakmi?
Ma'lumot kam bo'lsa — hammasini qamrang, lekin guruhlab. Ustunlarni ketma-ket sanab chiqish — Band 5 (mexanik ro'yxat, overview yo'q).
"twice as many" va "twice as much" farqi nima?
many — sanaladigan (students, people); much — sanalmaydigan (money, time). Foizda: "twice as high as" yoki "double the figure for".
Foizlarni solishtirganda "more men" deyish mumkinmi?
Ehtiyot bo'ling: 30% va 6% — ulush, kishi soni emas. "A higher proportion of men" yoki "proportionally, five times as many men as women" deng.
Overview'da "the most popular" deyish mumkinmi?
Ha, raqamsiz: "Walking was by far the most popular activity for both sexes." Raqamlar P3–P4 da.
notes: Task 1 bloki: 19 — mezonlar; 20 — formula va reja; 21 — Line graph; 22 — Bar chart (bugun); 23 — Pie chart + Table; 24 — Process; 25 — Map. Har darsda Band 6.5 namuna, til banki va 20 daqiqalik WRITING NORMATIV bor.
Uchala grafik (namuna, sinf, uy) Jony Academy tomonidan chizilgan, ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan. Slayd mazmuni (31, 33–34, 40, 43, 46) o'z so'zlarimiz bilan berilgan.
WRITING NORMATIV paytida izoh bermang — imtihon sharoiti. Juftlik tekshiruvidan keyin bitta ishni (o'quvchi roziligi bilan, ismsiz) ekranga chiqarib, overview, guruhlash va birliklarni tahlil qiling.
mistakes: Football decreased from men to women.
A far smaller proportion of women than men played football (6% compared with 30%).
The number of money spent on food was $70.
The amount of money spent on food was $70.
61% of women walked at least once a week.
percentage — ot; raqam bilan % yoki per cent
Walking 52%, gym 38%, football 30%, swimming 18%, yoga 4%... (ketma-ket sanash)
Men were ahead in two activities ... Women, by contrast, ...

how: CORE — solishtirish so'zlari; STRONG — farq darajasini aniqlovchi iboralar; SUPER — Band 7 tuzilmalari.
Har ibora bilan namuna grafikdan (erkak va ayollar) bitta gap tuzing — raqam va % albatta bo'lsin.
core: 38% of men went to the gym, compared with 27% of women.
Ayollarning 27% i bilan solishtirganda erkaklarning 38% i sport zaliga borgan.
A far higher proportion of men than women played football (30% compared with 6%), whereas women were well ahead in yoga (19% compared with 4%).
Futbol o'ynagan erkaklar ulushi ayollarnikidan ancha yuqori edi (30% va 6%), yoga bo'yicha esa ayollar ancha oldinda edi (19% va 4%).
Swimming attracted 22% of women, while the figure for men was 18%.
Suzish ayollarning 22% ini jalb qilgan, erkaklarda esa bu ko'rsatkich 18% edi.
The figure for women who played football was only 6%.
Futbol o'ynagan ayollar uchun ko'rsatkich atigi 6% edi.
The figures for walking among men and women were 52% and 61% respectively.
Erkaklar va ayollar orasida piyoda yurish ko'rsatkichi mos ravishda 52% va 61% edi.
By contrast, women were well ahead in yoga.
Bundan farqli o'laroq, yogada ayollar ancha oldinda edi.
In every age group, spending on food exceeded spending on transport.
Har bir yosh guruhida oziq-ovqat xarajati transport xarajatidan ko'p bo'lgan.
The biggest gap between the sexes was in football.
Jinslar orasidagi eng katta farq futbolda edi.
strong: In 2025, Eastport had more than twice as many international students as Southvale.
2025 da Eastportda Southvaledagidan ikki barobardan ko'proq xorijiy talaba bor edi.
Proportionally, five times as many men as women played football.
Ulush jihatidan futbol o'ynagan erkaklar ayollardan besh barobar ko'p edi.
The percentage of women who swam was slightly higher than that of men.
Suzgan ayollar ulushi erkaklarnikidan biroz yuqoriroq edi.
The figure for men doing yoga was considerably lower than that for women (4% compared with 19%).
Yoga bilan shug'ullangan erkaklar ko'rsatkichi ayollarnikidan ancha pastroq edi (4% va 19%).
A similar percentage of men and women went swimming (18% and 22%).
Erkaklar va ayollarning o'xshash foizi suzish bilan shug'ullangan (18% va 22%).
The majority of women (61%) walked at least once a week.
Ayollarning ko'pchiligi (61%) haftada kamida bir marta piyoda yurgan.
Only a small minority of men (4%) did yoga.
Erkaklarning juda oz qismi (4%) yoga bilan shug'ullangan.
super: Walking had the highest proportion of participants among both sexes.
Ikkala jinsda ham piyoda yurishda ishtirokchilar ulushi eng yuqori edi.
The lowest figure on the chart was 4%, for men doing yoga.
Grafikdagi eng past ko'rsatkich — yoga bilan shug'ullangan erkaklar, 4%.
Food accounted for the largest part of weekly spending in every age group.
Har bir yosh guruhida haftalik xarajatning eng katta qismini oziq-ovqat tashkil etgan.
In 2025, international students in Northbridge outnumbered those in Eastport.
2025 da Northbridgedagi xorijiy talabalar soni Eastportdagidan ko'p edi.
In terms of popularity, walking was far ahead of the other activities.
Ommaboplik jihatidan piyoda yurish boshqa faoliyatlardan ancha oldinda edi.
normativ: Til banki: 20 iboradan 16 tasi — ustoz o'zbekchasini aytadi, o'quvchi inglizcha iborani yozadi va grafik haqida 1 gap tuzadi (keyingi dars boshida, 5 daqiqa).

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Trend yoki solishtirma?
class_ex.instr: Har savol uchun ayting: grafikda vaqt bormi? Trend grafigimi yoki solishtirma grafikmi? Qaysi til kerak?
items: The bar chart shows the number of cars sold by three companies in 2010, 2015 and 2020.
The bar chart shows how many hours per week teenagers in five countries spent online in 2023.
The bar chart compares the percentage of boys and girls who chose five school subjects in 2024.
The bar chart shows the number of visitors to a museum each month from January to June 2022.
The bar chart shows the price of a cinema ticket in six cities.
The bar chart shows the population of three cities in 1990 and 2020, with projections for 2040.
answers: Solishtirma — solishtirish tili (higher than, the most, the least)
Solishtirma — solishtirish tili (a higher proportion of girls, whereas)
Trend (oylar) — o'zgarish tili (peaked in ..., fell to ...)
Solishtirma — solishtirish tili; valyutani yozish shart
Trend + prognoz — o'zgarish tili va kelajak (is expected to reach)
why: 2010, 2015, 2020 — vaqt bor; ustunli bo'lishi turini o'zgartirmaydi (slayd 31).
Bitta yil (2023) — o'zgarish yo'q, faqat mamlakatlar farqi.
Bitta yil, ikki guruh — bugungi namuna grafigi ham shunday.
Oylar ham vaqt — demak trend grafigi.
Yil umuman yo'q — "increased" yozib bo'lmaydi.
2040 — kelajak: will / is expected to / is projected to.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: number / amount / proportion / percentage
class_ex.instr: Bo'shliqqa number, amount, proportion yoki percentage so'zini qo'ying (ba'zi joyda ikki variant to'g'ri).
items: The ____ of international students in Westford tripled between 2015 and 2025.
The ____ of money that 18–25-year-olds spent on entertainment was $35 a week.
A higher ____ of women than men did yoga (19% compared with 4%).
The ____ of time that teenagers spent online rose steadily.
The ____ of men who went swimming every week was 18%.
Southvale saw a fall in the ____ of international students, from 22,000 to 15,000.
why: students — sanaladigan → number.
money — sanalmaydigan → amount.
Ulush (%) — proportion yoki percentage.
time — sanalmaydigan → amount.
18% — ulush; percentage of + odamlar.
Kishi soni (ming) — number.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Solishtirish gapini tuzing
class_ex.instr: Namuna grafikdan (erkak va ayollar, 2024) berilgan ibora bilan bitta to'liq gap yozing; raqam va % bo'lsin.
items: twice — erkaklar: gym (38%) va swimming (18%)
five times as many — football: erkaklar 30%, ayollar 6%
slightly higher — swimming: ayollar 22%, erkaklar 18%
the figure for — gym: erkaklar 38%, ayollar 27%
whereas — yoga: ayollar 19%, erkaklar 4%
respectively — walking: erkaklar 52%, ayollar 61%
answers: The proportion of men who went to the gym (38%) was more than twice as high as the proportion who went swimming (18%).
Proportionally, five times as many men as women played football (30% compared with 6%).
The percentage of women who went swimming was slightly higher than that of men (22% and 18% respectively).
38% of men used a gym every week, while the figure for women was 27%.
Yoga was practised by 19% of women, whereas only 4% of men did it.
Walking was the most popular activity for both men and women, at 52% and 61% respectively.
why: 38 ÷ 18 ≈ 2.1 — aniq ikki barobar emas, shuning uchun "more than twice".
30 ÷ 6 = 5; foiz bo'lgani uchun "proportionally" qo'shildi.
Farq 4 foiz punkti — "slightly"; "that of men" takrorni oldini oladi.
"the figure for" — ikkinchi raqamni so'zni takrorlamasdan beradi.
whereas — ikki qarama-qarshi faktni bitta murakkab gapda beradi.
respectively — raqamlar tartibi gapdagi tartibga mos.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Birlik xatolari (slayd 43)
class_ex.instr: Har gapda birlik, valyuta yoki foiz/son xatosini toping va gapni to'g'ri yozing. Qavsda grafik o'qidagi birlik berilgan.
items: (Visitors, thousands) The museum had 85 visitors in May.
(Weekly spending, €) Students spent 30 dollars a week on transport.
(Government spending, $ million) The government spent $20 on new roads in 2020.
(Percentage of women, %) The number of women who did yoga was 19.
(Steel production, thousand tonnes; axis value: 12) Factory A produced 12,000 thousand tonnes of steel.
answers: The museum had 85,000 visitors in May.
Students spent €30 a week on transport.
The government spent $20 million on new roads in 2020.
The proportion of women who did yoga was 19%.
Factory A produced 12,000 tonnes (12 thousand tonnes) of steel.
why: "thousands" tushib qolgan — raqam 1000 marta kichraygan.
Valyuta noto'g'ri: o'qda € — dollar emas.
"million" tushib qolgan — $20 va $20 million butunlay boshqa narsa.
Foiz son deb yozilgan: 19% — ulush, 19 kishi emas.
Birlik ikki marta: 12 (ming tonna) = 12,000 tonnes.

readings.title: NAMUNA: Bar chart → reja → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (176 so'z; ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The chart below shows the percentage of men and women in one city who did five types of physical activity at least once a week in 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA (2 daqiqa): VAQT YO'Q → solishtirish tili. O: Walk ++ (ikkala jins) // M > W: gym, football // W > M: walk, swim, yoga. P3: football (×5) + gym. P4: walk, swim, yoga (ayollarning eng katta ustunligi — yoga; eng past — 4%).
text: The bar chart compares the proportion of men and women in one city who took part in five types of physical activity at least once a week in 2024.
Overall, walking was by far the most popular activity for both sexes. Men were more likely than women to go to the gym and play football, whereas women were ahead in walking, swimming and yoga.

The largest male lead was in football. Proportionally, five times as many men as women played the sport every week (30% compared with 6%). Men were also more likely to work out in a gym, with 38% doing so weekly, while the figure for women was 27%.

Women, by contrast, led in the other three activities. Walking was the top choice for both groups, with 61% of women and 52% of men walking regularly. A slightly higher percentage of women than men went swimming (22% and 18% respectively). Women's widest lead was in yoga, which was practised by 19% of women but only 4% of men, the lowest figure on the chart.
glossary: by far — ancha, katta farq bilan
be more likely to — ... ga ko'proq moyil bo'lmoq
paraphrases: the percentage of men and women
the proportion of men and women
did five types of physical activity
took part in five types of physical activity

tasks.title: Namunani formula bilan tekshiring
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Grafik, reja va javobga qarab savollarga javob bering.
items: Bu grafikda vaqt bormi? Javobda qaysi til ishlatilgan?
Overview'dagi ikki asosiy fikr qaysi?
P3 va P4 qanday guruhlangan?
"five times as many" qaysi raqamlarga asoslangan?
"respectively" qaysi gapda va nimani bildiradi?
Javobda grafikda yo'q izoh yoki sabab bormi?
answers: Yo'q — bitta yil (2024). Faqat solishtirish tili: more likely than, whereas, compared with; increased/decreased yo'q.
1) walking ikkala jins uchun eng mashhur; 2) erkaklar gym va football da, ayollar walking, swimming va yoga da ustun.
P3 — erkaklar ustun faoliyatlar (football, gym); P4 — ayollar ustun faoliyatlar (walking, swimming, yoga).
"(22% and 18% respectively)" — 22% ayollar, 18% erkaklar, gapdagi tartib bo'yicha.
Yo'q — faqat grafikdagi fakt; "erkaklar futbolni ko'proq yaxshi ko'radi, chunki ..." kabi izoh yozilmagan.
why: Slayd 33: vaqt yo'q grafik — comparative graph.
Overview raqamsiz, 2 asosiy xususiyat, whereas bilan bitta murakkab gap.
Slayd 40: har birini har biri bilan emas — mantiqiy 2 guruh.
Foizlarni solishtirganda "proportionally" — aniqlik (slayd 45).
Ikki raqam bitta gapda — takror yo'q.
W6_T1_CHECK, 5-band: izoh va sabab yozilmaydi.

tasks.title: Writing (yozma): WRITING NORMATIV — xorijiy talabalar, 4 shahar
tasks.type: Writing (yozma)
tasks.instr: 2' reja + 18' yozish, 150+ so'z, 4 xatboshi, overview raqamsiz. Keyin juftlikda W6_T1_CLASS bilan baholang.
items: The chart below shows the number of international students (in thousands) studying in four cities in 2015 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
answers: Kirish: The bar chart compares how many international students were studying in four cities in 2015 and 2025, with figures given in thousands.

Overview: Overall, the number of international students rose in three of the four cities, while Southvale was the only city to see a fall. Northbridge became the most popular destination by 2025, overtaking Eastport, which had been the leader in 2015.
P3 (keskin o'sganlar): Northbridge 18,000 → 42,000 (more than doubled); Westford 9,000 → 27,000 (tripled; 2015 da eng kam).
P4 (kam o'zgargan va kamaygan): Eastport 35,000 → 38,000 (slight rise; 2015 da eng ko'p); Southvale 22,000 → 15,000 (yagona pasayish).
why: Vaqt bor (2015 → 2025) — o'zgarish tili kerak: rose, more than doubled, tripled, fell (slayd 31).
Birlik: thousands — "42" emas, "42,000 students" (slayd 43).
Guruhlash: har shahar alohida xatboshida emas — keskin o'sganlar (P3) va kam o'zgargan/kamaygan (P4) (slayd 40).

answers: People aged 41–60 spent $70 a week on food, compared with $40 for those aged 18–25.
The youngest group spent $35 on entertainment, whereas the oldest group spent only $15.

normativ: 20 daqiqada 150+ so'z, overview bor, 4 mezon o'rtachasi ≥ 5.5 (W6_T1_CLASS)
Uy vazifasi: Task 1 — yosh guruhlari bo'yicha haftalik xarajat

kahoot.q: 'The bar chart shows the number of cars sold by three companies in 2010, 2015 and 2020.' What type of graph is this?
options: A trend graph, because it has years
A comparison graph, because it has bars
A process, because it has stages
A map, because it shows three places
kahoot.explain: Uchta yil bor — vaqt bor. Ustunli bo'lsa ham bu trend grafigi, demak o'zgarish tili kerak: rose, fell, doubled (slayd 31).

kahoot.q: 'The bar chart compares the percentage of men and women who did five sports in 2024.' Which language will the answer mainly need?
options: Comparison: higher than, the most popular
Change: rose, fell, more than doubled
Process: is heated, after that, finally
Location: to the east of, next to
kahoot.explain: Bitta yil (2024) — o'zgarish yo'q, faqat guruhlar farqi. Shuning uchun solishtirish tili: higher than, twice as many, the most popular (slayd 33).

kahoot.q: Which sentence is WRONG for a bar chart with only one year (2024)?
options: Football decreased from men to women.
Women were well ahead in yoga.
Walking was the most popular activity.
Men led in the gym and in football.
kahoot.explain: Vaqt yo'q grafikda 'decreased', 'rose' ishlatilmaydi — hech narsa o'zgarmagan. To'g'risi: 'A far smaller proportion of women than men played football.'

kahoot.q: A bar chart shows international students in four cities in 2015 and 2025. What should the body paragraphs focus on first?
options: Only the 2025 figures, as they are newer
Only the 2015 figures, as they come first
Every bar from left to right in order
kahoot.explain: Ikki yilli bar — trend grafigi: avval o'zgarish (increased, fell, tripled), keyin shu yildagi solishtirish (Northbridge overtook Eastport).

kahoot.q: Which sentence is the best overview for the chart of men and women doing five activities?
options: Overall, walking was by far the most popular activity for both.
Overall, 61% of women and 52% of men went walking every week.
The bar chart compares five activities among men and women.
In 2024, the lowest figure on the chart was 4%, for yoga.
kahoot.explain: Overview — eng asosiy xususiyat, raqamsiz. Raqamli gap P3–P4 ga, savolning paraphrase'i esa kirishga (PARA 1) tegishli.

kahoot.q: What should a good Task 1 overview contain?
options: One feature with all its figures
Five features, one for each bar
kahoot.explain: Overview — 2 ta asosiy xususiyat (eng ko'p / eng kam, eng keskin farq), raqamsiz. Raqamlar P3 va P4 da beriladi (slayd 34).

kahoot.q: What is the best way to organise paragraphs 3 and 4 for a bar chart?
options: Group bars that show a similar pattern
Describe each bar in the order shown
Put all the figures in the overview
Write one short paragraph for every bar
kahoot.explain: Mantiqiy 2 guruh tanlanadi: masalan, erkaklar ustun faoliyatlar (P3) va ayollar ustun faoliyatlar (P4). Ketma-ket sanash — Band 5 (slayd 40).

kahoot.q: Choose the correct word: 'The ____ of money that 41–60-year-olds spent on food was $70 a week.'
kahoot.explain: money — sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun 'the amount of'. 'the number of' faqat sanaladigan otlar bilan ishlatiladi (students, visitors).

kahoot.q: Football: men 30%, women 6%. Which sentence is the most accurate?
options: A far higher proportion of men played football.
Football increased from women to men.
There were exactly 30 men and 6 women playing football.
Women played football more often than men.
kahoot.explain: 30% va 6% — ulush, kishi soni emas. Shuning uchun 'a higher proportion of men' yoki 'proportionally, five times as many men as women' deyiladi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence about a figure on a % axis is correct?
options: 30 per cents of men played football.
kahoot.explain: percentage — ot ('the percentage of men'). Raqam bilan esa % yoki 'per cent' yoziladi, ko'plik shaklisiz: 30% / 30 per cent.

kahoot.q: The axis says 'thousands'. The Northbridge bar shows 42 in 2025. How should you write this figure?
kahoot.explain: O'qda nima yozilgan bo'lsa, javobda ham shu bo'ladi: 42 thousand = 42,000. Birlikni tushirib qoldirish — Band 6 dagi 'noaniq detal'.

kahoot.q: Men 30%, women 6% (football). Complete: 'Proportionally, ____ men as women played football.'
kahoot.explain: 30 ÷ 6 = 5. men — sanaladigan, shuning uchun 'many'; 'much' sanalmaydigan otlar uchun (money, time).

kahoot.q: Swimming: women 22%, men 18%. Which phrase describes the difference best?
kahoot.explain: Farq atigi 4 foiz punkti — 'slightly higher'. 'considerably' va 'far' katta farq uchun (masalan, yoga: 19% va 4%).

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Walking was the top activity for both men and women, at 52% and 61% ____.'
kahoot.explain: respectively — 'mos ravishda': birinchi raqam birinchi guruhga (men 52%), ikkinchisi ikkinchisiga (women 61%) tegishli.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Men led in football, ____ women were well ahead in yoga.'
kahoot.explain: whereas — ikki qarama-qarshi faktni bitta gapda bog'laydi. 'because' sabab, 'therefore' natija, 'in addition' qo'shimcha uchun.

kahoot.q: Which sentence uses 'the figure for' correctly?
options: 38% of men used a gym, while the figure for women was 27%.
38% of men used a gym, while the figure of women were 27%.
The figure for 38% of men used a gym every week.
Men used a gym 38%, the figure for was women 27%.
kahoot.explain: 'the figure for + guruh' — ikkinchi raqamni so'zni takrorlamasdan beradi; fe'l birlikda: the figure ... was.

kahoot.q: Which sentence uses 'account for' correctly?
options: Food accounted for the biggest share of spending.
Food accounted the biggest share of all the spending.
Food was accounted for the biggest share of spending.
Food accounted to the biggest share of spending.
kahoot.explain: account for — '... ni tashkil etmoq'; 'for' predlogi shart va faol nisbatda ishlatiladi: Food accounted for ...

kahoot.q: Which phrase means MORE than half of a group, e.g. 61% of women?
kahoot.explain: majority — ko'pchilik (yarmidan ko'p: 61% of women); minority — ozchilik (masalan, 4% of men did yoga).

kahoot.q: The bar is a little below the 40 line, and the exact value is not shown. How should you describe it?
kahoot.explain: Aniq raqam ko'rinmasa — approximately, around, just over, just under. Ustun 40 dan biroz past, demak 'just under 40'.

kahoot.q: Which tense is best for data from 2024 (one year in the past)?
options: Past simple: walking was the most popular
Present perfect: walking has been the most popular
Future: walking will be the most popular
Present continuous: walking is being popular
kahoot.explain: O'tgan yilgi ma'lumot (2024, 2015) — past simple. Bitta yil solishtirmasi ham past simple: walking was, 61% of women walked.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (5): Pie chart + Table — ulushlar, kasrlar va jadvaldan asosiy ma'lumotni tanlash
lessons.grammar_topic: Pie chart va table: foiz → kasr iboralari (a quarter, just under a third), accounted for / made up, ikki pie solishtirish, jadvaldan qator/ustunni guruhlash, solishtirish aniqligi
lessons.vocab_topic: Ulush tili: proportion, share, a quarter, just under a third, the vast majority, a small fraction, accounted for, made up, doubled, a tenfold increase
lessons.book_ref: Ustoz slaydlari mazmuni (21–47-slaydlar mazmuni.md): 33–34 (solishtirma grafik), 40 (eng ko'p/eng kam, guruhlash), 44 (joy nomlari imlosi), 45 (solishtirish aniqligi), 28 (hammasini kiritmaslik). Grafik va jadvallar — Jony Academy original (matplotlib), ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan.
objectives: Pie chart va table'ni solishtirma (vaqtsiz) yoki vaqtli grafik sifatida ajratish va shunga mos til tanlash (ulush va solishtirish tili / o'zgarish tili).
Foizlarni kasr iboralari bilan almashtirish (25% — a quarter, 32% — just under a third, 76% — just over three quarters) va accounted for / made up / was made up of ni to'g'ri ishlatish.
Ikki pie chart'ni solishtirishda har sektorni alohida emas, eng katta o'zgarishlar va guruhlar (qazilma / qayta tiklanadigan) bo'yicha yozish.
Jadvalda avval eng katta va eng kichik qator/ustunni topish, qatorlarni P3/P4 ga guruhlash va hamma raqamni kiritmaslik; joy nomlari va birliklarni jadvaldagidek yozish.
'Ikki barobar', 'o'n barobar', 'yarmidan ko'proq kamaydi' kabi solishtirishlarni hisoblab tekshirish va 20 daqiqada 150+ so'zlik javob yozish (W6_T1_CLASS bo'yicha ≥ 5.5).
materials: Namuna grafigi ielts6_23_sample.png (ikki pie: 2005 va 2025) — proyektorda (Reading 1).
Sinf normativi jadvali ielts6_23_class.png (metro tizimlari, 2024) — proyektorda yoki chop etilgan (Reading 2).
Uy vazifasi grafigi ielts6_23_hw.png (pie + table) — chop etilgan yoki ilovada (Reading 3).
Doskada foiz → ibora jadvali: 25% a quarter / 33% a third / 50% half / 75% three quarters / 10% a tenth / 20% a fifth / 80%+ the vast majority.
Taymer (2' reja + 18' yozish), W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi varaqasi (har juftlikka) va W6_T1_CHECK ro'yxati.
timeline: Takrorlash
22-dars uy vazifasidan (bar chart) 1 overview o'qiladi; sinf tekshiradi: raqamsizmi, 2 asosiy xususiyat bormi, eng ko'p/eng kam aytilganmi.
Pie chart + Table: asosiy xususiyatlar (slaydlar 33–34, 40, 28)
Vaqtsiz pie/table — solishtirish; ikki yil pie — o'zgarish ham. Eng katta/eng kichik, guruhlar (qazilma / qayta tiklanadigan), hamma raqam emas. Grammatika intro 1–5 va formula jadvali.
Til banki
Foiz → kasr iboralari, accounted for / made up / was made up of (aktiv va passiv); 1-mashq (foiz → ibora) va 2-mashq (bo'shliqlar); CORE so'zlar bilan grafik haqida gap.
Namuna: grafik → reja → javob
Ikki pie (2005/2025): ustoz doskada 2 daqiqalik reja tuzadi → namuna javob o'qiladi → 'Namunani formula bilan tekshiring' (6 savol).
Sinf mashqlari
3-mashq (metro jadvalidan guruhlash) va 4-mashq (Aniqmi? — slayd 45, 'doubled' yoki 'tenfold'); W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi bilan tanishish (5-mashq).
WRITING NORMATIV — Pie chart + Table
2' reja + 18' yozish (imtihon sharoiti) → 10' juftlikda W6_T1_CLASS bilan tekshirish → 5' ustoz 1 ishni ekranda tahlil qiladi
Xulosa va vazifa
Foiz → ibora va guruhlash qoidasi takrori; uyga: aralash grafik (pie + table), 20 daqiqa, W6_T1_CHECK bilan o'z-o'zini tekshirish; til banki 8 gap.

intro: Pie chart va table ko'pincha VAQTSIZ solishtirma grafik bo'ladi (slayd 33): o'sish yoki tushish yo'q, faqat ulush va farq. Lekin ikki yil uchun ikki pie (2005 va 2025) yoki yillar ustuni bor jadval — vaqtli: unda o'zgarish tili ham kerak (fell, rose, more than halved).

FOIZ → KASR IBORASI: 25% — a quarter, 50% — half, 32% — just under a third, 48% — just under half, 76% — just over three quarters, 20% — a fifth, 10% — a tenth, 2% — a tiny fraction, 80% — the vast majority / four fifths. Ibora takrorni kamaytiradi va Lexical Resource'ni oshiradi; aniq raqamni yonida (qavsda) bering.

ULUSH FE'LLARI: X accounted for 48% of the electricity (aktiv, albatta 'for' bilan); X made up / constituted 30% of the total (aktiv); The total was made up of six sources (passiv: butun → qismlar). 'accounted 48%' va 'was made up by' — xato.

IKKI PIE SOLISHTIRISH: har sektorning o'zgarishini ketma-ket sanamang (slayd 28). Overview'da eng katta o'zgarish va guruhlar (slayd 34: qazilma va qayta tiklanadigan manbalar); P3 — kamaygan yoki barqaror sektorlar, P4 — o'sgan sektorlar.

JADVAL: avval eng katta va eng kichik qator hamda ustunni toping (slayd 40), keyin qatorlarni mantiqiy guruhlang (masalan eski va yangi tizimlar). Har qatorni har ustun bilan solishtirmang — har guruhdan 2–3 asosiy raqam yetarli; kutilmagan farq (qisqaroq tarmoq, lekin ko'proq yo'lovchi) — albatta ayting.

ANIQLIK (slayd 45): 'doubled', 'twice as many', 'tenfold' gaplarini yozishdan oldin hisoblang. 2% → 20% — o'n barobar (a tenfold increase), 'doubled' emas; 3% → 12% — to'rt barobar (quadrupled); 48% → 22% — yarmidan ko'proq kamaydi (more than halved).

IMLO VA BIRLIK (slayd 44, 43): joy nomlarini jadvaldagidek yozing (Northbridge, Eastport, Southvale); birlikni tushirmang: km, million passengers, %. Foizlar farqi — percentage points (2% → 20% = 18 percentage points).
ZAMON: o'tgan yil — past simple (accounted for, made up, was); ikki yil orasidagi natija — 'By 2025, its share had fallen to 22%' (past perfect) ham mumkin. Jadval yili 2024 bo'lsa ham past simple.
formulas: "The two pie charts compare the proportions of electricity that one country generated from six sources in 2005 and 2025."
shows → compare; sources of electricity produced → proportions of electricity generated from

presentation: Pie chart'da overview qanday topiladi?
Eng katta va eng kichik sektor, ikki pie bo'lsa — eng katta o'zgarish va guruh (masalan qazilma yoqilg'i ulushi kamaydi, qayta tiklanadigan oshdi).
Overview'da 'half', 'three quarters' yozsam bo'ladimi?
Ha, bu umumiy ulush iborasi — aniq foiz emas. Lekin 48% yoki 22% kabi aniq raqamlar P3–P4 da.
'accounted for' va 'made up' farqi bormi?
Ma'nosi bir xil: qism → butun. 'accounted for' + foiz; 'made up' + foiz; passiv 'was made up of' esa butun → qismlar.
2% dan 20% ga — necha foiz o'sdi?
18 percentage points o'sdi yoki o'n barobar ko'paydi (rose tenfold). '18% o'sdi' yoki 'doubled' — noaniq yoki xato.
Jadvalda nechta raqam yozaman?
Har guruhdan 2–3 asosiy raqam: eng katta, eng kichik va kutilmagan farq. Taxminan 8–10 ta raqam 150–180 so'zga yetarli.
Aralash topshiriqda (pie + table) qanday guruhlayman?
Overview ikkala grafikni bog'laydi; P3 — pie'dagi eng katta sabablar va ularning yosh tarkibi, P4 — qolganlari. Har grafikka alohida xatboshi shart emas.

Har javob W6_T1_CLASS bo'yicha tekshiriladi; uy vazifasida o'quvchi avval W6_T1_CHECK (9 band) bilan o'zini tekshiradi.

readings.title: NAMUNA: Pie chart (ikki yil) → reja → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (183 so'z; ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The pie charts below show the sources of electricity produced in one country in 2005 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA (2 daqiqa): O: fossil (C+G) ¾+ → ½ ↓ // renew ↑↑ (S ×10, W ×4). P3: C ↓↓ (48 → 22, >½), G ≈ (30 → 28, 2025 #1), oth ≈ (5 → 4). P4: S ×10 (2 → 20), W ×4 (3 → 12), H ↑ (12 → 14); renew 17 → 46.
text: The two pie charts compare the proportions of electricity that one country generated from six sources in 2005 and 2025.

Overall, the country relied far less on fossil fuels in 2025 than in 2005, with the combined share of coal and gas falling from just over three quarters to half. Renewable sources, especially solar and wind, grew dramatically.

In 2005, coal was by far the largest source, accounting for almost half of all electricity (48%), but by 2025 its share had more than halved to 22%. Gas, which made up just under a third of production in the first year, remained almost unchanged at 28%, becoming the largest source. Other sources constituted only a small fraction in both years, at 5% and 4% respectively.

By contrast, all three renewable sources expanded. The most striking change was in solar power, which rose from a mere 2% to a fifth, a tenfold increase. Wind power quadrupled from 3% to 12%, whereas hydroelectricity grew only slightly, from 12% to 14%. As a result, renewables produced 46% of the electricity in 2025, compared with 17% in 2005.
glossary: by far the largest — eng kattasi, katta farq bilan
more than halved — yarmidan ko'proq kamaydi
paraphrases: the proportions of electricity ... generated from six sources
in the first year / over the period / by 2025

tasks.title: Writing (yozma): WRITING NORMATIV — metro jadvali
tasks.type: Writing (yozma)
tasks.instr: 2' reja + 18' yozish, 150+ so'z, 4 xatboshi, overview raqamsiz. Keyin juftlikda W6_T1_CLASS bo'yicha baholang.
items: The table below gives information about the metro systems in five cities in 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
answers: Namuna kirish: "The table compares the metro systems of five cities in 2024 in terms of when they opened, the length of their routes, the number of stations and how many passengers they carried each year."

Namuna overview: "Overall, the two oldest systems, in Northbridge and Eastport, were by far the largest and busiest, while the three newer networks were much smaller. Interestingly, Eastport carried the most passengers even though its network was shorter than Northbridge's."
P3 (eski, katta): Northbridge — opened in 1890, 400 km, 270 stations, 1,200 million passengers; Eastport — 1935, 320 km, 210 stations, but 2,400 million passengers, twice as many as Northbridge.

P4 (yangi, kichik): Southvale (1977) — 75 km, 60 stations, 210 million; Westford (2012) — 48 km, 35 stations, 95 million; the newest, Lakeside (2019), was the smallest in every respect — 22 km, 18 stations and 40 million passengers.
why: Overview: eski/yangi guruh + Eastport'dagi kutilmagan farq, raqamsiz.
Guruhlash: P3 — 2 eski shahar, P4 — 3 yangi shahar; har qatorni har ustun bilan solishtirmaslik.
Aniqlik: 'twice as many' (2,400 / 1,200) to'g'ri; birlik (km, million passengers) va joy nomlari imlosi jadvaldagidek.

answers: Namuna overview: "Overall, work was by far the most common reason for moving to the capital, and the age of the movers depended strongly on their reason: young adults mainly came to study, people aged 25–39 mostly came for work, while those over 40 moved mainly for healthcare and family."
Guruhlash: P3 — eng katta ikki sabab (work, study) va ularning yosh tarkibi; P4 — kichikroq sabablar (family, healthcare), ularda 40+ yoshdagilar ko'pchilik; 'other' (8%) bitta qisqa eslatma bilan.
Asosiy raqamlar: work — 42% (840 kishi), ularning 65% i 25–39 yoshda; study — 23%, ularning 80% i 18–24 yoshda (the vast majority); healthcare — 9%, ularning 70% i 40+ yoshda.

normativ: 20 daqiqada 150+ so'z, overview bor, 4 mezon o'rtachasi ≥ 5.5 (W6_T1_CLASS)
Uy vazifasi: Task 1 — poytaxtga ko'chish (pie + table)

kahoot.q: 'The two pie charts show the sources of electricity in one country in 2005 and 2025.' What kind of Task 1 question is this?
options: Two pie charts compared over time
A static pie with no change at all
A map showing changes to a town
kahoot.explain: Ikki yil (2005 va 2025) bor, demak pie bo'lsa ham vaqtli grafik: ulush tili bilan birga fell, rose, more than halved kabi o'zgarish tili ham kerak.

kahoot.q: Which phrase best describes 25% of the total?
kahoot.explain: 25% = 1/4, ya'ni a quarter. A third ~33%, a fifth = 20%, a tenth = 10%.

kahoot.q: Gas made up 30% of production in 2005. Which phrase is the most accurate?
kahoot.explain: Uchdan bir ~33% — 30% undan sal kam, shuning uchun just under a third. Over a third 33% dan ko'p bo'lardi.

kahoot.q: In 2005, coal and gas together produced 78% of the electricity. Which phrase fits best?
kahoot.explain: To'rtdan uch = 75%; 78% undan sal ko'p, demak just over three quarters. Two thirds ~67% — juda uzoq.

kahoot.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Coal was accounted for 48% of it.
kahoot.explain: 'account' fe'li ulush ma'nosida faqat 'for' bilan va aktivda ishlatiladi: X accounted for 48%. 'for' siz yoki passivda — xato.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Electricity production in 2005 was made up ___ six sources.'
kahoot.explain: Passiv 'was made up of' — butun → qismlar. 'made up by' keng tarqalgan xato.

kahoot.q: Solar power rose from 2% to 20%. Which description is accurate?
kahoot.explain: 2 x 10 = 20, demak o'n barobar (tenfold). 'doubled' 4% bo'lardi; '18 per cent' emas, 18 percentage points.

kahoot.q: Wind power rose from 3% to 12%. Which verb is accurate?
kahoot.explain: 3 x 4 = 12, demak to'rt barobar — quadrupled. Hisoblamasdan yozilgan 'doubled' Task Achievement'ni tushiradi.

kahoot.q: Coal fell from 48% to 22%. Which phrase describes this change accurately?
kahoot.explain: 48 ning yarmi 24; 22 undan ham kam, demak ulush yarmidan ko'proq kamaydi — more than halved.

kahoot.q: A share rose from 2% to 20%. How should you describe the difference?
kahoot.explain: Ikki foiz orasidagi farq — percentage points: 20 - 2 = 18. '18 per cent' boshqa ma'no beradi (2% ning 18% i).

kahoot.q: What should the overview of two pie charts mainly contain?
options: The biggest change and the main groups
Every sector's figure for both years
Only the figures for the later year
A conclusion with your own opinion
kahoot.explain: Overview — eng katta o'zgarish va guruhlar (qazilma vs qayta tiklanadigan), raqamsiz. Har sektor raqami P3–P4 da; o'z fikri umuman kerak emas.

kahoot.q: Which sentence is the best overview for the two pie charts?
options: Overall, the country relied far less on fossil fuels.
Overall, coal fell from 48% to 22% in this period.
Overall, solar power rose from 2% to 20% by 2025.
Overall, I believe renewable energy is the future.
kahoot.explain: Overview guruh haqida umumiy gap bo'ladi va raqam bermaydi. Aniq raqamlar keyingi xatboshilarda; shaxsiy fikr Task 1 da yo'q.

kahoot.q: You get a table about five metro systems. What should you look for first?
options: The first row of the table only
The total of every single column
The city with the longest name
kahoot.explain: Slayd 40: avval eng katta va eng kichik qator/ustunni toping — overview shundan chiqadi.

kahoot.q: How many figures does a good table answer of 150–180 words usually need?
kahoot.explain: Har guruhdan 2–3 asosiy raqam: jami 8–10 ta yetarli. Hammasini sanash — 'key features' emas, umuman raqamsiz javob esa dalilsiz.

kahoot.q: Eastport's network was shorter than Northbridge's, but it carried twice as many passengers. What should you do with this fact?
options: Mention it as a key feature
Ignore it as a small detail
Save it for a final opinion
Give each figure its own line
kahoot.explain: Kutilmagan farq (qisqa tarmoq, lekin ko'proq yo'lovchi) — asosiy xususiyat: overview'da umumiy, P3 da raqam bilan ayting.

kahoot.q: How should you group the five metro systems in paragraphs 3 and 4?
options: Old, large systems vs new, small ones
In alphabetical order of city names
One paragraph for each table column
One paragraph for each single city
kahoot.explain: Mantiqiy guruh: P3 — Northbridge va Eastport (eski, katta), P4 — Southvale, Westford, Lakeside (yangi, kichik).

kahoot.q: The table lists 'Northbridge'. Which sentence is correct?
kahoot.explain: Slayd 44: joy nomini jadvaldagidek yozing (Northbridge), o'tgan voqea — past simple (opened).

kahoot.q: The table shows data for 2024. Which tense should you mainly use?
kahoot.explain: 2024 — o'tgan yil, shuning uchun past simple: carried, had, was. Ikki yil orasidagi natija uchun past perfect ham mumkin.

kahoot.q: Choose the best linker: 'Coal fell sharply, ___ solar power rose tenfold.'
kahoot.explain: 'whereas' ikki qarama-qarshi faktni solishtiradi (holbuki). because — sabab, so that — maqsad, therefore — natija (vergul bilan ikki gapni bog'lay olmaydi).

kahoot.q: Which word is a formal synonym of 'made up' in 'Hydropower ___ 14% of the total in 2025'?
kahoot.explain: 'constituted 14%' = 'made up 14%' (qism → butun). 'consisted of' esa butun → qismlar ma'nosida; 'contained' va 'included' butun → qism ma'nosini beradi, bu yerda mos emas.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (6): Process diagram — bosqichlar, passiv va ketma-ketlik
lessons.grammar_topic: Process diagram: bosqichlarni sanash (overview), present simple passive, ketma-ketlik bog'lovchilari (first, next, once, after which, finally), sun'iy (man-made) va tabiiy (natural) jarayon, tarmoqlanuvchi jarayon
lessons.vocab_topic: Jarayon tili: is collected, is transported, is sorted, is melted, is spun, is woven; first, next, once, after which, at the following stage, finally; consists of, stages
lessons.book_ref: Ustoz slaydlari mazmuni (21–47-slaydlar mazmuni.md): 32 (jarayonda trend yo'q), 34 (bosqichdagi material/uskuna), 35 (bosqichlar soni, 'appears to be'), 26 (izoh bermaslik). Diagrammalar — Jony Academy original (matplotlib: to'rtburchaklar, strelkalar, sodda shakllar; tayyor clipart yo'q).
objectives: Process diagram turini aniqlash: sun'iy (man-made) yoki tabiiy (natural), chiziqli yoki sikl, tarmoqlanuvchi jarayon.
Overview yozish: jarayon turi + bosqichlar soni + boshlanish va oxir; sanash qiyin bo'lsa 'appears to consist of' (slayd 35).
Har bosqichni present simple passive bilan tasvirlash (is collected, are melted, is woven) va diagrammadagi material, harorat, vaqtni aniq berish (slayd 34).
Ketma-ketlik bog'lovchilarini takrorlamasdan ishlatish (first, next, once, after which, at the following stage, finally) va ikki gapni bitta murakkab gapga birlashtirish.
Jarayonni P3/P4 ga mantiqiy bo'lib, 20 daqiqada 150+ so'zlik javob yozish va uni W6_T1_CLASS bo'yicha juftlikda baholash; trend tili va izoh ishlatmaslik (slaydlar 32, 26).
materials: Namuna diagramma: ielts6_24_sample.png (plastik butilkadan kiyim, 9 bosqich) — proyektorda.
Sinf normativi diagrammasi: ielts6_24_class.png (ipak qurti va ipak mato) — har juftlikka chop etilgan yoki ekranda.
Uy vazifasi diagrammasi: ielts6_24_hw.png (qora choy) — o'quvchi ilovasida.
Taymer: 2' reja + 18' yozish; doskada ketma-ketlik so'zlari ro'yxati (first → next → once → after which → at the following stage → finally).
W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi varaqasi (har juftlikka) va W6_T1_CHECK ro'yxati (uy vazifasi uchun).
timeline: Takrorlash
23-dars uy vazifasidan 1 overview o'qiladi; sinf tekshiradi: raqamsizmi, 2 asosiy xususiyat bormi?
Process diagram: asosiy xususiyatlar (slaydlar 32, 34, 35, 26)
Jarayonda trend yo'q (32); overview = tur + bosqichlar soni + boshlanish va oxir (35, 'appears to'); har bosqichdagi material va uskuna (34); izoh bermaslik (26). 3-mashq: 5 diagramma uchun overview.
Til banki: passiv va ketma-ketlik
20 so'z (CORE → STRONG → SUPER) namuna diagramma bo'yicha; 1-mashq: aktiv → passiv (8 gap).
Namuna: grafik → reja → javob
Plastik butilka diagrammasi: sinf bosqichlarni sanaydi (9) → ustoz doskada 2 daqiqalik reja tuzadi → namuna o'qiladi → 6 savol bilan formula tekshiriladi.
Sinf mashqlari
2-mashq (ketma-ketlik, 8') → 4-mashq (ikki gapni bitta qilish, 8') → W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasini o'qib chiqish (4').
WRITING NORMATIV — Process diagram
2' reja + 18' yozish (imtihon sharoiti) → 10' juftlikda W6_T1_CLASS bilan tekshirish → 5' ustoz 1 ishni ekranda tahlil qiladi
Xulosa va vazifa
Jarayon formulasi takrorlanadi (tur + bosqichlar soni + boshi/oxiri); uyga qora choy diagrammasi (20 daqiqa) + W6_T1_CHECK + til banki gaplari.

intro: PROCESS DIAGRAM — Task 1 ning uchinchi turi: grafikda raqamlar o'zgarmaydi, balki biror narsa qanday yasalishi (man-made: shisha, choy, kiyim) yoki tabiatda qanday rivojlanishi (natural: hayot sikli, suv aylanishi) bosqichma-bosqich ko'rsatiladi.
Jarayonda TREND YO'Q (slayd 32): rose, fell, peaked, remained stable kabi trend tilini ishlatmang. Uning o'rniga — bosqichlar tili: is collected, is then heated, at the following stage.

OVERVIEW (slayd 35) — uch narsa: 1) jarayon turi (sun'iy yoki tabiiy, chiziqli yoki sikl); 2) bosqichlar soni; 3) qayerdan boshlanib, nima bilan tugashi. Bosqichlarni aniq sanab bo'lmasa: 'appears to consist of about nine stages'.

Har bosqichdagi MATERIAL va USKUNA (slayd 34) — detal xatboshilarining asosi: diagrammadagi harorat (260°C), vaqt (12–18 hours), joy (a recycling plant) va material (flakes, fibres, yarn) albatta aytiladi.

PRESENT SIMPLE PASSIVE — jarayonning asosiy grammatikasi, chunki kim qilgani muhim emas: The bottles ARE COLLECTED. The yarn IS WOVEN into fabric. Tabiiy jarayonda esa ko'pincha aktiv: The larva feeds on leaves. A moth emerges.
KETMA-KETLIK so'zlari takrorlanmasin: First → Next → Once ... → after which → At the following stage → Subsequently → Finally. Bir xil 'then' ni 5 marta yozish Coherence bandini tushiradi.

IZOH BERMANG (slayd 26): faqat diagrammadagi fakt. 'The flakes are melted because plastic is cheaper' — xato, diagrammada sabab yo'q. Maqsad strelkada yozilgan bo'lsa ('to form fibres'), uni aytish mumkin.

TABIIY SIKL va TARMOQ: sikl oxirida 'The cycle then begins again.' Tarmoqlanuvchi jarayonda (ipak qurti) ayriluvchi nuqtani aniq ayting: 'At this point, the cocoon either develops into a moth or is boiled...'. P3 — sikl, P4 — undan ajralgan ishlab chiqarish.
formulas: "The diagram illustrates the stages by which empty plastic bottles are turned into new clothes."
shows → illustrates; how ... are recycled → the stages by which ... are turned into
Tur + bosqichlar soni + boshlanish va oxir, raqamsiz
"Overall, this is a man-made, linear process that consists of nine stages, beginning with ... and ending with ..."
"The system appears to consist of six main stages."
Detal xatboshilari shu songa mos kelsa, xato emas
Jarayonning birinchi yarmi yoki tabiiy sikl
"First, used bottles are collected... Once they arrive, they are sorted by colour and type."
Mantiqiy guruh: tayyorlash / ishlab chiqarish, sikl / mahsulot
"Next, the flakes are melted at about 260°C... Finally, the yarn is woven into fabric."
Material, harorat va vaqtni tushirib qoldirmang (slayd 34)
after which / before being / once / where / in order to
"They are sorted by colour, after which they are washed."
Murakkab gap — GRA bandini oshiradi, takror kamayadi
presentation: Process diagram'da overview nima haqida?
Trend emas, bosqichlar: tur (man-made / natural), bosqichlar soni va boshi-oxiri. Masalan: 'a nine-stage linear process, beginning with ... and ending with ...'.
Bosqichlarni aniq sanay olmasam-chi?
'appears to consist of' yoki 'there appear to be' ishlating (slayd 35). Detal xatboshilari shu sonni qo'llab-quvvatlasa, examiner xato hisoblamaydi.
Nega passiv?
Jarayonda kim qilgani ahamiyatsiz, nima qilingani muhim: 'Workers wash the bottles' emas, 'The bottles are washed'. Tabiiy jarayonda aktiv ham to'g'ri: 'A moth emerges'.
Diagrammada sabab yozilmagan bo'lsa, o'zim qo'shsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q (slayd 26). Faqat diagrammada bor narsa: material, uskuna, harorat, vaqt. Sabab qo'shish — Task Achievement xatosi.
P3 va P4 ni qanday bo'laman?
Mantiqiy ikki yarim: tayyorlash va ishlab chiqarish; tabiiy sikl va undan ajralgan mahsulot; zavoddagi va do'kondagi bosqichlar. Imkon qadar 50/50.
Tabiiy sikl qanday tugaydi?
Sikl yopiladi: 'The adult moth lays 300–500 eggs, and the cycle then begins again.' Bu gap overview'da ham, P3 oxirida ham bo'lishi mumkin.
notes: Bosqichlarni sanashni sinf bilan birga qiling: doskada 1, 2, 3... deb belgilang — overview'dagi son detal xatboshilarida qo'llab-quvvatlanishi kerak.
Normativ ishlarini tekshirganda birinchi savol: overview'da bosqichlar soni va boshi-oxiri bormi? Trend so'zi (increase, rose) bo'lsa — darhol belgilang.
Uchta diagramma ham Jony Academy original chizmasi; jarayon raqamlari (260°C, 300–500 eggs, 12–18 hours) mashq uchun soddalashtirilgan.
mistakes: The number of bottles increases at stage 3.
The bottles are sorted by colour and type.
Overall, the bottles are melted at 260°C.
Overall, this is a nine-stage man-made process, beginning with ... and ending with ...
Overview'da raqam va detal emas, tur + son + boshi/oxiri
The flakes melted. / The yarn weaves into fabric.
The flakes are melted. / The yarn is woven into fabric.
Sun'iy jarayonda present simple passive; III shakl: spun, woven
First ... Next ... Once ... after which ... Finally ...
Bir xil bog'lovchi — Coherence & Cohesion pasayadi
The bottles are shredded because small flakes melt faster.
The bottles are shredded into small flakes.

how: CORE — har process javobida keladigan passiv fe'llar va asosiy bog'lovchilar; STRONG — material va mahsulot nomlari, ishlab chiqarish fe'llari; SUPER — Band 7 uchun murakkab ketma-ketlik iboralari.
Namuna diagrammadagi har bosqich uchun bitta so'z bilan gap tuzing; oxirida 9 gapni ketma-ketlik so'zlari bilan bitta xatboshiga ulang.

Ishlatilgan butilkalar qayta ishlash qutilaridan yig'iladi.

Butilkalar yuk mashinasida qayta ishlash zavodiga tashiladi.

Zavodda butilkalar rangi va turi bo'yicha saralanadi.
The flakes are melted at about 260°C.
First, the bottles are collected from recycling bins.
Avval butilkalar qayta ishlash qutilaridan yig'iladi.

Nihoyat, ip matoga to'qiladi va kiyim tikiladi.

The fibres are spun into yarn.
The yarn is woven into fabric.
The bottles are turned into small plastic flakes.
Liquid plastic is forced through tiny holes to form fibres.
Suyuq plastik tola hosil qilish uchun mayda teshiklardan o'tkaziladi.

Og'zaki: namuna diagrammaning 9 bosqichini passiv va 5 xil ketma-ketlik so'zi bilan to'xtovsiz aytib berish — +1 coin.

A machine shreds the clean bottles into small flakes.

The bottles are taken to a recycling plant by lorry.

The fibres are spun into yarn.

'by lorry' — transport turi diagrammada bor, shuning uchun qoladi.
Ijrochi (staff) ahamiyatsiz — tushiriladi.
shred → shredded (oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi).

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Ketma-ketlik — bosqichlarni tartiblang va bog'lang
class_ex.instr: Qog'ozni qayta ishlash jarayonining 8 bosqichi aralash berilgan. To'g'ri tartibni toping va har gapni boshqa-boshqa ketma-ketlik so'zi bilan boshlang (first, next, once, after that, at the following stage, subsequently, then, finally).
items: A — the pulp is cleaned and the ink is removed
B — used paper is collected from homes and offices
C — it is dried and made into large rolls
D — it is sorted into different grades
E — the rolls are cut and sent to shops as new paper
F — it is taken to a recycling centre
G — it is pressed between rollers to remove the water
H — it is mixed with water and chemicals to make pulp
answers: 1 — B: First, used paper is collected from homes and offices.
2 — F: Next, it is taken to a recycling centre.
3 — D: Once it arrives, it is sorted into different grades.
4 — H: After that, it is mixed with water and chemicals to make pulp.
5 — A: At the following stage, the pulp is cleaned and the ink is removed.
6 — G: Subsequently, it is pressed between rollers to remove the water.
7 — C: It is then dried and made into large rolls.
8 — E: Finally, the rolls are cut and sent to shops as new paper.
why: Jarayon har doim xomashyoni yig'ishdan boshlanadi.
Joy o'zgarishi — 'Next' yetarli.
'Once it arrives' — oldingi bosqich bilan bog'laydi.
Pulp bo'lmasa, uni tozalab bo'lmaydi — mantiq tartibni beradi.
Band 7 iborasi: 'At the following stage'.
'Subsequently' — 'then' ning rasmiyroq varianti.
'then' gap o'rtasida — boshida takrorlanmaydi.
Oxirgi bosqich — 'Finally'; mahsulot iste'molchiga yetadi.
class_ex.note: Javoblar to'g'ri tartibda berilgan (1–8). Ketma-ketlik so'zlari boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin — asosiysi, bittasi ham takrorlanmasin.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Overview yozing — bosqichlarni sanang (slayd 35)
class_ex.instr: Har diagramma tavsifi uchun: 1) turi (man-made / natural, chiziqli / sikl); 2) bosqichlar soni; 3) boshi va oxiri — bitta gaplik overview yozing. Soni noaniq bo'lsa 'appears to' ishlating.
items: Diagram A — how bricks are made: clay dug from the ground → sieved → mixed with sand and water → shaped in moulds → dried for 24–48 hours → heated in a kiln → cooled → packed and delivered.
Diagram B — the life cycle of a frog: eggs → tadpole → tadpole with legs → young frog → adult frog, which lays eggs (arrow back to the start).

Diagram C — rainwater collection in a village: rain falls on roofs → flows through pipes → stored in an underground tank → filtered → pumped to a container → used for drinking (two arrows are unclear).
Diagram D — how orange juice is produced: oranges picked → washed → squeezed → juice heated → packed into cartons → delivered to supermarkets.
Diagram E — the water cycle: water evaporates from the sea → forms clouds → falls as rain → flows back to the sea through rivers.
answers: Overall, brick production is a man-made, linear process consisting of eight stages, from digging clay out of the ground to delivering the finished bricks.
Overall, the frog's life cycle is a natural process with five main stages, beginning with eggs and ending with an adult frog, after which the cycle begins again.
Overall, the rainwater system appears to consist of six main stages, beginning with rain falling on roofs and ending with clean water being used for drinking.
Overall, orange juice is made in a six-stage man-made process, which starts with picking the fruit and ends with delivering the cartons to supermarkets.
Overall, the water cycle is a natural, continuous process of four stages, in which sea water rises as vapour, falls as rain and returns to the sea.
why: 8 bosqich aniq sanaladi; tur + son + boshi/oxiri — uchala qism bor.
Tabiiy sikl → 'the cycle begins again'.
Ikki strelka noaniq → 'appears to consist of' (slayd 35).
'a six-stage process' — sonni sifat sifatida berish (defis bilan, 'stages' emas 'stage').
Sikl — boshi yo'q; overview'da aylana yopilishini ayting.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Ikki gapni bitta qiling
class_ex.instr: Qavsdagi bog'lovchi bilan ikki gapni bitta murakkab gapga aylantiring. Ma'no va zamon o'zgarmasin.
items: The bottles are washed. Then their labels are removed. (after which)
The flakes are dried. Then they are melted. (before being)
The tea leaves arrive at the factory. They are spread out to wither. (once)
The bottles are taken to a recycling plant. There they are sorted by colour. (where)
The liquid plastic is forced through tiny holes. This forms fibres. (in order to)
The tea is sorted by size. Then it is packed. (before being)
answers: The bottles are washed, after which their labels are removed.
The flakes are dried before being melted.
Once the tea leaves arrive at the factory, they are spread out to wither.
The bottles are taken to a recycling plant, where they are sorted by colour.
The liquid plastic is forced through tiny holes in order to form fibres.
The tea is sorted by size before being packed.
why: 'after which' oldidan vergul; ikkinchi gap butunligicha qoladi.
'before being' + III shakl — ega bir xil bo'lsa, ikkinchi 'they are' tushadi.
'Once' — ergash gap boshida, keyin vergul.
'where' — joyga ishora qiluvchi relative clause; 'There' o'rniga.
Maqsad diagramma strelkasida yozilgan ('to form fibres') — shuning uchun izoh emas, fakt.
Gaplar qisqaradi, takror yo'qoladi — GRA va CC bandlari uchun foydali.
