readings.title: NAMUNA: Process diagram → reja → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (166 so'z; ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The diagram below shows how used plastic bottles are recycled to make clothing. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA (2 daqiqa): TUR: man-made, chiziqli // 9 bosqich // boshi: yig'ish → oxiri: kiyim. P3: 1–5 (tayyorlash: collect → lorry → sort → wash → shred). P4: 6–9 (ishlab chiqarish: melt 260°C → fibres → yarn → fabric/clothes). Bog'lovchilar: First / Once / after which / At the following stage / Next / Subsequently / Finally.
text: The diagram illustrates the stages by which empty plastic bottles are turned into new clothes.

Overall, this is a man-made, linear process that consists of nine stages, beginning with the collection of used bottles and ending with the production of finished garments. The first five steps prepare the plastic, whereas the last four convert it into fibres, yarn and fabric.

First, used bottles are collected from recycling bins and then transported by lorry to a recycling plant. Once they arrive, they are sorted by colour and type, after which they are washed and their labels are removed. At the following stage, the clean bottles are shredded into small flakes, which marks the end of the preparation phase.

Next, these flakes are melted at a temperature of about 260°C, and the liquid plastic is forced through tiny holes in order to form fibres. Subsequently, the fibres are spun into yarn. Finally, the yarn is woven into fabric, which is then made into clothes ready to be worn.
paraphrases: the stages by which ... are turned into

tasks.title: Namunani formula bilan tekshiring
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Diagramma va rejaga qarab javob bering.
items: Overview'da qaysi uch ma'lumot bor?
Nega P3 da 1–5-bosqichlar, P4 da 6–9-bosqichlar?
Javobdan 4 ta passiv fe'lni toping.
Qaysi ketma-ketlik so'zlari ishlatilgan? Birortasi takrorlanganmi?
Diagrammadagi harorat javobning qaysi gapida?
Javobda trend tili (rose, increased) yoki izoh (because ...) bormi? Nega?
answers: Tur (man-made, linear), bosqichlar soni (nine stages), boshi va oxiri (collection of used bottles → finished garments)
1–5 — plastikni tayyorlash (yig'ish, tashish, saralash, yuvish, maydalash); 6–9 — undan mahsulot yasash (eritish, tola, ip, mato va kiyim)
are collected, are sorted, are shredded, are melted, is forced, are spun, is woven (istalgan 4 tasi)
First, Once, after which, At the following stage, Next, Subsequently, Finally — har biri bir marta
"these flakes are melted at a temperature of about 260°C"
Yo'q — jarayonda trend yo'q (slayd 32), sabab diagrammada ko'rsatilmagan (slayd 26)
why: Slayd 35: process overview — bosqichlar; raqam (260°C) overview'da yo'q.
Guruhlash 5/4 — imkon qadar 50/50 va mantiqiy: material tayyorlanadi, keyin mahsulotga aylanadi.
Present simple passive — sun'iy jarayonning asosiy grammatikasi.
Takrorsiz bog'lovchilar — CC bandi 6 dan 7 ga ko'tarilishi uchun.
Slayd 34: bosqichdagi material va sharoit (harorat) — asosiy detal.
'in order to form fibres' — izoh emas, chunki maqsad diagramma strelkasida yozilgan.

tasks.title: Writing (yozma): WRITING NORMATIV — ipak qurti va ipak mato
tasks.type: Writing (yozma)
tasks.instr: 2' reja + 18' yozish, 150+ so'z, 4 xatboshi. Overview: ikki qism (tabiiy sikl va ishlab chiqarish), bosqichlar soni, boshi va oxiri — raqamsiz. Yozgach sherik bilan almashing va W6_T1_CLASS bo'yicha baholang.
items: The diagram below shows the life cycle of the silkworm and the stages in the production of silk cloth. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
answers: Kirish: The diagram illustrates how silkworms develop from eggs into moths and how their cocoons are used to make silk cloth.

Overview: Overall, the diagram consists of a natural life cycle with four main stages and a three-stage man-made process which branches off from it at the cocoon stage and ends with the production of silk cloth.

P3 (hayot sikli): The cycle begins with eggs, which hatch after about 10 days. The larva, or silkworm, then feeds on mulberry leaves for four to six weeks before it spins a cocoon, which takes two to three days. After about two weeks, a moth emerges and lays between 300 and 500 eggs, and the cycle begins again.
P4 (ipak ishlab chiqarish): Alternatively, at the cocoon stage, the cocoons are boiled, after which the threads are unwound. Finally, these threads are spun and woven into silk cloth.
why: Overview'da ikki qism va bosqichlar soni bormi (4 + 3), raqam yo'qmi?
Vaqtlar to'g'rimi: 10 days, 4–6 weeks, 2–3 days, about 2 weeks; 300–500 eggs — P3 da; tabiiy bosqichlar aktiv (feeds, spins, emerges), ishlab chiqarish passiv (are boiled, are unwound)?
Ayriluvchi nuqta aniq aytilganmi (at the cocoon stage / alternatively) va sikl yopilganmi (the cycle begins again)?

readings.title: Uy vazifasi grafigi: How black tea is produced
readings.qtype: Process diagram (8 bosqich, chiziqli) — uy vazifasi
readings.source: Jony Academy diagrammasi (ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The diagram below shows how black tea is produced. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

homework_intro: Bugun process diagram formulasini o'rgandik: overview = tur + bosqichlar soni + boshi va oxiri; har bosqich present simple passive bilan; ketma-ketlik so'zlari takrorlanmaydi; trend tili va izoh yo'q.
Birinchi vazifa — qora choy diagrammasi (uchinchi rasm): 2' reja + 18' yozish, 150+ so'z, 4 xatboshi. Vaqt va harorat raqamlarini tushirib qoldirmang.
Ikkinchi vazifa — yozib bo'lgach, W6_T1_CHECK ro'yxatining 9 bandiga 'Ha' yoki 'Yo'q' qo'ying; 'Yo'q' chiqqan joyni tuzating.
Uchinchi vazifa — til banki: CORE va SUPER ro'yxatidan 8 ta so'z bilan qora choy jarayoni haqida 8 gap.

homework.title: Writing (yozma): Task 1 — How black tea is produced
homework.instr: readings[2] grafigi: 2' reja + 18' yozish, 150+ so'z, 4 xatboshi, overview raqamsiz; yozgach W6_T1_CHECK bo'yicha o'zingizni tekshiring.
answers: Namuna overview: Overall, black tea is produced in a linear, man-made process of eight stages, beginning with picking the leaves by hand and ending with shipping the packed tea to shops.
Guruhlash: P3 — 1–4-bosqichlar, barg bilan ishlash (picked by hand → withered → rolled → oxidised); P4 — 5–8-bosqichlar, tayyor choy (dried → sorted by size → packed → shipped to shops).
Asosiy raqamlar: the leaves are withered for 12–18 hours (va oxidised for 1–3 hours); the tea is dried at about 120°C.

homework.title: Writing (yozma): o'z-o'zini tekshirish (W6_T1_CHECK)
homework.instr: Uy vazifasi javobingizni 9 savol bo'yicha tekshiring: har qatorga 'Ha' yoki 'Yo'q' yozing. Process diagram'da 4-band: harorat (°C) va vaqt (hours) to'g'ri; 8-band: present passive.
head: Savol
Ha / Yo'q
Mezon
rows: Kirish savolni o'z so'zlarim bilan aytadi (savoldan 3 tadan ko'p so'z aynan emas)?
Overview 2-xatboshida, raqamsiz, 2 ta asosiy xususiyat bilan?
Ma'lumot P3 va P4 ga mantiqiy guruhlangan?
Har asosiy xususiyat raqam bilan; birlik (%, million, km, °C) va valyuta to'g'ri?
Izoh yoki sabab yozilmagan — faqat grafikdagi fakt?
Bog'lovchilar xilma-xil (while, whereas, by contrast, respectively, after which)?
Ikki shakl ham bor: fe'l + ravish va sifat + ot?
Zamon to'g'ri: o'tgan — past, kelajak — will / is expected to, jarayon — present passive?
homework.answers: 9 banddan kamida 7 tasi 'Ha' bo'lsa — normativ bajarildi. 'Yo'q' chiqqan bandni tuzatib, javobni qayta yuboring.

homework.title: Writing (yozma): Til banki — 8 gap
homework.instr: CORE va SUPER ro'yxatidan 8 ta so'z (kamida 3 ta SUPER) bilan qora choy jarayoni haqida 8 gap yozing. Har gapda passiv fe'l bo'lsin.
answers: First, the tea leaves are picked by hand.
Once they are collected, they are withered for 12–18 hours.
The leaves are rolled, after which they are oxidised for one to three hours.
At the following stage, the tea is dried at about 120°C.
The dried tea is subsequently sorted by size.
Finally, the packed tea is shipped to shops.
The whole process consists of eight stages.

kahoot.q: 'The diagram shows how plastic bottles are recycled into clothes.' Which type of Task 1 is this?
kahoot.explain: "How ... are recycled" — vaqt bo'yicha o'zgarish emas, bosqichlar ketma-ketligi, ya'ni jarayon (process diagram).

kahoot.q: Which kind of language should you NOT use to describe a process diagram?
options: Trend verbs like rose or peaked
kahoot.explain: Jarayonda raqamlar o'zgarmaydi, demak trend tili (rose, fell, peaked) noto'g'ri; bosqichlar tili kerak (slayd 32).

kahoot.q: Which sentence is the best overview of the bottle-to-clothes diagram?
options: Overall, it is a nine-stage process, from collection to clothes.
Overall, the flakes are melted at about 260°C.
The diagram illustrates how empty plastic bottles become new clothes.
Overall, recycling is good because it saves plastic.
kahoot.explain: Overview = tur + bosqichlar soni + boshi va oxiri, raqamsiz. '260°C' li gap — detal, 'The diagram illustrates...' — kirish (paraphrase), 'because it saves plastic' — izoh.

kahoot.q: Which THREE things does a process overview mention?
options: Type, number of stages, start and end
Every material, tool and temperature shown
kahoot.explain: Slayd 35: jarayon turi (sun'iy/tabiiy, chiziqli/sikl), bosqichlar soni va qayerdan boshlanib nima bilan tugashi.

kahoot.q: You cannot count the stages exactly. Which phrase is the safest?
options: The process appears to consist of six stages.
The process definitely has six stages.
The process is increasing in six stages.
The process has many different stages, maybe.
kahoot.explain: 'Appears to consist of' — aniq sanab bo'lmaganda himoyalangan ifoda (slayd 35); 'maybe' norasmiy, 'increasing' — trend tili.

kahoot.q: Choose the correct sentence for a man-made process.
options: The bottles are collected from bins.
The bottles are collect from bins.
The bottles were collecting from bins.
kahoot.explain: Sun'iy jarayonda present simple passive: am/is/are + III shakl (collected). Jarayon har doim takrorlanadi, shuning uchun present.

kahoot.q: The yarn is ___ into fabric.
kahoot.explain: Weave — noto'g'ri fe'l: weave – wove – woven. Passivda III shakl kerak: is woven.

kahoot.q: The fibres are ___ into yarn.
kahoot.explain: Spin – spun – spun. 'Spinned' degan shakl yo'q; 'span' — eski II shakl, passivda ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: In a natural process, which sentence is correct and natural?
options: A moth emerges from the cocoon.
A moth is emerged from the cocoon.
A moth is emerging by the cocoon.
A moth emerged by the cocoon.
kahoot.explain: Tabiiy jarayonda ko'pincha aktiv ishlatiladi: emerge — o'timsiz fe'l, passivi bo'lmaydi; vaqt — present simple.

kahoot.q: Which sequence avoids repeating the same linker?
options: And ... And ... And then ... And then ...
kahoot.explain: Bir xil bog'lovchini takrorlash Coherence and Cohesion bandini tushiradi; turli ketma-ketlik so'zlari kerak.

kahoot.q: ___ the bottles arrive at the plant, they are sorted by colour.
kahoot.explain: 'Once' — "... bilanoq": birinchi harakat tugashi bilan ikkinchisi boshlanadi. 'After which' gap boshida emas, verguldan keyin keladi.

kahoot.q: The bottles are washed, ___ their labels are removed.
kahoot.explain: '..., after which' ikki gapni bitta murakkab gapga bog'laydi ("shundan so'ng"). 'After that' alohida gap boshlaydi.

kahoot.q: They are washed before ___ into flakes.
kahoot.explain: 'Before' predlog sifatida -ing talab qiladi; passivda: before being + III shakl (being shredded).

kahoot.q: Liquid plastic is forced through tiny holes ___ form fibres.
kahoot.explain: Maqsad strelkada yozilgan bo'lsa, 'in order to + fe'l' bilan aytiladi. 'For to' — xato, 'because of' esa ot talab qiladi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence breaks the 'no comment' rule for Task 1?
options: Flakes are melted because it is cheaper.
Next, the flakes are melted down.
kahoot.explain: Diagrammada sabab yo'q — 'because it is cheaper' o'zingizdan qo'shilgan izoh, Task Achievement pasayadi (slayd 26).

kahoot.q: Bottles → flakes → fibres → ___ → fabric. Which word fits the gap?
kahoot.explain: Tolalar (fibres) yigiriladi va ip — yarn hosil bo'ladi; ip to'qilib mato (fabric) bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: A life cycle ends with the adult laying eggs. How do you close the description?
options: The cycle reaches a peak again.
kahoot.explain: Tabiiy sikl yopiladi: 'The cycle then begins again.' 'Increases' va 'reaches a peak' — trend tili, jarayonga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

kahoot.q: In the silkworm diagram, the cocoon either becomes a moth or is boiled. What should you do?
kahoot.explain: Tarmoqlanuvchi jarayonda ayriluvchi nuqtani aniq ayting: 'At this point, the cocoon either develops into a moth or is boiled...'.

kahoot.q: How should you divide the details into Paragraphs 3 and 4?
options: Into two logical groups of stages
Numbers in P3, words in P4
Man-made in P3, opinion in P4
kahoot.explain: Bosqichlarni mantiqiy ikki guruhga bo'ling (tayyorlash / ishlab chiqarish yoki sikl / mahsulot), imkon qadar 50/50.

kahoot.q: The process ___ nine stages.
kahoot.explain: 'Consist of' — "... dan iborat"; passivi yo'q (is consisted — xato), predlogi faqat 'of'.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (7): Map — joylashuv, o'zgarishlar va kirish shablonlari
lessons.grammar_topic: Map: joylashuv va yo'nalish (to the north of, adjacent to, opposite, alongside), o'zgarish passivi (was demolished, was replaced by, was converted into, made way for), o'tgan va kelajak (taklif qilingan) xaritalar, kirish shablonlari; Task 1 blok yakuni
lessons.vocab_topic: Xarita tili: north-east, adjacent to, opposite, alongside, was demolished, was replaced by, was converted into, was extended, made way for, remained unchanged, is to be built
lessons.book_ref: Ustoz slaydlari mazmuni (21–47-slaydlar mazmuni.md): 26–28 (uchta tipik xato), 34 (xaritada eski va yangi holat farqi), 44 (joy nomlari imlosi), 47 (kirish shablonlari). Xaritalar — Jony Academy original (matplotlib: sodda shakllar, kompas, inglizcha yorliqlar), joy nomlari to'qilgan.
objectives: Xarita topshirig'ining ikki ko'rinishini ajratish: ikki davr (o'tgan → hozir) yoki hozirgi holat va taklif (kelajak) — ko'rinish fe'l zamonini belgilaydi.

Kirishni shablon bilan 1 gapda yozish: "The maps illustrate the changes that took place in ... between ... and ..." / "The plans compare the present layout of ... with the proposed changes" (slayd 47).
Overview'da eng katta 2 o'zgarishni va hududning umumiy xarakterini (more residential, urbanised) raqamsiz berish; P3 va P4 ni xaritaning qismi bo'yicha guruhlash.

Joylashuv (to the north of, adjacent to, opposite, alongside) va o'zgarish passivini (o'tgan — was/were + V3, kelajak — will be / is to be + V3) to'g'ri ishlatish; joy nomlarini xaritadagidek yozish (slayd 44).
Uchta tipik xatodan (izoh, overview + xulosa, hammasini sanash — slaydlar 26–28) qochib, 20 daqiqada 150+ so'zlik xarita javobini yozish, W6_T1_CLASS bo'yicha baholash va Task 1 blokini yakunlash.
materials: ielts6_25_sample.png — Greenbank daryo bo'yi xaritalari (2000 va 2025): proyektorda yoki chop etilgan.
ielts6_25_class.png — kollej kampusi rejasi (hozir va taklif): har o'quvchiga chop etilgan (WRITING NORMATIV).
ielts6_25_hw.png — ko'l bo'yidagi qishloq xaritalari (1990 va 2025): uy vazifasi uchun chop etilgan.
Taymer (2' reja + 18' yozish); doskada kompas: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW.
W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi varaqasi (har juftlikka), W6_T1_CHECK ro'yxati va Task 1 blok bandlari jadvali (21–25-darslar uy vazifalari).
timeline: Takrorlash
24-dars uy vazifasidan 1 overview o'qiladi; sinf tekshiradi: 2 asosiy xususiyat bormi, raqam va izoh yo'qmi?
Map: asosiy xususiyatlar (slaydlar 26–28, 34, 44, 47)
Xaritada trend yo'q — eski va yangi holat farqi (34); ikki ko'rinish: o'tgan → hozir va hozir → taklif; kirish shablonlari (47); joy nomlari imlosi (44); uchta tipik xato (26–28).
Til banki
Kompas yo'nalishlari, joylashuv iboralari, o'zgarish passivi (vocab); 1-mashq (Qayerda?) namuna xaritasi bo'yicha og'zaki.
Namuna: grafik → reja → javob
Greenbank xaritasi: ustoz doskada 2 daqiqalik reja tuzadi (O / P3 shimoliy qirg'oq / P4 janubiy qirg'oq va ko'priklar); namuna o'qiladi va 'Namunani formula bilan tekshiring' savollari.
Sinf mashqlari
2-mashq (o'zgarish fe'li) 6' → 3-mashq (kampus rejasi, kelajak passivi) 6' → 4-mashq (uchta xato) 6' → W6_T1_CLASS rubrikasi bilan tanishish 2'.
WRITING NORMATIV — Map
2' reja + 18' yozish (imtihon sharoiti) → 10' juftlikda W6_T1_CLASS bilan tekshirish → 5' ustoz 1 ishni ekranda tahlil qiladi
Xulosa va vazifa
Task 1 blok yakuni: har o'quvchi 21–25-darslar uy vazifalari bandlarini W6_T1_CLASS bo'yicha jadvalga yozadi va eng zaif mezonni belgilaydi (6'); uy vazifasi tushuntiriladi (4').

intro: Xarita (map) — Task 1 ning to'rtinchi turi. Ikki ko'rinishi bor: 1) IKKI DAVR — o'tgan va hozirgi (yoki ikki o'tgan yil) xarita: "in 2000 and 2025"; 2) HOZIR va TAKLIF — hozirgi reja va kelgusi o'zgarishlar: "at present and the proposed changes". Ko'rinish fe'l zamonini belgilaydi.
Xaritada trend (o'sish yoki tushish) yo'q — asosiy xususiyat ESKI va YANGI holat FARQI (slayd 34): nima buzildi, nima qurildi, nima kengaydi, nima o'zgarmadi.

KIRISH SHABLONLARI (slayd 47): o'tgan → hozir: "The maps illustrate the changes that took place in [joy] between [yil] and [yil]." Taklif: "The plans compare the present layout of [joy] with the proposed changes for [vaqt]." Kirish rejalashtirilmaydi — shablon bilan 1 daqiqada yoziladi.

OVERVIEW: eng katta 2 o'zgarish + hududning umumiy xarakteri: "the area became far more residential", "the main change was the replacement of farmland with housing", "the campus will gain new facilities". Raqam va kichik detal yo'q.

JOYLASHUV kompas bo'yicha: in the north-east of the area, to the south of the river, adjacent to (yonma-yon), opposite (ro'parasida), alongside (bo'ylab). Har o'zgarishga 'qayerda?' javobini qo'shing.

PASSIV: o'tgan xaritada — was/were + V3 (was demolished, was replaced by, was converted into, was extended); taklif rejasida — will be + V3 yoki is to be + V3 (will be extended, is to be built). Faol shakllar ham bor: made way for, remained unchanged.
JOY NOMLARI (slayd 44): xaritadagi nomlarni aynan ko'chiring (Greenbank, North Road, East Road) — imlo xatosi ham Task Achievement (noaniqlik), ham Lexical Resource (imlo) bahosini tushiradi.

UCHTA XATO (slaydlar 26–28): 1) izoh — "because people wanted more shops" (xaritada sabab yo'q); 2) overview ham, xulosa ham (yoki hech biri); 3) hamma narsani sanash — har daraxt va yo'lakni emas, asosiy o'zgarishlarni tanlang.
formulas: Xarita ko'rinishiga mos shablonga joy va yillarni qo'yish
The maps illustrate the changes that took place in the riverside area of Greenbank between 2000 and 2025.
Eng katta 2 o'zgarish + umumiy xarakter, raqamsiz
Overall, the area was transformed from farmland and industry into a mainly residential and commercial district.
Xaritaning bir qismi (masalan, shimol) + joylashuv + passiv
To the north of the river, the farmland made way for a large housing estate.
Joy bo'yicha guruhlash xaritada eng tabiiy
On the southern bank, the factory was demolished and replaced by a shopping centre.
was/were + V3; faol: made way for, remained unchanged
The small park was extended to the western edge of the area.
Kim qurgani muhim emas — natija muhim
will be + V3 / is to be + V3 / is going to be + V3
The tennis courts are to be replaced by a sports hall.
presentation: Xaritada overview'ga nima yoziladi?
Eng katta 2 o'zgarish va hududning umumiy xarakteri (more residential, more urbanised, more facilities for tourists); kerak bo'lsa, o'zgarmagan asosiy narsa ham.
Ikki xarita ko'rinishini qanday ajrataman?
Savoldagi vaqtga qarang: "in 2000 and 2025" — o'tgan zamon (was/were + V3); "at present and the proposed changes" — kelajak (will be / is to be + V3).
P3 va P4 ni qanday bo'laman?
Joy bo'yicha: shimol va janub, daryoning ikki qirg'og'i, markaz va chekka. Bir xatboshida — xaritaning bitta qismi.
Har o'zgarishni yozishim kerakmi?
Yo'q (slayd 28). Katta binolar, yer turi va yo'llardagi o'zgarishlar yetarli; har daraxt yoki skameyka shart emas.
"Replaced" va "replaced by" farqi nima?
"The factory was replaced by a shopping centre" — zavod o'rnida savdo markazi. "by" dan keyin YANGI narsa keladi; teskari yozilsa ma'no buziladi.
O'zgarmagan narsalarni yozamanmi?
Ha, qisqa: "The main road remained unchanged." Bu solishtirish talabini bajaradi, lekin bir gapdan oshmasin.
notes: Doskaga kompas chizing (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW) va dars oxirigacha qoldiring — o'quvchilar har o'zgarishni 'qayerda?' bilan aytsin.

Xulosa bosqichida Task 1 blok yakuni: har o'quvchi 21–25-darslar uy vazifalari bandlarini (line graph, bar chart, pie chart + table, process, map) W6_T1_CLASS bo'yicha jadvalga yozadi va eng zaif mezonni belgilaydi — keyingi Writing bloki shu jadvaldan boshlanadi.
Xaritalar va joy nomlari (Greenbank, kollej kampusi, ko'l bo'yidagi qishloq) mashq uchun to'qilgan; xaritalar Jony Academy original (matplotlib).
mistakes: The factory replaced by a shopping centre.
The factory was replaced by a shopping centre.
A shopping centre was replaced by the factory.
The factory was replaced by a shopping centre.
The trees were cut down because the village needed money from tourists.
Part of the forest was cleared to make way for a campsite.
The library will be extended / is to be extended.

how: CORE — joylashuv va yo'nalish; STRONG — o'zgarish passivi; SUPER — Band 7 iboralari va hududning umumiy xarakteri.
Namuna xaritadagi har o'zgarish uchun CORE joylashuv + STRONG fe'l bilan bitta gap tuzing: "To the east of the park, the factory was demolished."
core: To the north of the river, a housing estate was built.
A school was constructed in the north-east of the area.
The playground is in the south-west, inside the park.
The school stands opposite the large car park, on the other side of the river.
Maktab daryoning narigi tomonida, katta avtoturargoh ro'parasida turibdi.
A large car park was built adjacent to the shopping centre.
Savdo markaziga yondosh katta avtoturargoh qurildi.
A cycle path was built alongside the river.
The plans compare the present layout of the campus with the proposed changes.
Rejalar kampusning hozirgi tarhini taklif qilingan o'zgarishlar bilan solishtiradi.
The campus will gain new sports and study facilities.
Kampusda yangi sport va o'quv inshootlari paydo bo'ladi.
strong: The factory in the east was demolished.
The factory was replaced by a shopping centre.
The farmland to the south of the lake was converted into a golf course.
Ko'lning janubidagi ekin maydoni golf maydoniga aylantirildi.
The jetty was extended from 20 to 60 metres.
A pedestrian bridge was constructed to the west of the road bridge.
Avtomobil ko'prigining g'arbida piyodalar ko'prigi qurildi.
The car park is to be relocated to the north-east corner of the campus.
The northern bank became a residential area.
super: The farmland made way for a large housing estate.
Ekin maydoni katta turar-joy massiviga o'rin bo'shatdi.
The main road and the road bridge remained unchanged.
Asosiy yo'l va avtomobil ko'prigi o'zgarishsiz qoldi.
A café is to be built to the north-east of the lake.
By 2025, the riverside area had become far more urbanised.
2025 ga kelib daryo bo'yi hududi ancha shaharlashgan edi.
The biggest development was the new housing estate.
Eng katta qurilish loyihasi yangi turar-joy massivi edi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Qayerda? (Greenbank, 2025)
class_ex.instr: Namuna xaritasiga (2025) qarab har savolga to'liq gap bilan javob bering: to the north of, adjacent to, opposite, alongside iboralaridan foydalaning.
items: Where was the housing estate built?
Where is the large car park in relation to the shopping centre?
What is opposite the large car park, on the other side of the river?
Where does the cycle path run?
Where is the new pedestrian bridge?
Where is the playground?
answers: It was built to the north of the river, in the west and centre of the northern bank.
It is adjacent to the shopping centre, on its eastern side.
The school is opposite the large car park, in the north-east.
It runs alongside the river, along the whole northern bank.
It is to the west of the road bridge, between the housing estate and the park.
It is in the south-west of the area, in the western part of the extended park.
why: to the north of + mo'ljal (the river).
adjacent to — bevosita yonma-yon.
opposite — daryoning ikki tomonida, bir-biriga qarab.
alongside — butun uzunligi bo'ylab.
to the west of — mo'ljalga nisbatan yo'nalish.
in the south-west of — hudud ichidagi joy (to the south-west of — hududdan tashqarida).

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: O'zgarish fe'li
class_ex.instr: Bo'shliqqa box'dagi fe'llardan mosini qo'ying; har fe'l bir marta ishlatiladi.
box: was demolished
was replaced by
was converted into
was extended
made way for
remained unchanged
was constructed
was relocated
items: The factory in the east _____, and the land was cleared.
Later, the factory _____ a shopping centre with a large car park.
In the village, the farmland to the south of the lake _____ a golf course.
The small park _____ to the western edge of the area.
A new pedestrian bridge _____ to the west of the road bridge.
On the northern bank, the fields _____ new homes and a school.
The main road along the south of the area _____.
In another town plan, the bus station _____ from the centre to the edge of the town.
why: Bino yo'q qilindi — "the land was cleared" ishorasi.
"by" dan keyin yangi narsa: zavod → savdo markazi.
Yer qoldi, faqat vazifasi o'zgardi — converted into.
Mavjud park kattalashdi — extended.
Yangi inshoot paydo bo'ldi — constructed.
was yo'q, keyin ot — faol shakl made way for.
Obyektsiz faol shakl — remained unchanged.
"from ... to ..." — joyi o'zgardi: relocated.
class_ex.note: 2- va 3-gapda replaced by / converted into / made way for ham grammatik to'g'ri; ma'no farqini so'rang: binolar almashsa — replaced by, yerning vazifasi o'zgarsa — converted into.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: O'tgan yoki kelajak? (kampus rejasi)
class_ex.instr: Kampus rejasi hali amalga oshmagan. Har gapni kelajak shakliga o'giring: will be + V3, is to be + V3 yoki is going to be + V3 (har shaklni kamida bir marta ishlating).
items: The library was extended to the south.
The tennis courts were replaced by a sports hall.
The car park made way for student accommodation.
The car park was relocated to the north-east corner.
A new entrance was opened on East Road.
A café was built to the north-east of the lake.
answers: The library will be extended to the south.
The tennis courts are to be replaced by a sports hall.
The car park will make way for student accommodation.
The car park is going to be relocated to the north-east corner.
A new entrance will be opened on East Road.
A café is to be built to the north-east of the lake.
why: was + V3 → will be + V3.
Ko'plik: are to be + V3 (rasmiy reja uslubi).
Faol ibora: made way for → will make way for.
is going to be + V3 — reja allaqachon tuzilgan.
Joy nomi aynan xaritadagidek: East Road.
is to be built — taklif rejalarida eng ko'p uchraydi.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Uchta xato (slaydlar 26–28)
class_ex.instr: Har parchada qaysi xato bor: 1) izoh, 2) overview + xulosa (yoki ikkalasi ham yo'q), 3) hamma narsani sanash? Xatoni ayting va qanday tuzatishni taklif qiling.
items: Between 2000 and 2025, the factory was demolished because the people of Greenbank wanted more shops and jobs.
(The answer has an overview in paragraph 2.) Last paragraph: "In conclusion, Greenbank became much more residential and easier to cross."

In 2000 there was a river, a road, a bridge, a farm track, farmland, a factory, a park and some grass. In 2025 there was a river, a road, two bridges, a cycle path, houses, a school, shops, a car park, a park and a playground.
A pedestrian bridge was probably built so that children from the new houses could walk safely to the park.
The answer has three paragraphs: an introduction, then the northern bank, then the southern bank. There is no general statement anywhere.
answers: 1-xato (izoh): "because ... wanted more shops and jobs" o'chiriladi → "the factory was demolished and replaced by a shopping centre".
2-xato: overview ham, xulosa ham — oxirgi xulosa o'chiriladi (bir xil fikr takrorlangan).
3-xato: hamma narsa sanalgan, o'zgarish ko'rsatilmagan → faqat asosiy o'zgarishlar: farmland → housing estate, factory → shopping centre, new bridge.
1-xato (izoh): "probably ... so that children could ..." — xaritada sabab yo'q → "a pedestrian bridge was constructed to the west of the road bridge".
2-xato (ikkalasi ham yo'q): overview yo'q — Task Achievement Band 5 dan oshmaydi; 2-xatboshi sifatida "Overall, ..." qo'shiladi.
why: Slayd 26: faqat ko'rsating, tushuntirmang.
Slayd 27: ikkalasini birga yozmang.
Slayd 28: "key features" — hammasi degani emas.
"probably" va "so that" — taxmin va maqsad, ya'ni izoh.
Slayd 27: bittasi har doim kerak — biz overview'ni 2-xatboshida yozamiz.

P3 va P4 qaysi guruh? Guruh sababini 1 gapda ayta olasizmi?

Bandni raqam bilan yozing va 1 maslahat bering

readings.title: NAMUNA: Map → reja → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (172 so'z; ma'lumot mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The maps below show the riverside area of the town of Greenbank in 2000 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA (2 daqiqa): O: farm + factory → houses + shops // crossing ↑ (2 bridges) // main road, old bridge ≈. P3 (N bank): farm → housing (W + C), school (NE), cycle path. P4 (S bank + bridges): factory → shopping + car park (E), park ← W + playground, new footbridge W of old bridge.
text: The maps illustrate the changes that took place in the riverside area of Greenbank between 2000 and 2025.

Overall, the area was transformed from farmland and industry into a mainly residential and commercial district. In addition, it became much easier to cross the river, while the main road and the road bridge remained unchanged.

To the north of the river, the farmland that covered the whole bank in 2000 made way for a large housing estate in the west and centre, and a school was constructed in the north-east. A cycle path was also built alongside the river, running along the entire northern bank.

On the southern bank, the factory in the east was demolished and replaced by a shopping centre, with a large car park adjacent to it. To the west, the small park was extended to the western edge of the area, and a playground was added. Finally, a new pedestrian bridge was constructed to the west of the road bridge, linking the new housing estate directly with the park.
glossary: link A with B — A ni B bilan bog'lamoq
paraphrases: The maps illustrate the changes that took place in
the riverside area of the town of Greenbank
from farmland and industry into a mainly residential and commercial district

tasks.title: Namunani formula bilan tekshiring
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Xarita va rejaga qarab javob bering.
items: Kirish qaysi shablon bilan yozilgan?
Overview'dagi ikki asosiy fikr qaysi?
P3 va P4 qanday guruhlangan?
Javobda nechta passiv fe'l bor? Uchtasini ayting.
Nega javobda "because people wanted more shops" kabi gap yo'q?
Javob oxirida xulosa bormi? Nega?
answers: "The maps illustrate the changes that took place in ... between ... and ..." (slayd 47)
Hudud ekin maydoni va sanoatdan turar-joy va savdo hududiga aylandi; daryodan o'tish osonlashdi (asosiy yo'l va avtomobil ko'prigi (road bridge) o'zgarmadi)
Joy bo'yicha: P3 — shimoliy qirg'oq; P4 — janubiy qirg'oq va ko'priklar
8 ta: was transformed, was constructed (school), was built, was demolished, (was) replaced, was extended, was added, was constructed (bridge)
Bu izoh bo'lardi — xaritada sabab ko'rsatilmagan (slayd 26)
Yo'q — overview bor, ikkalasi kerak emas (slayd 27)
why: Kirish shablon bilan 1 daqiqada yoziladi — rejaga kirmaydi.
Overview — raqamsiz, eng katta 2 o'zgarish.
Xaritada joy bo'yicha guruhlash eng tabiiy; ikki xatboshi deyarli teng.
O'tgan xarita — was/were + V3; made way for va remained unchanged — faol shakllar.
Faqat ko'rsating, tushuntirmang.
Slayd 27: overview va xulosani birga yozmang, lekin bittasi doim bo'lsin (NEVER write both, ALWAYS write one).

tasks.title: WRITING NORMATIV — Map: kollej kampusi rejasi
tasks.type: Writing (yozma)
tasks.instr: 2' reja + 18' yozish: 150+ so'z, 4 xatboshi, overview raqamsiz; kelajak passivi (will be / is to be + V3). Keyin juftlikda W6_T1_CLASS bo'yicha band qo'ying.
items: The plans below show a college campus at present and the proposed changes for next year. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
answers: Namuna kirish: The plans compare the present layout of a college campus with the changes that are proposed for next year.

Namuna overview: Overall, the campus is set to gain several new facilities for sport, study and student life, and its car park will be moved to the north-east, where a second entrance will be created. The lake and the main entrance on North Road will remain unchanged.

P3 (markaz va sharq): the library is to be extended southwards; the tennis courts in the east will be replaced by a sports hall; the car park will be relocated to the north-east corner, adjacent to a new entrance from East Road.
P4 (janub va g'arb): the car park in the south will make way for student accommodation; a café is to be built to the north-east of the lake, which will remain unchanged.
why: 1-tekshiruv: kirish "compare the present layout ... with the proposed changes" shabloni bilan, savoldan 3 tadan ko'p so'z aynan emas.
2-tekshiruv: overview'da eng katta 2 o'zgarish (yangi inshootlar; avtoturargoh va kirish yangi joyda), raqam va izoh yo'q.
3-tekshiruv: kelajak passivi to'g'ri (will be extended, is to be replaced) va joy nomlari xaritadagidek (North Road, East Road, sports hall).

kahoot.q: 'The maps show a village in 1990 and 2025.' Which verb form will most of your sentences need?
options: Past passive: was built, was replaced
kahoot.explain: Ikki o'tgan davr xaritasi (1990 va 2025) — o'zgarishlar allaqachon bo'lgan, shuning uchun o'tgan passiv: was/were + V3.

kahoot.q: 'The plans show the present layout of a campus and the proposed changes.' Which sentence fits?
options: The library will be extended to the south.
The library had been extended to the south.
The library was extended to the south.
The library extends to the south.
kahoot.explain: Taklif (proposed) rejasi hali amalga oshmagan — kelajak passivi kerak: will be + V3 yoki is to be + V3.

kahoot.q: Which is the best introduction for maps of Greenbank in 2000 and 2025?
options: The maps show how Greenbank changed between 2000 and 2025.
Overall, Greenbank became far more residential and commercial.
The factory in Greenbank was demolished because of low profits.
In 2000 there was a river, a road, a bridge and a factory.
kahoot.explain: Kirish — shablon: joy va yillarni qo'yib savolni paraphrase qilish. 'Overall...' — overview, 'because...' — izoh (xato), ro'yxat — kirish emas.

kahoot.q: Which sentence is the best overview for the Greenbank maps?
options: Overall, the area became mainly residential and commercial.
Overall, the park was extended by about 200 metres.
The factory was demolished because local people wanted more shops.
The maps show Greenbank in 2000 and in 2025.
kahoot.explain: Overview — eng katta o'zgarish va hududning umumiy xarakteri, raqamsiz. Raqam P3–P4 ga tegishli, sabab umuman yozilmaydi, oxirgi gap esa kirish.

kahoot.q: A shopping centre was built where the factory stood. Which sentence is correct?
options: The factory was replaced by a shopping centre.
A new shopping centre was replaced by the factory.
The factory replaced by a shopping centre.
The factory was replacing a shopping centre.
kahoot.explain: 'by' dan keyin YANGI narsa keladi: eski zavod o'rnida yangi savdo markazi. Passivda was tushib qolmasin.

kahoot.q: Which sentence about a PROPOSED change is correct?
options: The car park is to be relocated to the north-east.
The car park is relocating to the north-east.
The car park relocated to the north-east.
The car park will relocate itself to the north-east.
kahoot.explain: Taklif rejasida passiv kelajak: is to be + V3 yoki will be + V3. Avtoturargoh o'zi ko'chmaydi — uni ko'chirishadi.

kahoot.q: On the map, the school is in the top right corner. Where is it?
kahoot.explain: Xaritada tepa — shimol (north), o'ng — sharq (east). Tepa o'ng burchak — north-east.

kahoot.q: How are paragraphs 3 and 4 usually grouped in a map answer?
options: By area, e.g. north and south banks
By year, one paragraph for each date
By size, from the biggest building down
By alphabet, using the names on the map
kahoot.explain: Xaritada eng tabiiy guruhlash — joy bo'yicha: shimol va janub, daryoning ikki qirg'og'i, markaz va chekka.

kahoot.q: Which sentence would LOSE marks in a map answer?
options: The farm was sold because the owner needed money.
The farmland made way for a housing estate.
A new cycle path was built alongside the whole river.
kahoot.explain: Xaritada sabab ko'rsatilmaydi — 'because...' izohi o'zingizdan qo'shilgan ma'lumot, Task Achievement pasayadi.

kahoot.q: Your answer already has an overview in paragraph 2. What about a conclusion at the end?
options: Don't add one – never write both
Add one that repeats the overview
Add one with your own opinion
Add one with the main numbers
kahoot.explain: Qoida: overview yoki xulosa — bittasi doim bo'lsin, ikkalasi hech qachon. Takror fikr vaqt va so'zni isrof qiladi.

kahoot.q: A student lists every tree, bench and path on both maps. What is the problem?
options: The answer will be under 150 words
Maps should not mention any roads
Trees must always go in the overview
kahoot.explain: Hamma narsani sanash — xato: katta binolar, yer turi va yo'llardagi asosiy o'zgarishlarni tanlang.

kahoot.q: The map label says 'East Road'. A student writes 'East Rood'. Which criteria can lose marks?
options: Grammatical Range and Coherence and Cohesion
kahoot.explain: Joy nomidagi imlo xatosi ham noaniqlik (Task Achievement), ham imlo (Lexical Resource) bahosini tushiradi — nomni aynan ko'chiring.

kahoot.q: Task 1 block review: which language does a PROCESS diagram mainly need?
options: Location: to the north of, opposite
kahoot.explain: Jarayonda passiv va ketma-ketlik tili: 'is cut', 'next', 'after that'. Joylashuv — xarita, trend — vaqtli grafik, solishtirish — vaqtsiz grafik.

kahoot.q: Task 1 block review: which type has NO trend, only an 'old vs new' difference?
options: A line graph over ten years
A bar chart with yearly data
kahoot.explain: Xaritada o'sish yoki tushish yo'q — eski va yangi holat farqi (slayd 34). Yillik ma'lumotli grafik va jadvalda esa trend bor.

kahoot.q: 'By 2025, the riverside area ___ far more urbanised.' Which form fits best?
kahoot.explain: 'By 2025' — o'tgan davr xaritasida shu vaqtgacha yakunlangan natija: had become (past perfect).

kahoot.q: Which phrase means 'right next to, sharing a side'?
kahoot.explain: adjacent to — yonma-yon: 'A large car park was built adjacent to the shopping centre.'

kahoot.q: 'The school stands ___ the car park, on the other side of the river.' Which word fits?
kahoot.explain: opposite — ro'parasida: daryoning narigi tomonida, qarshi tomonda turadi.

kahoot.q: 'The old warehouse ___ a hotel.' (the same building gets a new use) Which phrase fits?
kahoot.explain: was converted into — boshqa maqsadga aylantirildi: bino buzilmaydi, faqat vazifasi o'zgaradi.

kahoot.q: 'The farmland ___ a housing estate.' Which phrase shows the farmland disappeared and houses were built?
kahoot.explain: made way for — o'rnini bo'shatib berdi: dala yo'qolib, o'rnida uy-joy massivi qurildi (faol shakl).

kahoot.q: 'The main road ___.' Which phrase shows that nothing changed?
kahoot.explain: remained unchanged — o'zgarmay qoldi: solishtirish uchun o'zgarmagan asosiy narsa bir gap bilan aytiladi.
